jobs.title: AI Software Engineer II (Credit)

jobs.title: CAD Evaluation Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: Storygold is seeking a CAD Evaluation Engineer to build the execution harnesses, benchmarking tools, and evaluation infrastructure needed to test AI systems inside 3D CAD and physics simulation software. In this role, you will bridge mechanical engineering principles (FEA, structural analysis) with Python automation pipelines that evaluate how effectively AI models perform technical design tasks. **Responsibilities** * Build, adapt, and maintain execution harnesses that programmatically interface CAD platforms and simulation solvers with AI evaluation and RL training frameworks. * Design standardized benchmark tasks and physical ground\-truth tests for CAD modeling, FEA, static stress, and thermal analysis workflows. * Inspect, debug, and grade CAD models, feature tree failures, constraint errors, and geometry rebuild issues generated by language models and RL agents. * Implement automated scoring scripts, deterministic validation checks, and reward metrics to grade model tool\-use, geometry validity, and physics accuracy. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome). * Sound understanding of core Mechanical Engineering simulation principles (FEA, static analysis, stress, thermal mechanics, constraints). * Hands\-on experience with parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, FreeCAD, Fusion 360, CadQuery, NX, or Creo). * **No prior coding expertise required**—must be open, eager, and willing to learn basic Python on the job to execute scripts and maintain test harnesses. * Fluent or proficient technical English (B2\+ level). Pay: From $1,400\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description: *Union Square Hospitality Group (USHG) has created some of New York’s most beloved restaurants, cafes, and bars, which offer outstanding food delivered with our signature warmth and hospitality. Founded by Danny Meyer with the opening of Union Square Cafe in 1985, the company now extends beyond the walls of its eateries.* *USHG has long supported its communities through hunger relief and civic organizations. USHG holds 28 James Beard Awards and numerous accolades for its distinctive style of hospitality.* **Who you are:** The Data and AI Engineer will own the data infrastructure that powers reporting and decision\-making across every concept in the USHG portfolio. This is a hybrid role split evenly between two disciplines: building and maintaining our AWS Redshift data warehouse, and building and maintaining the AI layer on top of it. You will be the first dedicated owner of this stack end\-to\-end: source APIs in, clean and modeled data in Redshift, and an AI\-driven experience out. You will work closely with FP\&A, Operations, Marketing and others to understand the data they need and the questions they want to answer, and you’ll be the one who helps build the solutions needed. **What you’ll do:** * Cultivate a culture of Enlightened Hospitality for all stakeholders * Design, build, and maintain the AWS Redshift environment that consolidates data from our source APIs (POS, reservations, guest survey, labor/HR, and other operational systems) * Build and maintain ETL pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data reliably and on schedule, using tools such as AWS Glue, Lambda, and/or Airflow * Design efficient schemas and data models (distribution keys, sort keys, incremental models) optimized for reporting and analytics workloads * Monitor pipeline health and data quality; build automated validation and alerting so issues are caught before they reach a report * Manage Redshift performance and cost – right\-sizing clusters, tuning queries, and keeping the environment scalable as we add sources and concepts * Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, schemas, and access controls * Design, build, and maintain an internal analytics agent that lets non\-technical stakeholders ask questions of our data in plain language and get accurate, trustworthy answers * Build and maintain AI\-automated reporting structures (e.g. daily/weekly/ monthly reports) that blend metrics with narration * Prototype and productionize agentic workflows – including retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails – so AI\-generated outputs are reliable enough for operators and executives to act on * Evaluate and integrate new AI/LLM tooling as the space evolves, bringing back practical recommendations rather than chasing every new release **What we need from you:** * 2\-4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role * Hands\-on production experience with AWS Redshift or comparable cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery), including schema design and query/performance tuning * Strong SQL and Python skills * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating data from multiple third\-party APIs * Hands\-on experience with LLM/AI tooling – e.g. Claude or another foundation model API, prompt design, RAG, or agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) * Comfort working with ambiguous, evolving requirements and prioritizing independently * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders **What you’ll get from us:** At Union Square Hospitality Group, we believe our people are our greatest ingredient. Joining our team means becoming part of a culture rooted in care, creativity, and growth. As a Data and AI Engineer, you’ll enjoy: * *Competitive pay and bonus potential*: Annual compensation of $110,000 plus eligibility for a performance\-based bonus, with consideration for your experience and impact * *Comprehensive health coverage:* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending options for healthcare and dependent care * *Time to recharge:* Generous paid time off and paid parental leave to support life outside of work * *Investing in your future:* A matched 401(k) plan to help you grow long\-term savings * *Peace of mind:* Life insurance, employee assistance programs, and exclusive access to primary care, mental health, and other wellness services. * *Support in times of need:* Access to the USHG HUGS Employee Relief Fund, offering direct assistance to team members facing unexpected hardship * *Hospitality perks:* Annual dining credit and a 51% dining discount across the entire USHG family of restaurants * *Convenience \& flexibility:* Pre\-tax commuter benefits for transit and parking * *Growth and community:* Opportunities for learning, mentorship, and collaboration with some of the most passionate people in hospitality. **Putting Enlightened Hospitality into Practice** Integral to our culture are our six behaviors. Our behaviors guide how we work together. * **We play to win with humble swagger.** Hospitality is a team sport where everyone deserves an opportunity to thrive and belong * **Turn over the rocks and always be connecting dots** to build uplifting experiences and relationships * **Center the salt shaker** with an unwavering commitment to excellence and the values that matter most * **Write a great next chapter.** The road to success is paved with mistakes well\-handled * **Bring a charitable assumption** and err on the side of generosity * **Leave our campsite better than we found it;** always responsible for the impact of our wake * The above represents the expected salary range for this position. Ultimately, we'll consider your experience and other job\-related factors in determining your pay. *The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive. This role may be required to take on other duties or projects as necessary to support organizational goals, in alignment with their skills, experience, and the evolving needs of the business.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** This role is in based in Houston, TX. Candidates currently located in the Houston, TX are are encouraged to apply. We're looking for a Data Engineer to design and maintain the data architecture that powers our business systems and analytics — and possess a working knowledge of AI\-powered applications as they become part of that landscape. You'll own how data is modeled, moved, and governed across the organization, and make sure that foundation is solid enough for both traditional reporting and modern AI\-driven tools to build on. This role sits at the center of a lot of cross\-functional work: you'll partner with application teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to make sure data is structured consistently, documented clearly, and trustworthy wherever it's used. **Responsibilities** Data architecture \& schema design * Design canonical, well\-documented data models for core business entities (customers, projects, products, contracts, finance, etc.) that multiple systems and teams can rely on as a single source of truth. * Evaluate and evolve schemas as the business and its systems grow — balancing new requirements against long\-term maintainability. * Establish and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices. Pipelines \& integration * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that move data reliably from source systems (ERP, CRM, operational databases, vendor feeds, files) into a cloud data warehouse. * Monitor data quality and pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data issues at the source rather than downstream. * Integrate new data sources — including third\-party platforms and vendor APIs — into the existing architecture without duplicating effort or creating conflicting versions of the same data. Data governance * Define and maintain data classification standards (e.g., what counts as sensitive financial, contractual, or customer data) and ensure those standards are applied consistently across systems. * Support access control and audit requirements by ensuring data lineage and usage are traceable. * Maintain a data dictionary and related documentation so other teams can find and trust the data they need. AI\-aware data engineering * Design data structures and access patterns with an understanding of how they'll be consumed — including by AI/LLM\-powered applications that rely on well\-scoped, accurate context rather than raw database access. * Apply minimum\-necessary\-data principles when structuring data that will be surfaced through AI features, in partnership with application and security teams. * Stay current enough on how retrieval\-augmented generation and LLM context assembly work to make informed schema and access decisions — this is a working\-knowledge requirement, not a machine learning role. Collaboration * Work with engineering, product, and business teams to translate reporting and application needs into sound data models. * Act as a technical resource and point of contact for data\-related questions across multiple concurrent projects. **Technical Skills** **Required** * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or data architecture, including hands\-on schema/data model design in a production environment. * Strong SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and MSFT SQL Server preferred) * Experience SQL query language * Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. * Solid understanding of data governance fundamentals: classification, access control, and documentation practices. * Working knowledge of how modern AI/LLM applications consume data — context windows, retrieval\-augmented generation, and the basics of why minimizing and scoping data matters for these systems. * Strong communication skills; comfortable being the person other teams come to for data questions. Preferred * Experience in a distribution, industrial supply, or ERP\-adjacent environment. * Familiarity with integrating third\-party SaaS platforms via API. * Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions) and cloud application environments (e.g., AWS). * Experience consolidating multiple existing data models into a shared standard. Nice to have * Exposure to BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) and how they consume the underlying data model. * Working knowledge of Python **Company Statement:** PSS Industrial provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: DevSecOps / Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the delivery pipelines, automation, and environments that carry federal systems into production. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. It is a remote position, and a hybrid arrangement is preferred: hybrid means traveling to the client site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, typically one to two days a week. Wherever you work from, occasional travel to DC is part of the role. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you owning assigned delivery pipelines and the environments beneath them. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Work on the integration and deployment of enterprise tools and platforms such as SageMaker, Posit Connect, or on\-demand, pre\-configured EC2\-based Linux virtual machines. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure validation, testing, deployment, and release promotion. * Configure cloud networking, access permissions, storage, and compute resources following established security requirements. * Build and maintain Linux machine images, including software installation, configuration, patching, and validation. * Support analytics and development environments, including user onboarding, access configuration, and software dependencies. * Troubleshoot deployment failures, connectivity problems, permissions, Linux services, and application runtime issues using logs and diagnostic tools. * Write and maintain scripts that simplify recurring operational tasks and improve consistency. * Participate in code reviews, test infrastructure changes, and document implementation details, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks. * Take ownership of assigned changes from implementation through deployment verification, collaborating with senior engineers on architectural decisions and complex incidents. You deliver CloudFormation templates, Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), and pipelines that provide the required functionality through the enterprise tools and platforms, enforce the required controls, and produce the evidence a release review needs. You automate the manual steps out of the release path, and you build progressive delivery with automated health checks and rollback so that deploying stops being an event. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of DevSecOps or platform engineering experience * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Hands\-on experience administering Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure with a working understanding of compute, storage, networking, and identity management * Practical experience with infrastructure as code (CloudFormation or the AWS Cloud Development Kit), CI/CD pipeline automation with security gates using GitHub Actions or comparable tools, and hands\-on Docker image creation and containerization * Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including packages, services, permissions, and logs * Ability to write and troubleshoot scripts in Python and Bash * Understanding of least\-privilege access, zero trust principles, secure configuration, and controlled deployment processes * Experience with Git\-based version control * Monitoring and logging * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Federal security experience supporting Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance, implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls, and providing Authority to Operate (ATO) support * Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, Ansible, and software packaging experience * An Amazon Web Services certification * Nexus, Artifactory, CloudBolt, or comparable artifact management and provisioning platforms * OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication, deployment approval controls, and AWS environments spanning multiple accounts * Federal information technology experience **Who you are** You build security and reliability into the work from the start because they cannot be afterthoughts in a federal environment. You automate what others do by hand and leave an audit trail. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on ownership of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines in AWS environments, together with the knowledge to build and maintain Linux machine images and navigate the intricacies of enterprise tool integrations and deployment. * Python or Bash scripting beyond pipeline configuration, so you can automate the work the tools do not cover. * A working command of cloud networking, access permissions, storage, and compute resources to deliver optimal functionality on budget and in line with security requirements. * Judgment suited to building where security and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Director Information Technology (IT) - Remote San Diego
jobs.description: **About Belite Bio** Belite Bio is a clinical\-stage biopharmaceutical drug development company focused on advancing novel therapeutics targeting retinal degenerative eye diseases with significant unmet medical needs. Built on our proprietary Retinol Binding Protein 4 (RBP4\) IP portfolio, our clinical pipeline includes **Tinlarebant (LBS\-008\)**, an oral therapy currently in late\-stage clinical trials (including the Phase 3 DRAGON and PHOENIX studies) for Stargardt disease (STGD1\) and Geographic Atrophy (GA) in dry AMD. At Belite Bio, we are dedicated to developing innovative solutions to treat untreatable conditions and prevent vision loss in patients worldwide. As an early\-stage company, we value entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, accountability and the ability to thrive in fast moving environments. **Position Overview** Belite Bio is seeking a highly skilled AD/Director of IT to lead our technology infrastructure with a specialized focus on quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and policy development. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our technology ecosystems are secure, scalable, and fully aligned with global compliance standards. The ideal candidate possesses a strong technical background combined with extensive experience authoring enterprise IT policies and navigating complex regulatory frameworks. This role will also be expected to support IT asset management, including potentially configuring devices for new hires in coordination with other IT personnel. **Key Responsibilities** IT Governance, Policy \& Documentation * Draft, implement, and maintain comprehensive IT policies, procedures, and standards to ensure data integrity and operational security. * + Maintain the IT Compliance policy and procedure inventory, including document lifecycle tracking, review schedules, version control, approvals, publication, acknowledgments, retirement, and archival. + Coordinate IT policy approval workflows by working with reviewers, approvers, Legal, Compliance leadership, and other stakeholders to support timely review and documented approval. + Ensure IT policies, procedures, and related documents are consistently formatted, current, accessible, and aligned with applicable laws, regulations, industry guidance, Company standards, and operational needs. * Establish governance frameworks that align IT strategy with overall business objectives and risk management protocols. * Translate complex technical concepts and IT\-related legal regulations into clear, actionable internal policies for employees. IT Compliance \& Risk Management * Oversee IT\-related compliance with relevant industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, SOX) depending on applicability * Lead internal and external IT audits, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory bodies and auditors. * Conduct regular IT\-related risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to proactively mitigate data breaches and operational failures. IT Quality Assurance * Develop and enforce IT Quality Management Systems (QMS) to standardize software deployment, system validation, and infrastructure changes. * Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for IT quality. Strategic Leadership \& Operations * Provide vision and leadership for the IT department, managing a team of technical professionals, engineers, and analysts. * Manage the IT budget, optimizing resource allocation for hardware, software, vendor services, and compliance tooling. * Collaborate with Legal, HR, and executive leadership to align technology initiatives with company\-wide compliance goals. **Qualifications \& Requirements** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA is a plus. * 8\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 3\+ years in a leadership or directorial role. * Proven track record of successfully writing, rolling out, and enforcing IT policies at an enterprise level. * Deep experience managing IT compliance audits and working within structured quality frameworks. **Certifications (Highly Desired)** * CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) * CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) * CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control) * ITIL Foundation or Master certification * PMP (Project Management Professional) **Technical \& Soft Skills** * Exceptional technical writing skills with the ability to draft meticulous, legally sound documentation. * Strong understanding of modern IT infrastructure, cloud computing (AWS, Azure), network security, and data privacy laws. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. * Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving capabilities and high attention to detail. **Equal Employment Opportunity \& Accommodations** Belite Bio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Belite Bio is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interviewing process due to a medical condition or disability, please contact human resources to let us know the nature of your request. **Salary Disclosure** Pay Range: $172,000 to $200,000 USD (Salary offered will depend on candidate location, market rate adjustments, skills, and relevant experience). Belite Bio provides a competitive total compensation package that includes base salary, annual incentive bonuses, equity participation, and a full benefit package (health, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off).

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: **The Company** TelemetryX, formerly Access Control Group, is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pacific Rim Capital. TelemetryX is a fast\-growing provider of agnostic telemetry data and third\-party asset management services. TelemetryX centralizes fleet intelligence to transform data into operational power — driving continuous improvement across every asset and aspect of fleet operations. Our solutions help clients optimize total cost of ownership, performance, and safety. **Job Summary** The Director of Engineering for Telematics Hardware and Embedded Software is responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle management of telematics hardware and embedded software systems. The Director of Engineering manages internal and external engineering teams responsible for hardware development, embedded firmware, and device platform architecture used in connected equipment and vehicle telemetry solutions. The Director of Engineering ensures reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective device platforms while coordinating closely with product management, operations, and outsourced manufacturing and engineering partners. **Key Responsibilities** The primary duties include: * Lead development of telematics platforms including cellular, GPS, sensor interfaces, and power management systems and embedded software and firmware. * Manage the full product development lifecycle from concept through production and field deployment and * Manage contract manufacturers, suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure timely production and delivery of telematics hardware and coordinate with outsourced manufacturing partners to ensure design for manufacturability, design for test, and production quality. * Establish and maintain engineering processes for design reviews, documentation, testing, and release management and implement metrics to track development timing, product reliability, and productivity. * Define system architecture for telematics devices including communications, data processing, over\-the\-air updates, and security. * Oversee device certification efforts including cellular, FCC, carrier approvals, and environmental compliance. * Ensure devices meet quality and reliability requirements and standards. * Lead and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams including hardware, embedded software, and systems engineers. * Work with operations and supply chain to manage component selection, cost targets, and lifecycle risks. * Collaborate with product management to translate market requirements into technical specifications and development roadmaps. * Support customer deployments by assisting with technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of field issues. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree preferred. * 10\+ years of experience in embedded systems and hardware product development. * 5\+ years leading engineering teams. * Experience developing connected devices, telematics systems, cloud\-connected IoT platforms. * Experience with wireless technologies such as LTE, LTE\-M, NB\-IoT, WiFi, or Bluetooth. * Experience bringing hardware products from concept through production. * Experience working with contract manufacturers. * Experience designing ruggedized or automotive\-grade electronics. * Experience with certification processes (FCC, PTCRB, EE, carrier certification). * Familiarity with GPS/GNSS systems and vehicle or equipment interfaces (CAN, OBDII, J1939, sensor I/O). * Knowledge of OTA update frameworks and device security architecture. **Compensation and Benefits** * **Salary**: $188,000 \- $213,000 * **Performance Bonus**: Eligible for a quarterly bonus of up to 20%, bringing the total compensation range to $225,600\-$255,000\. * **Health Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, along with an Employee Assistance Program and 401(k) plan with company match, available for full\-time employees. * **Paid Time Off**: Accrue three weeks of PTO annually. * **Holidays**: Enjoy 15\.5 paid holidays throughout the year. *TelemetryX is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the People and Culture department.* *We believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience makes us stronger and helps us better serve our employees, customers, and communities.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: Every moment of every day, people around the world rely on the energy they access through infrastructure built by Quanta. Comprising the largest skilled\-labor force in North America, our employees are highly skilled and innovative, continually working to connect people and power. We’re building the infrastructure that supports the energy transition, and there are more opportunities than ever to be part of our team. Join us and build your career building a brighter future. Imagine what you could do here. We encourage, inspire, and support our people to seize opportunities in our corporate office and with hundreds of our operating companies worldwide that provide solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, and communications industries. Quanta actively promotes and maintains a culture of belonging where all employees can be themselves, live their values, and find opportunities to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic organization in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is prized. Come find out how our people power modern life. About this Role: The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands\-on technical consultant embedded in some of Quanta's most innovative and fast\-moving projects. You will partner with business leaders, domain experts, and engineers to design, prototype, and deploy real\-world solutions focused on AI, applications, and automation build around our enterprise Databricks Lakehouse platform. From domain\-specific chatbots to internal tooling and backend process automation, you'll work across a wide range of business and technical domains\-energy infrastructure, operations, finance, safety, logistics, and more. This role emphasizes speed, adaptability, and using AI\-powered development workflows to accelerate delivery and impact. What You'll Do: Engage directly with internal stakeholders and operating units to understand technical needs and business priorities Translate requirements into working software prototypes and full\-featured solutions Use AI\-assisted tools for code generation, automation, data analysis, and research acceleration Build integrations, applications, and scripts across cloud services, APIs, and enterprise systems Iterate rapidly on solutions with continuous feedback from subject matter experts Deploy applications to production environments and provide post\-deployment support Document learnings, design decisions, and reusable components to support scale and knowledge\-sharing Stay current with emerging AI tools and technologies\-and help bring them into use across Quanta's ecosystem What You'll Bring: * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field * 5\-10 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or technical consulting Licenses / Certifications: * None required * Cloud certifications or AI/ML specializations are a plus Knowledge and Skills: * 2\+ Years hands on experience with Databricks in an enterprise setting * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Java, Go) * Strong problem\-solving mindset with a consultative approach * Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern development practices (CI/CD, containers, APIs) * Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar for development workflows * Ability to learn new technologies and domain contexts quickly * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across disciplines What You'll Get: Competitive compensation and benefits package Flexible work options (on\-site, hybrid, or remote) Educational assistance and learning resources Wellness and Mental Health programs Paid Parental Leave Employee Referral Program Learning and Development Programs In\-office amenities and perks (where applicable) Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **About the Role** This role is based in Houston, TX. Candidates currently located in the Houston, TX area are encouraged to apply. **About the role** ------------------ PSS CC is building a set of AI\-powered business applications on a shared backend architecture: a master orchestrator model that routes to domain\-specific AI models, grounded in a canonical enterprise data model. This role builds the applications people use: the interfaces, APIs, and services that sit between that backend and the sales, finance, and operations teams relying on it. You'll work across the stack — front\-end interfaces, backend services and APIs, and the integration layer connecting to AI models and enterprise data — on whichever solution needs it most as the ecosystem grows. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build and maintain web application front\-ends for the ecosystem's tools (customer intelligence dashboards, AP/AR review interfaces, quoting workflows, internal AI assistants). * Design and implement backend APIs and services that connect front\-end applications to AI models, business logic, and the underlying data layer. * Work with existing Python\-based services and SQL\-backed data views, and help migrate them toward the platform's evolving canonical data model as it comes online. * Integrate application features with LLM\-backed capabilities — sending the right context to a model and rendering its response — following the platform's established grounding and security patterns rather than building ad hoc AI calls per feature. * Collaborate with data engineering, IT leadership, and (where applicable) third\-party vendor platforms to ship features end\-to\-end. * Write tests, participate in code review, and keep security and data\-handling practices consistent with the platform's standards, particularly around what data can reach an AI model and what can't. **Skills** ---------- **Required** * 4\+ years of professional full stack development experience. * Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front\-end framework (React preferred). * Solid backend experience with Python and REST API design. * Working SQL skills and comfort querying and shaping data from a relational or cloud data warehouse. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs into production applications. * Ability to work independently across unfamiliar codebases and pick up context quickly — this role moves between projects as priorities shift. **Preferred** * Experience building features on top of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — prompt/response handling, streaming responses, structured output. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) for hosting application and inference layers. * Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse. * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and code scanning tooling. **Nice to have** * Background in enterprise B2B software, distribution, or ERP\-adjacent systems. * Experience working alongside data or Machine Learning (ML) team building shared platform capabilities rather than one\-off features. **How success is measured in the first 6 months** ------------------------------------------------- * Shipped and maintaining at least one production\-facing feature or interface within the ecosystem. * Comfortable working across at least two of the platform's active solutions. * Able to build a new AI\-integrated feature following the platform's existing grounding and security patterns without requiring architectural guidance each time. **Company Statement:** PSS Industrial provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery\-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight. **Full Stack Software Engineer I** Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Interfaces team. The Interfaces team builds the software people use to operate, monitor, and manage our vehicles and fleet, including our main operator application and the product surfaces that will grow into enterprise customer software. This is a junior role with real ownership. You do not need years of production experience, but you do need high agency, clear communication, and the hunger to learn fast. We care more about how you work than how many years you have been paid to work. **Responsibilities:** * Build and improve the operator and customer product platform in TypeScript, React, and Rust. * Ship features in our Electron operator application. * Work with product and vehicle/systems engineers to turn operational needs into clear, reliable interfaces. * Own features end\-to\-end: understand the user, implement, test, document, and follow through after merge. * Grow into full\-stack product work as we expand enterprise software, including data models, APIs, and the performance and reliability of software that talks to the real world. **What Success Looks Like:** * **After 30 Days:** You've set up your environment, learned how operators use our application, and shipped your first changes to the software platform. You're asking good questions early and building relationships with product and vehicle/systems engineers. * **After 60 Days:** You've owned a feature end\-to\-end, from understanding the operator's need through implementation, testing, documentation, and follow\-through after merge. You're reading and improving code across the Interfaces codebase. * **After 90 Days:** You're a reliable contributor to the operator application, independently identifying and fixing problems without waiting to be assigned. You've started contributing beyond the UI, such as data models, APIs, or performance and reliability improvements for our enterprise software. **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp plus portfolio, research, or shipped projects are fine). * Comfortable writing software in TypeScript or Rust and component\-based UI (React or similar). You can read other people's code and leave it better than you found it. * A track record of picking up a new tool, language, or domain and becoming useful with it, whether through a class project, internship, research, open source, or something you built because you wanted it to exist. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Project or professional experience with Rust, React, TypeScript, or Python. * Exposure to desktop wrappers (Electron, Tauri), backend development, or databases. * Coursework or projects touching networks, operating systems, or distributed systems. * Experience pairing with AI coding tools and being honest about what they got wrong. *Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.* *Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.*

jobs.title: HVAC Estimator
jobs.description: The AER Commercial Estimator supports DNE’s estimating efforts for applied product lines by preparing accurate, timely cost estimates and proposals for a variety of HVAC projects. This role manages projects from bid receipt through submission, analyzing mechanical plans to evaluate system capacity, design feasibility, and code compliance, while suggesting design adjustments as needed. Experience: * Previous HVAC experience preferred but not required Education: * Bachelors degree or higher required * Engineering degree preferred. People Management: No Physical Requirements / Working Environment: * Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with reasonable accommodations. Reports to: * Director, AER/Inside Sales Pay Range: $65,000\-$75,000\.00 The Company provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of a person’s race, color, religion (including religious dress or grooming practices), creed, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, uniform service member or veteran status, ancestry, disability, physical or mental disability (including HIV/AIDS), medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, request for protected leave, marital status, sex, pregnancy, age (over 40\), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by law. The Company will comply with all federal and state regulations and statutes pertaining to individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Lead Forward Deployed Engineer** Location: San Francisco, CA (full time, in\-person) **Company Overview** Our mission is to **accelerate the construction of critical infrastructure on Earth** while pioneering technologies to enable humanity to build beyond. Starting with Cosmic\-1 – a system that installs solar panels 10x faster than today’s methods, helping us transition to a clean energy future and laying the groundwork for the future of autonomous construction. **The Role** As a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, you will build and lead the team that bridges our cutting\-edge robotics and our customers, owning the end\-to\-end deployment and long\-term success of robots in the field. You will work hand\-in\-hand with our customers to develop, deploy, and ensure the optimal performance of the best construction robots in the world. This role is crucial for extending our platform with new features based on direct customer feedback and driving its adoption. As a core member of the team, you will help define the era of autonomous construction. This is a rare opportunity to: * Work on hard, meaningful problems that impact the future of infrastructure and energy. * Collaborate with a world\-class team from NASA, SpaceX, Google, Amazon, Zoox, Tesla, Nuro, Built Robotics, and others. * Rapidly grow, learn, and lead within a quickly scaling company. **Responsibilities** * Own the full robot deployment lifecycle at customer sites, from initial setup and commissioning to field validation and long\-term maintenance. * Work directly with customers as a technical partner, translating their operational needs into requirements for new robot and platform features. * Develop, integrate, and deploy new features to meet specific customer requirements. * Triage and debug issues in the field and ensure high robot uptime. * Set milestones, plan roadmaps, and deliver on ambitious timelines for customer deployments and feature delivery. * Balance tasks as an individual contributor while also managing and mentoring other forward deployed engineers and staff. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional engineering experience at an organization with a strong forward deployed engineering culture. * Experience with forward deployment, field engineering, or technical consulting in a robotics field. * Management and recruiting experience. * Willingness to regularly travel to customer jobsites. * Experience debugging and developing hardware, software (Python, C\+\+), or mechatronics products. * Demonstrated experience owning the full product lifecycle from customer requirements collection to field deployment. * Excellent communication and project management skills. * Thrive in fast\-paced dynamic environments and push boundaries to meet deadlines. **Bonus** * 5\+ years of professional engineering experience in a technical field role.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Mgr
jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research, and is responsible for driving the day\-to\-day operation of the Product \& Technology organization, including: project and portfolio management and tracking; organization\-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team. **Job Summary**: Within the Business Operations organization, the Lead Technical Program Manager is a senior\-level program position responsible for driving complex, cross\-functional programs and initiatives that extend the functionality of services across Disney\+, Hulu, and ESPN\+. This role owns program\-level outcomes end to end, from scoping and sequencing through delivery, and is expected to operate with significant autonomy in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. You will partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to shape delivery models, influence organizational priorities, and drive alignment on the highest\-impact initiatives. If you enjoy entertainment, driving complex programs to completion, mentoring other program leads, and shaping how teams work, this role is an excellent fit for you. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role**: * **Project Planning and Execution**: Develop project plans and drive the end\-to\-end execution and delivery of multiple programs across various teams. Ensure all dependencies are understood and keep business partners informed of progress. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Work with engineering, product management, and cross\-functional leaders to align on the roadmap, vision, and strategy for the organization. * **Influence and Alignment**: Influence direction and drive alignment to reduce complexity across cross\-functional teams. * **Team Dynamics and Culture**: Develop team dynamics, morale, and motivation while fostering a culture where all members and points of view are respected. * **Engineering Partnership**: Partner with engineering to ensure developments balance cost vs. benefit, are highly scalable, and meet business goals, objectives, and customer needs. * **Proactive Initiative**: Display initiative, take a proactive approach, and initiate conversations. * **Skilled Negotiation**: Negotiate with skill and identify solution paths for various competing requirements or stakeholder preferences. * **Enthusiastic Learning**: Learn quickly and enthusiastically, especially about technical systems and issues. * **Process Improvement**: Constantly evaluate processes and seek ways to improve with every iteration. **Required Education and Experience/Skills/Training**: Minimum Qualifications: * Established in Technical Program Management with 7\+ years of experience in the software industry * Proven track record leading complex, cross\-functional programs and initiatives from scoping through delivery, with strong working knowledge of Agile and other software delivery methodologies * Experience working across the software development lifecycle, including delivery, release management, and technical program governance * Experience collaborating with product and design teams and other stakeholders to understand requirements, prioritize initiatives, and engage with engineering teams to drive projects forward * Ability to identify, analyze, prioritize, mitigate, and communicate project risks to internal and external partners * Proactive approach, able to initiate conversations and guide other program leads in process development, consistently evaluating and improving processes at every iteration * Developed essential soft skills, including meeting leadership, communication, teamwork, collaboration, flexibility, problem\-solving, critical thinking, and conflict resolution * BA/BS or equivalent experience required Preferred Qualifications: * Program or project management certification (PMP, CSM, CSP, or similar) preferred * Experience in streaming media software and digital technology * Expertise in software delivery management tools (Jira, Confluence, Airtable, etc.) * Technical proficiency demonstrated through coding skills, quality assurance experience, technical writing background, or similar expertise The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles, CA is $155,700 \- $208,700 per year and in Seattle, WA is $163,100 \- $218,700 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Multi-Family - Energy Engineer I
jobs.description: Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI\-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech\-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution. POSITION SUMMARY This position is primarily responsible for providing expert technical support to customers and trade allies. In this role, you will provide energy advice and coordination services for the energy efficiency programs; these services include: building maintenance, lighting, controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems for energy efficiency and comfort. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES This list of duties and responsibilities is not all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time. * Work with business and building owners, developers, architects, engineers and contractors to provide energy efficiency advice and assistance in participating energy efficiency or energy conservation programs * Identify and provide documentation of on\-site opportunities for energy efficiency in buildings under design and construction; provide follow\-up as required to the customers * Participate in QA/QC and internal audit activities * Analyze building utility bills to determine energy usage trends * Ability to promote, sell and influence property managers, owners and maintenance staff to install energy efficiency measures in multifamily dwellings * Prepare and present reports and presentations * Discuss technical elements of energy consuming equipment in a facility (lighting, HVAC, hot water systems, envelope, integrated design) and how it affects utility consumption and demand, to help build a business case to prioritize recommendations and how they affect savings and first cost * Enter data into spreadsheets and databases to determine energy savings and to manage current projects, collaborate with other Energy Advisors/Energy Engineers as required to maximize technical support to the client base * Develop a comprehensive understanding of the program’s strategic direction regarding energy efficiency and the business activities of its customers * Keeping current on the latest energy\-saving technology and how we might incorporate them into our products * Collaborating with other Energy Advisors and Energy Engineers to maximize client technical support * Serve as a technical resource for Energy Advisors * Ensure compliance with all quality and safety policies as well as all OSHA regulations POSITION REQUIREMENTS Education and Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited four\-year college or university. (Based on the position preferences may include: Mechanical, Civil, Electrical or Industrial Engineering) * 1 – 3 years engineering experience related to mechanical design, energy modeling or construction * 1 – 2 years of experience in the energy efficiency industry * Experience in building design, “green” construction and sustainable design \- Preferred * Certified Energy Manager and the LEED AP credentials – Preferred * CEM or VPI certification \- Preferred * PE or FE certification or desire to obtain one \- Preferred * A licensed engineer – Preferred * Strong understanding of how systems affect energy consumption Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities * Strong customer service and communication skills * Must be able to handle a wide work variety and work in a fast\-paced environment * Must be a self\-starter, organized and have an ability to prioritize workload * Ability to identify and resolve project application issues with customers and trade allies * Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook * Strong data entry skills in entering information in tracking systems/databases * Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with customers, clients and employees * Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems * Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages and ratios * Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry * Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions * Ability to understand and apply in a building environment applied physics including thermodynamics, fluids and heat transfer theory * Must be able to research questions of a technical nature efficiently and find new information * Committed to diversity and inclusion * Reliable transportation Licenses \& Certifications * Valid driver’s license **Compensation \& Benefits:** Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $76,000 to $78,000 annually. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company\-sponsored benefits and programs. Travel Requirements * Willingness to travel less than 50% **Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position. An Equal Opportunity Employer **Safety \-Sensitive Role Addendum:** Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration. **Notice Regarding Automated Tools:** We may use automated or AI\-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job\-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher –Catalytic Oleochemistry and Process Scale-Up.
jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Postdoctoral Researcher –Catalytic Oleochemistry and Process Scale\-Up. . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Postdoc (Fixed Term) . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== The Integrated Carbon Conversion Processes Group within NLR’s Catalytic Carbon Transformation and Scale\-Up Center is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher to work on oleochemistry, catalysis, and product development. Our group’s mission is to de\-risk and accelerate the scale\-up of technologies for producing chemicals, fertilizers, and critical minerals from domestic biomass resources and waste resources. Our multidisciplinary team integrates expertise in process engineering, process science, catalysis, and computational modeling of integrated processes to translate laboratory discoveries into technically and economically viable processes suitable for pilot\-scale demonstration and eventual commercialization. The selected candidate will work closely with senior researchers and industry collaborators to develop, de\-risk, and scale up processes for converting emerging plant oils into performance\-advantaged chemicals and materials. Target products may include lubricants, surfactants, specialty chemicals and other high\-value oleochemical products. The position combines fundamental catalytic science, with process development and applied research aimed at translating promising chemistries toward scalable and commercially relevant processes. A key objective will be to advance promising chemistries from bench\-scale discovery through integrated process development and pilot\-scale validation, generating the scientific and engineering knowledge required for technology scale\-up. The selected candidate’s responsibilities will include: * Developing pretreatment strategies for lipids to produce feedstocks with critical material attributes (CMAs) for downstream catalytic conversion into products * Develop and optimize catalytic processes that transform lipids, fatty acids, and related intermediates into chemical precursors for high\-value products * Design and evaluate catalytic reaction pathways from bench to pilot including catalyst screening, reaction engineering and integration of reaction and separation unit operations * Develop product formulations and structure\-property relationships that connect molecular composition with enhanced performance in applications such as lubricants, surfactants and specialty chemicals. * Generating kinetic, mass\-balance, and process\-performance data needed to support reactor design, process modeling, techno\-economic analysis, and transition from laboratory systems to pilot\-scale operation. * Establishing CMAs and critical process parameters (CPPs) for key unit operations and determining how feedstock variability and processing conditions affect intermediate quality, product performance, process robustness, and scale\-up. * Communicating research results through technical reports, peer\-reviewed publications, conference presentations, invention disclosures, and project reviews. . **Basic Qualifications** ======================== Must be a recent PhD graduate within the last three years. **\* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.** **Additional Required Qualifications** ====================================== **Required Education, Experience, and Skills** Must be a recent PhD graduate within the last three years in Chemical Engineering, Biological Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, or relevant field. * A solid background in biorefinery and biomass conversion. * Strong scientific writing skills demonstrated by first authorship of quality scientific papers. * Proven communications ski ience in oleochemistry * Experience with wet chemistry, including sample preparation and catalytic conversion. * Experience with catalytic upgrading and catalyst characterization. * Experience with separations, including liquid\-liquid and solid\-liquid extractions. * Experience with polymer formulation. * Operation of analytical instrumentation (e.g. FTIR, SEM, GC\-MS, etc.) * Experience with pilot scale equipment for biomass conversion. * Experience with modeling and machine learning. . **Job Application Submission Window** ===================================== The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. **Annual Salary Range (based on full\-time 40 hours per week)** =============================================================== Job Profile: Postdoctoral Researcher / Annual Salary Range: $76,600 \- $126,400 NLR takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions. **Benefits Summary** ==================== Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short\-term disability insurance\*; pension benefits\*; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match\*; life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance; personal time off (PTO) and sick leave; and paid holidays. NLR employees may be eligible for, but are not guaranteed, performance\-, merit\-, and achievement\- based awards that include a monetary component. Some positions may be eligible for relocation expense reimbursement. **\*** Based on eligibility rules **Badging Requirement** ======================= NLR is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as required by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\), which includes a favorable background investigation. **Drug Free Workplace** ======================= NLR is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug\-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre\-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre\-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre\-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn. **Submission Guidelines** ========================= Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at NLR you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application. . **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Reasonable Accommodations** **E** **\-Verify** **www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify** For information about right to work E\-Verify is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. This business uses E\-Verify in its hiring practices to achieve a lawful workforce.

Can effectively articulate complex ideas and influence others through well\-reasoned explanations. * Enjoy working within a team setting of engineers of varying experience * Excellent written and verbal communication skill with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience using modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to improve code quality, accelerate development, and enhance documentation. \#DISNEYTECH The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $117,500 to $157,500 per year.
