jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Sales Technical Enablement
jobs.description: **Business Area:** Sales Operations**Seniority Level:** Mid\-Senior level**Job Description:** At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises. The Technical Enablement team at Cloudera is the engine behind our field’s competitive edge. We don't just deliver training; we architect the frameworks that transform complex data product capabilities into field\-ready value propositions. As the Senior Director of Global Sales Technical Field Enablement, you will be a critical executive leader responsible for building, scaling, and leading the global organization that drives technical readiness across our Solution Engineering and other customer facing organizations. Reporting directly to the VP of Global Sales Enablement, you will own the end\-to\-end technical readiness lifecycle. You will lead a high\-performing team of enablement managers and strategists, acting as the strategic liaison between executive leadership in Product Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure our technical sellers are elite consultants capable of navigating the most complex enterprise data architectures. **Strategic Responsibilities** ------------------------------ ### **Global Organizational Leadership \& Scale** * Build \& Lead the Team: Recruit, mentor, and develop a world\-class global team of technical enablement managers and instructional designers. Foster a high\-performance culture aligned with Cloudera's strategic growth. * Budget \& Resource Management: Own the global budget for technical enablement, including software vendor management (LMS, lab environments) and external content partnerships. Ensure maximum ROI on enablement spend. ### **Executive Stakeholder \& Strategy Realization** * Sales Alignment: Partner directly with the VPs and SVPs of Worldwide Sales, Solution Engineering, and Product Management to diagnose global skill gaps, align on corporate KPIs, and deploy targeted enablement interventions. * Product\-to\-Field Pipeline: Serve as the executive bridge to Product Engineering. Ensure your team transforms roadmap features into comprehensive, "Value\-Based Technical Demo" frameworks that articulate how Cloudera beats the competition at an architectural level. ### **Governance \& Competency Frameworks** * Global Certification Ownership: Design, govern, and scale a sophisticated, role\-based technical competency matrix. Own the global "Certification" strategy that validates the field’s ability to execute high\-stakes technical validations (PoCs) and architectural designs. * Onboarding \& Time\-to\-Value: Standardize and evolve the "First 90 Days" technical journey globally. Move beyond completion metrics to directly impact executive KPIs: Time\-to\-First\-Deal and Technical Proficiency Benchmarks. ### **Enablement Innovation** * Tech Stack \& AI Transformation: Champion and fund next\-generation learning modalities. Drive the adoption of AI\-driven coaching tools, automated advanced lab environments, and "just\-in\-time" enablement triggers tied to CRM data. **Qualifications \& Experience** -------------------------------- * Experience: 12\+ years of experience in Technical Sales, Sales Engineering, or Technical Enablement within the Big Data, Cloud, or SaaS space, with at least 5\+ years of direct people management experience leading global, multi\-tiered teams. * Leadership Track Record: Proven success leading enablement or technical pre\-sales organizations through massive corporate transformations (e.g., shifting a global field team from legacy on\-premise to Hybrid Cloud/SaaS selling models). * Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of influencing, challenging, and collaborating with C\-suite stakeholders, VPs, and external partners. * Deep Technical Fluency: Ability to "speak engineer" and command respect from highly technical teams. Strong conceptual understanding of data lifecycles, Kubernetes, Cloudera/Hadoop ecosystems, and hyperscale cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP). * Data\-Driven Revenue Mapping: Expert ability to correlate enablement investments with hard revenue outcomes (e.g., Win Rates, Deal Cycle compression, ACV growth). **Preferred Requirements** -------------------------- * Education: MBA or a Master’s degree in a technical or business discipline preferred. * Tech Stack Governance: Experience architecting and managing an enterprise enablement stack at scale (e.g., Mindtickle, Highspot, Salesforce, Tableau, PowerBI). * Architectural Certification: Active or historical high\-level certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, GCP Professional Data Engineer, or similar). **What you can expect from us:** * Generous PTO Policy * Support work life balance with Unplugged Days * Flexible WFH Policy * Mental \& Physical Wellness programs * Phone and Internet Reimbursement program * Access to Continued Career Development * Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages * Paid Volunteer Time * Employee Resource Groups EEO/VEVRAA \#LI\-CH1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **AI Architect** We are seeking an AI Architect to embed with our largest, most complex enterprise clients and lead the deployment of cutting\-edge Salesforce Agentforce solutions. This high\-impact role combines deep hands\-on AI systems engineering, enterprise platform architecture, and high\-visibility client leadership. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and autonomous AI execution. You will "command the room" with C\-suite stakeholders, dive deep into code and data pipelines, and build scalable, production\-grade Agentforce architectures that deliver immediate, measurable business transformation. **Role Responsibilities:** * **Field Engineering \& Autonomous AI Execution** + Embed directly with client engineering and business leadership to rapidly prototype, architect, and deploy custom Agentforce autonomous agents, topics, actions, and guardrails. + Design and implement complex agent workflows utilizing Einstein 1 Platform, Data Cloud, and custom API actions (Apex, Flow, MuleSoft, and external REST endpoints). + Establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks (evals) to monitor agent accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and business performance in production. + Unblock critical deployment bottlenecks in real\-time, functioning as the high\-velocity engineering engine on $2M\+ strategic engagements. * **Enterprise Architecture \& Data Strategy** + Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for multi\-cloud, AI\-driven implementations, ensuring enterprise\-grade scalability, security, context grounding, and compliance. + Architect real\-time data pipelines using Salesforce Data 360 to power Agentforce context engines, unifying disparate data lakes (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) with CRM data. + Produce clear architectural artifacts, including system sequence diagrams, agent action flows, data schemas, and security/governance frameworks. + Evaluate emerging AI/LLM models, prompt engineering patterns, and Agentforce features to build reusable assets, agent templates, and internal accelerators. * **Strategic Client Leadership \& Practice Growth** + Serve as a trusted technical advisor to C\-suite, VP, and Enterprise Architecture stakeholders, framing complex AI paradigms into clear business outcomes. + Lead high\-stakes discovery sessions, live agent demonstrations, and architectural design reviews. + Partner with Delivery Leadership and Account Executives to scope, estimate, and technically validate high\-value Agentforce proposals. + Share field\-tested insights and deployment patterns with internal teams to help mature our Agentforce Center of Excellence. **Experience/Skills Required:** * Production AI \& Salesforce Experience: 6\+ years of solution architecture experience on the Salesforce platform, with explicit, hands\-on experience building and deploying Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, or advanced Data Cloud implementations. * Forward Deployed / Consulting Agility: 5\+ years in client\-facing technical consulting or FDE roles, with a proven track record of shipping production code and systems under tight timelines on $2M\+ accounts. * Hands\-on Development Skills: Strong proficiency in Apex, Flow, LWC, REST/SOAP APIs, and modern programmatic integration patterns required to trigger agent actions across external stacks. * Data \& Grounding Architectures: Deep understanding of Data Cloud, zero\-copy architecture, vector databases, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and enterprise data ingestion strategies. * AI Safety \& Governance: Demonstrated experience implementing agent guardrails, prompt defense, audit logging, and enterprise compliance frameworks. * Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex generative AI concepts, LLM mechanics, and agentic workflows for executive audiences. * Work Authorization \& Travel: Full\-time permanent US work authorization. Willing and able to travel 50%\+ to client sites as required for high\-velocity field engagements. * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Certifications:** * Salesforce: Salesforce Certified AI Specialist, Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect. * Data Platforms: Snowflake Certified Core/Advanced, Databricks Certified Data Engineer, or MuleSoft Integration Architect. * Enterprise Architecture \& Cloud: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or TOGAF. **Why Coastal, and what we offer:** * Flexible working hours with an emphasis on a life\-work balance (in that order!) * Remote friendly; plus company office locations in Palm Coast, FL; Atlanta, GA; Tysons, VA \& Lexington, KY * Unlimited Paid Time Off (RTO), 401K with Company Match, and Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage * Competitive quarterly bonus opportunities * Continuing education and certification reimbursements, specifically within the Salesforce and Snowflake ecosystems; plus occasional in\-house competitions with spot bonuses * A flexible and fun team culture! We value transparency, support, flexibility, growth, teamwork, fun, and so much more * Frequent team and culture activities, virtual \& in\-person, including Lunch and Learns, Happy Hours, team\-building events * Monthly All\-Hands calls to bring the company together, and an open\-door leadership policy with access to mentorship and guidance * Opportunities for accelerated growth, networking, and career guidance and support * Trust, transparency and respect across all levels of the company *Coastal provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

jobs.title: Director, Paid & Digital
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Marketing **We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us. **The Role** We're looking for a Director of Paid \& Digital to build and scale Cognition's paid demand engine. You'll own the strategy and execution behind how we use paid distribution to reach the engineers, technical leaders, and enterprise buyers shaping the future of software development. This goes well beyond managing ad platforms. You'll determine where Cognition should invest, which audiences we need to reach, what we should put in front of them, and how we turn that attention into qualified enterprise pipeline. You'll operate across established channels like paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and other social platforms, while continuously identifying new opportunities across technical publications, newsletters, communities, creators, sponsorships, and emerging channels. This is a highly hands\-on role. You'll build the strategy and execute it: launching campaigns, analyzing performance, developing audiences, reviewing search queries, testing creative, evaluating new channels, and deciding where the next dollar should go. **What You’ll Do** **Build Cognition's Paid Demand Engine** * Own Cognition's paid acquisition and distribution strategy with a focus on generating qualified enterprise pipeline. * Determine the right channel mix, investment strategy, audiences, offers, and campaign architecture as we scale. * Build a clear understanding of where our highest\-value audiences spend their time and how we can reach them. * Allocate budget dynamically based on performance and opportunity rather than fixed channel assumptions. * Build the systems, processes, and measurement framework required to scale paid investment significantly. * Partner with sales, operations, and sales enablement to ensure leads are qualified and are effectively worked. **Own Paid Media** * Own strategy and execution across paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Meta, X, and other relevant platforms. * Build sophisticated audience and account strategies around enterprise segments, personas, intent, and buying stage. * Capture high\-intent demand while creating demand among accounts that may not yet be actively searching. * Continuously optimize campaigns based on pipeline quality and downstream business outcomes—not just clicks, leads, or platform\-reported conversions. * Maintain deep expertise in the platforms and stay close enough to execution to identify opportunities others miss. **Expand Paid Distribution Beyond Traditional Advertising** * Identify and test new channels where technical and enterprise audiences spend attention. * Build partnerships across relevant newsletters, technical publications, developer and enterprise communities, podcasts, creators, influencers, and other emerging distribution channels. * Evaluate opportunities based on audience quality, enterprise relevance, scale potential, economics, and ability to test. * Build a repeatable process for finding, testing, measuring, and scaling new sources of demand. * Continuously challenge where Cognition should be spending its next dollar. **Build a High\-Velocity Experimentation Engine** * Run a continuous pipeline of experiments across **channel × audience × message × creative × offer × format × landing experience**. * Develop clear hypotheses and success criteria before launching tests. * Test fundamentally different approaches rather than only optimizing existing campaigns. * Quickly scale what works and shut down what doesn't. * Build a culture where experimentation velocity increases as the paid program grows. * Track investment impact throughout the sales journey. * Turn individual campaign learnings into insights that improve the broader Demand Gen strategy. **Build the Creative Testing System** * Develop a systematic approach to paid creative experimentation. * Identify which messages, narratives, customer proof, product capabilities, and formats resonate with different audiences. * Partner with Product Marketing and Design to maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative concepts. * Test across video, static, product\-led creative, customer proof, technical content, executive perspectives, and emerging form  than sending every campaign to the same conversion path. **Optimize for Enterprise Pipeline** * Measure success based on qualified enterprise pipeline and downstream business impact. * Partner with RevOps to understand performance from impression account engagement opportunity pipeline. * Understand performance by audience, account segment, channel, campaign, offer, and creative. * Develop clear frameworks for CAC, pipeline efficiency, marginal spend, and incrementality. * Use data to determine where Cognition should increase, decrease, or reallocate investment. **Work AI\-Natively** * Use AI aggressively across research, audience development, campaign creation, creative iteration, analysis, and optimization. * Build workflows that allow the paid program to operate with exceptional speed and leverage. * Experiment with emerging AI\-native advertising, discovery, and distribution channels as they develop. **What Success Looks Like** * Paid becomes a predictable and scalable source of qualified enterprise pipeline. * Cognition has a clear understanding of which channels, audiences, messages, offers, and creative combinations generate the highest\-quality opportunities. * We're consistently discovering and validating new distribution channels. * Experimentation velocity increases over time. * Creative is continuously refreshed based on real market feedback. * Budget can scale materially without sacrificing pipeline quality or efficiency. * We can confidently explain where the next incremental dollar should go—and why. * Paid insights are helping the broader marketing organization understand what resonates with the market. **You Should Be** * 8\+ years of experience in paid acquisition, growth marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, ideally in a high\-growth B2B technology company. * Experience managing and scaling significant paid media budgets. * Deep hands\-on expertise across major advertising platforms, particularly paid search and LinkedIn. * Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys and account\-based marketing. * Experience testing channels beyond traditional paid media. * Strong creative instincts and experience building systematic creative testing programs. * Exceptional analytical ability and comfort connecting media performance to pipeline and revenue. * Comfortable owning both **strategy and execution**. * Experience working closely with Product Marketing, Design, Web/Growth, RevOps, and Sales. * Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish meaningful business outcomes from attractive marketing metrics. * Highly hands\-on. You're comfortable opening an ad account, digging into campaign performance, writing a brief, evaluating a media opportunity, launching a test, and deciding what to do next. * Excited about AI and interested in using it to fundamentally change how performance marketing operates. **The Ideal Candidate** You're not looking to inherit a media plan and optimize it. You want to figure out where Cognition's next million dollars of efficient growth should come from. You're equally comfortable scaling a proven channel, killing an underperforming campaign, testing an unconventional distribution partner, developing a new offer, or digging into the data to understand why a campaign generated leads but no pipeline. You combine the analytical rigor of a performance marketer with the curiosity of a growth marketer and the commercial instincts of an enterprise demand generation leader. And you want to build, not just manage. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

The Senior Civil Engineer Supervisor (Transportation) with the Department of Transportation, District 6, guides complex engineering work that improves safety and supports major public projects. This role offers opportunities to solve challenges, work directly with railroads and utilities, and support many partners. Step into a position where your engineering skill strengthens vital transportation systems. **DESCRIPTION OF WORK** ----------------------- This position manages engineering work that connects roadway design, railroad operations, public utilities, and major transportation projects. It involves coordinating inspections, reviewing plans, guiding staff, overseeing agreements, and supporting safe and effective project delivery. As a Senior Civil Engineer Supervisor (Transportation), you will perform the following duties: * **Railroad Coordination:** Serve as liaison for railroad impacts to transportation projects and support reviews, communication, and required actions * **Project Oversight:** Manage utility designation projects, lead teams, monitor progress, and address risks and problems * **Engineering Inspection:** Inspect facilities and projects to check compliance with plans, detect deficiencies, and resolve issues * **PUC Representation:** Prepare data, attend hearings, and present the Department’s position for cases involving the Public Utility Commission * **Grade Crossing Work:** Supervise safety program tasks such as preparing plans, developing proposals, and coordinating crossing improvements * **Staff Supervision:** Lead and guide engineering staff, approve leave, assign work, and conduct performance evaluations **Work Schedule and Additional Information:** * Full\-time employment * Work hours are 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday \- Friday, with a 30\-minute lunch. * **Telework:** You may have the opportunity to work from home (telework) part\-time, up to 5 days per week. In order to telework, you must have a securely configured high\-speed internet connection and work from an approved location inside Pennsylvania. If you are unable to telework, you will have the option to report to the headquarters office in King of Prussia. The ability to telework is subject to change at any time. Additional details may be provided during the interview. * **Salary:**Selected candidates who are new to employment with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania will begin employment at the starting annual salary of $80,646 (before taxes). * You will receive further communication regarding this position via email. Check your email, including spam/junk folders, for these notices. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, TRAINING \& ELIGIBILITY** ------------------------------------------------ **QUALIFICATIONS** **Minimum Experience and Training Requirements:** * Six years of civil engineering experience in the appropriate specialty; and an Engineer\-in\-Training certificate issued by or acceptable to the Pennsylvania State Registration Board for Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors and Geologists; **or** * Five years of civil engineering experience in the appropriate specialty; and an Engineer\-in\-Training certificate issued by or acceptable to the Pennsylvania State Registration Board for Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors and Geologists; and an associate’s degree in civil engineering technology or a closely related engineering discipline; **or** * Two years of professional civil engineering experience in the appropriate specialty, and a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. **Special Requirements:** * This position requires possession of a valid driver’s license. **Other Requirements:** * PA residency requirement is currently **waived** for this title. * You must be able to perform essential job functions. **How to Apply:** * Resumes, cover letters, and similar documents will **not** be reviewed, and the information contained therein will not be considered for the purposes of determining your eligibility for the position. Information to support your eligibility for the position must be provided on the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). * If you are claiming education in your answers to the supplemental application questions, you must attach a copy of your college transcripts for your claim to be accepted toward meeting the minimum requirements. Unofficial transcripts are acceptable. * Your application must be submitted by the posting closing date*.* Late applications and other required materials will not be accepted. * **Failure to comply with the above application requirements may eliminate you from consideration for this position.** * All application materials and interview responses must reflect the applicant’s own experience, qualifications, and work. Applicants may use generative AI tools for preparation purposes only. Use of AI to misrepresent or falsify information, or to assist during interviews, is not permitted. Review the Guidance for Generative AI Tools \& Job Seekers for additional information. **Veterans:** * Pennsylvania law (51 Pa. C.S. §7103\) provides employment preference for qualified veterans for appointment to many state and local government jobs. To learn more about employment preferences for veterans, go to www.pa.gov/agencies/employment/how\-to\-apply.html and click on Veterans. **Telecommunications Relay Service (TRS):** * 711 (hearing and speech disabilities or other individuals). If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodations due to a disability, please discuss your request for accommodations with the interviewer in advance of your interview date. The Commonwealth is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse workforce. The Commonwealth values inclusion as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most qualified people to serve the citizens of Pennsylvania. The Commonwealth does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious creed, ancestry, union membership, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, AIDS or HIV status, disability, or any other categories protected by applicable federal or state law. All diverse candidates are encouraged to apply. **EXAMINATION INFORMATION** --------------------------- * Completing the application, including all supplemental questions, serves as your exam for this position. No additional exam is required at a test center (also referred to as a written exam). * Your score is based on the detailed information you provide on your application and in response to the supplemental questions. * Your score is valid for this specific posting only. * You must provide complete and accurate information or: + your score may be lower than deserved. + you may be disqualified. * You may only apply/test **once** for this posting. * Your results will be provided via email. Learn more about our Total Rewards by watching this short video! See the total value of your benefits package by exploring our benefits calculator. **Health \& Wellness** We offer multiple health plans so our employees can choose what works best for themselves and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package includes health coverage, vision, dental, and wellness programs.\* **Compensation \& Financial Planning** We invest in our employees by providing competitive wages and encouraging financial wellness by offering multiple ways to save money and ensure peace of mind including multiple retirement and investment plan options. **Work/Life Balance** We know there’s more to life than just work! Our generous paid leave benefits include paid vacation, paid sick leave, eight weeks of paid parental leave, military leave, and paid time off for most major U.S. holidays, as well as flexible work schedules and work\-from\-home opportunities.\* **Values and Culture** We believe in the work we do and provide continual opportunities for our employees to grow and contribute to the greater good. As one of the largest employers in the state, we provide opportunities for internal mobility, professional development, and the opportunity to give back by participating in workplace charitable giving. **Employee Perks** Sometimes, it is the little “extras” that make a big difference. Our employees receive special employee\-only discounts and rates on a variety of services and memberships. For more information on all of these Total Rewards benefits, please visit www.employment.pa.gov and click on the benefits box. * Eligibility rules apply.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Voice Agents
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** Health system call centers can't keep up with patient demand. 85% of patients who can't get through never call back. They go elsewhere, and appointments that should have been booked never are. We're building AI Voice Agents that pick up every call and handle the full conversation: scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, confirmations, FAQs, and intake. They work by integrating directly with the EHR and telephony stack in real time. We're hiring a Software Engineer to build the systems these agents run on: the voice pipelines, EHR integrations, and services that take a call from "hello" to a booked appointment. It's a mid\-level role on a small team that ships every day, with a lot of room to grow into harder problems. **This full\-time position requires working 5 days a week in our Mountain View, CA office.** **What You'll Do** * Design and build backend services in Python that power real\-time voice agents: call orchestration, conversation state, tool execution, and EHR write\-back. * Architect low\-latency pipelines connecting telephony, ASR, LLMs, and TTS into a single conversational loop. * Lead integrations with healthcare systems (like Epic, Cerner, athena, and others) for scheduling, eligibility, and intake. * Drive design decisions on APIs, data models, and event\-driven workflows, and mentor other engineers on the team. * Partner with AI, product, and operations to ship features patient access teams actually use. * Set the bar for what ships: latency, reliability, observability, and release readiness. **What You Have** * 4\+ years of backend software experience, primarily in Python. * A track record of designing and shipping production services, APIs, and data models that others build on. * An intuition for how people interact with automated assistants through voice and text, where the rules are different than icons and buttons. * Deep experience with async, event\-driven, or real\-time systems. * Strong fundamentals in testing, LLM evaluation, observability, and reliability. * A patient\-centered mindset. You design for the person on the other end of the line, not just the metrics. * Bias for action, an ownership mindset, and the judgment to know when to move fast and when to slow down. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $170K \- $230K

jobs.title: Engineer - Central Engineering, Relay Protection P&C Standards
jobs.description: **Mission Statement:** Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison), Orange \& Rockland Utilities (O\&R), and Consolidated Edison Transmission (CET) employees are required to follow health, safety, and environmental policies, EEO, Standards of Business Conduct, and all other applicable company policy and procedures. We all share a responsibility to advance the company’s mission by excelling at our three corporate priorities – safety of our people and the public, operational excellence in all that we do, and ensuring the best possible customer experience. **Benefits:** We are dedicated to supporting the physical, mental, and financial health of our employees and their families. This commitment extends beyond the workplace to foster personal growth and holistic wellbeing. Our life\-changing rewards package includes: * Rich medical \& pharmacy benefits, including vision benefits * Dental benefits * Health Savings Accounts * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) with robust matching * Employer paid Pension Plan * Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a generous matching contribution * State of the art Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Leave * Generous paid time off plus paid holidays * Family support: emergency backup child, \& elder care assistance * Social responsibility and volunteer opportunities * Employee discount program * Commuter Benefits * Culture of growth and learning: career development; tuition reimbursement; recognition program Life and Long\-Term Disability Benefits * \*Please be aware that some benefits may not apply to provisional or part\-time job titles. An opportunity to be part of our Protective Relay Strategy Implementation (PRSI) team, where multifold strategic initiatives in redesigning Con Edisons Protection and Control (P\&C) systems are taking place. You will be on the cutting edge of clean energy future and part of a collaborative culture where information is shared, and innovative ideas are welcome. Being part of PRSI team is an exciting opportunity to create futuristic P\&C design integrating technology and innovation for Con Edisons unique electric system. **Core Responsibilities*** Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop, test, implement, and maintain protection and control (P\&C) system standards, including philosophy documents, relay setting guides, templates, drawings, and test procedures. * Research industry best practices and emerging technologies to support continuous improvement of established P\&C standards. * Perform engineering analyses, evaluate new hardware and software solutions, and support the deployment of protection system upgrade initiatives. * Support PRSI department efforts by implementing new strategies, initiatives, and processes to enhance the design, operation, and reliability of P\&C systems. * Provide technical support to other PRSI functions, including protection system asset management and remote monitoring and analytics of substation P\&C devices. * Oversee vendor activities and perform technical reviews to ensure contractor work meets engineering standards and departmental requirements. * Maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders to implement relay protection standards, obtain feedback, and manage expectations. **Required Education/Experience*** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and 3 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of two years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. or **Preferred Education/Experience*** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering and 4 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of two years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. **Relevant Work Experience*** A minimum of two years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. * Computer proficiency to include Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), required. * Proficiency in using PSS/E CAPE, Aspen or equivalent fault study analysis tools, required. * Experience with various microprocessor relay platforms and software, required. * Ability to write engineering specifications and standards, preferred. **Skills and Abilities*** Demonstrated analytical skills * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Effective interpersonal skills * Develops and delivers effective presentations * Must be proficient in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint, etc. **Licenses and Certifications*** Driver's License Required **Physical Demands*** Sit or stand to use a keyboard, mouse, and computer for the duration of the workday * Stand to use/operate office equipment for the duration of the workday **Additional Physical Demands*** The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non\-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays. * Ability to travel throughout the company service territory and work at company locations as needed. * Ability to wear the required PPE as needed. * Ability to work in various indoor and outdoor conditions, and in all weather conditions. * Ability to work in power plants and high voltage substations. EEO Statement: Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison), Orange \& Rockland Utilities (O\&R), and Consolidated Edison Transmission (CET) are equal opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of the individual’s actual or perceived disability, protected veteran status, race, color, creed, religion, sex, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, domestic violence victim status, or any other actual or perceived status protected by law. Technical Difficulty Statement: For technical issues, please contact us at careerconnect@coned.com

jobs.description: **Mission Statement:** Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison), Orange \& Rockland Utilities (O\&R), and Consolidated Edison Transmission (CET) employees are required to follow health, safety, and environmental policies, EEO, Standards of Business Conduct, and all other applicable company policy and procedures. We all share a responsibility to advance the company’s mission by excelling at our three corporate priorities – safety of our people and the public, operational excellence in all that we do, and ensuring the best possible customer experience. **Benefits:** We are dedicated to supporting the physical, mental, and financial health of our employees and their families. The Senior Engineer will support Con Edisons Protective Relay Strategy Implementation (PRSI) team, contributing to strategic initiatives focused on modernizing and standardizing Protection and Control (P\&C) systems. This role is responsible for developing forward looking relay protection designs that integrate advanced technologies to enhance system reliability, resiliency, and support the clean energy transition. The position works closely with crossfunctional stakeholders in a collaborative environment that promotes technical excellence, innovation, and knowledge sharing across Con Edisons unique electric system. This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan. **Core Responsibilities*** Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop, test, implement, and maintain Protection and Control (P\&C) standards, including philosophy documents, setting guidelines, calculation templates, configuration files, drawings, procedures, and training on standards. * Research industry best practices and emerging technologies to continuously improve and modernize relay protection and controls standards. * Perform engineering analyses and evaluations to assess new hardware and software solutions and support the deployment of protection system upgrade programs. * Support the Protective Relay Strategy Implementation (PRSI) team in executing new strategies, initiatives, and processes that enhance the design, operation, and reliability of P\&C systems. * Manage and oversee vendor and contractor technical performance, including review of designs, deliverables, and field implementations. * Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to implement relay protection standards, gather feedback, and manage expectations across organizations. * Perform technical reviews of relay protection scopes and designs to ensure alignment with approved standards and system requirements. * Apply technical and analytical skills to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex relay protection issues, recommending effective engineering solutions. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Engineers and Associate Engineers within the group. * Deliver technical and safetyrelated presentations to engineering teams, management, and executive leadership as required. **Required Education/Experience*** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and 8 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. or * Master's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and 6 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. **Relevant Work Experience*** A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. * Excellent communication skills, the ability to champion change, and the capacity to influence others to improve management processes, required. * Proficient in computer applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, required. * Experience with microprocessor relay platforms and related configuration software, required. * Working knowledge of IEC61850, preferred. * Industry involvement with EPRI, NATF and other organizations on relay applications, preferred. **Licenses and Certifications*** Driver's License Required **Physical Demands*** Sit or stand to use a keyboard, mouse, and computer for the duration of the workday * Stand to use/operate office equipment for the duration of the workday **Additional Physical Demands*** The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non\-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays. * Ability to travel throughout the company service territory and work at company locations as needed. * Ability to wear the required PPE as needed. * Ability to work in various indoor and outdoor conditions, and in all weather conditions. * Ability to work in power plants and high voltage substations. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Water Structures
jobs.description: *What Your Day Will Look Like:* : As a Senior Structural Engineer focused on water infrastructure, you will lead the planning, analysis, and design of critical water and wastewater facilities, including treatment plants, pump stations, reservoirs, elevated tanks, intake structures, and other hydraulic infrastructure. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and regulatory agencies, you will develop innovative, resilient solutions that support essential community services and long\-term system reliability. Your day will involve performing structural analyses, developing design calculations, preparing construction documents, and conducting technical reviews to ensure compliance with industry standards and client requirements. You will provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guide project deliverables through all phases of design, and support business development efforts through client engagement and proposal development. You will also participate in site visits, condition assessments, and construction support activities, helping resolve field issues and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Balancing technical excellence with project execution, you will play a key role in delivering sustainable water infrastructure projects that have a lasting impact on the communities we serve. **Projected Compensation:** $160,000 \- $200,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. Compensation above this range may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the minimum requirements. *What You'll Do:* : * Lead the structural design and analysis of water and wastewater infrastructure, including treatment facilities, pump stations, reservoirs, tanks, and hydraulic structures. * Serve as the technical lead on multidisciplinary projects, ensuring designs meet client requirements, applicable codes, and industry standards. * Develop structural calculations, specifications, reports, and construction documents for projects ranging from rehabilitation efforts to new facility expansions. * Perform condition assessments and structural evaluations of existing water infrastructure to identify deficiencies and recommend practical solutions. * Collaborate with civil, mechanical, electrical, process, and geotechnical engineers to deliver integrated and efficient project designs. * Review and seal engineering jobs.title: Backend Engineer: Retail Media
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- EMEA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About Us** ------------ Constructor is the next\-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in\-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager: Recall
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- EMEA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- ProductProduct Management **About Us** ------------ Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. **Job Summary** --------------- We’re looking for a highly technical, systems\-minded **Senior Product Manager** to lead two critical search intelligence teams: **Machine Learning \& Recall** and **Query**. Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval. In this role, you will bridge the **Query** team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the **Machine Learning \& Recall** team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state\-of\-the\-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM\-assisted query interpretation, with low\-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search\-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Set a unified roadmap:** Define the multi\-quarter vision and strategy across both the **Machine Learning \& Recall** and **Query** teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand\-in\-hand. * **Drive Query intelligence:** Lead the **Query** team to push boundaries in tokenization, spell correction, entity extraction, intent classification, and LLM\-assisted query parsing across multiple languages. * **Advance Recall systems:** Lead the **Machine Learning \& Recall** team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models. * **Move core business metrics:** Own measurable lift in search\-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals. * **Turn research into production wins:** Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low\-latency, cost\-effective production systems. * **Balance ML performance trade\-offs:** Make data\-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real\-time execution constraints. * **Build evaluation frameworks:** Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes. * **Orchestrate pipeline handoffs:** Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss. * **Solve systemic issues:** Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one\-off patches. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within your first year, you will have: * Evolved our hybrid recall framework to measurably improve candidate generation precision for long\-tail queries and complex catalog structures. * Driven quantifiable lift in search\-attributed conversion and revenue per visit across major customer verticals. * Stood up an integrated evaluation framework connecting query parsing and candidate recall directly to business outcomes. * Optimized inference latency and compute infrastructure to ensure high\-capacity ML models run fast and cost\-effectively in production. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited vacation time \- we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year. * A competitive compensation package including stock options. * Company\-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee). * Fully remote team \- choose where you live. * Work\-from\-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office. * Apple laptops provided for new employees. * Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year. * Parental leave for qualified employees. * Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact. ### **This position is fully remote —** **Constructor.io** **is a remote\-first company.** **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** --------------------------------------------------- At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. jobs.title: Gaming Designer
jobs.description: About the Role: Culmen International is seeking a Gaming Designer. This position involves designing and developing serious games, simulation\-supported activities, and interactive exercise experiences for public health and medical preparedness, response, recovery, and continuity missions. The position transforms exercise objectives, operational plans, threat information, and subject\-matter expertise into realistic game mechanics, scenarios, participant decisions, and multimedia products that enable readiness and improve performance. jobs.title: Data Developer & Engineer
jobs.description: **The Cystic Fibrosis Foundation** is a leading healthcare nonprofit organization like no other. For decades, we have been taking major steps and pioneering new ways to advance the mission to find a cure for cystic fibrosis and to provide all people with CF the opportunity to lead long, fulfilling lives by funding research and drug development, partnering with the CF community, and advancing high\-quality, specialized care. **By joining the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation** , you will be part of a dedicated team committed to our core values and working towards a cure for cystic fibrosis. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of those affected by CF. Learn more about why work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation . **Position Summary:** The Cystic Fibrosis Foundation is seeking a talented Database Developer \& Engineer to design, develop, and support data solutions that power business operations, reporting, and analytics across the organization. In this role, you will work with stakeholders, application teams, and Enterprise IT to build scalable database solutions, develop complex SQL queries, and create meaningful reporting and dashboard experiences that support informed decision\-making. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges, working with large datasets, and turning information into actionable insights, we'd love to hear from you. This is a hybrid role based in Bethesda, MD, and requires 2\-3 days per week in the Bethesda office. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Apply database development principles, concepts, and best practices to support operational, application, reporting, and analytical needs. * Design, develop, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, database structures, and other database objects. * Understand and work with logical and physical data models, relational database structures, schemas, and data relationships. * Analyze business and application requirements and translate them into effective database, reporting, and analytical solutions. * Extract, transform, analyze, and combine data across multiple tables and data sources to transform raw data into meaningful information that supports operational and decision\-making needs. * Analyze and resolve data quality, integrity, and reconciliation issues, ensuring accuracy and consistency across source systems, databases, applications, and reporting outputs. * Develop and support database components, reporting datasets, data models, Power BI reports, dashboards, and other analytical products, including data preparation, calculations, filtering, and output validation. * Develop and maintain data integration and ETL processes as needed to support data movement between operational systems, databases, reporting platforms, and analytical applications. * Collaborate with application developers, application owners, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand complex data requirements, integrate database solutions with applications, and recommend appropriate solutions. * Perform peer code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization to ensure database solutions meet established quality, reliability, maintainability, and performance standards. * Partner with Enterprise IT on database administration, infrastructure, enterprise ETL/data engineering, deployment, security, and platform\-related activities. * Ensure the security and confidentiality of data and apply established development, documentation, and Agile practices as appropriate. * Maintain an understanding of and comply with applicable HIPAA requirements, relevant FDA regulations, organizational policies, and data privacy and security standards. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * Approximately 3–5 years of experience in database development, data development, data analysis, or a related role. * Strong SQL development skills, including experience developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and other database objects. * Strong understanding of relational databases, database design, data modeling, and data processing concepts and methodologies. * Experience analyzing large or complex datasets, transforming data into meaningful information, and performing data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting of data discrepancies. * Experience developing database and data solutions that support business applications, reporting, analytics, migrations, and data conversions. * Working knowledge of ETL and data integration concepts, tools, and techniques, along with an understanding of DevOps and IT controls related to database development and deployment. * Experience developing and supporting reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using Microsoft Power BI or similar business intelligence/reporting tools, including translating business requirements into meaningful analytical outputs and visualizations. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently understand business requirements, translate them into appropriate technical and data solutions, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and learn new technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and data concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences and collaborate effectively with application development teams, business stakeholders, and Enterprise IT. **REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:** * Reports to the Director of the Patient Registry **WORKING CONDITIONS:** * Normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, and temperature. * No heavy lifting required. * Minimal travel (e.g., 4x/yr.) to conferences and meetings, as necessary. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 days or until the position is filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, so candidates are encouraged to apply promptly if interested. The salary range is $94,200\.00 to $117,600\.00\. Specific salary varies based on geographic location and is commensurate with experience. **Total Rewards:** The CF Foundation is committed to offering competitive compensation (base pay and incentive), benefits, time off and professional development opportunities that maximize our ability to recruit, retain, reward, and motivate a highly qualified and diverse workforce. Visit our Why Work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation for detailed total rewards information. The CF Foundation is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to being an employer of choice, not just a good place to work, but a great and inclusive place to work. We strive to recruit and maintain a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, physical or mental disability, color, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, sex, pregnancy, marital status, genetic information or testing, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation or status as a Vietnam\-era or special disabled veteran or any characteristic protected by law. Reasonable Accommodations: The CF Foundation is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at HROps@cff.org. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Inspector, Cranes and Derricks
jobs.description: **Inspector, Cranes and Derricks** ================================== * DEPARTMENT OF BUILDINGS Posted on 09/24/2026 * Full\-time Location NYC\-ALL BOROS * Exam may be required Department Cranes \& Derricks Salary range: $62,244\.00 – $86,347\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The NYC Department of Buildings is responsible for ensuring the safe and lawful use of buildings and properties by enforcing the NYC Construction Codes, Energy Code and Zoning Resolution. We facilitate compliant development with integrity, efficiency and professionalism. We are committed to becoming a premier municipal building organization, dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for all New Yorkers and making our city safer. We are committed to improving our performance and developing procedures that are streamlined, understandable and transparent. This position performs work in the inspection of the condition and safety of cranes, machinery and equipment used in hoisting and rigging for conformity with NYC Construction Codes, Department rules, other pertinent laws and rules, and approved plans and specifications. Additional Information: Some of the physical activities performed by Inspectors (Hoists and Rigging) and environmental conditions experienced are: Walking to and from inspection sites, and during the course of inspections, climbing and descending ladders and stairs to get to areas of inspection; standing on scaffolds to inspect work; standing for extended periods of time; working in confined areas; wearing hard hats; bending and stooping during inspections; climbing over and around various objects; walking in areas that may be damp, dark, dusty, smoky or acrid; and working outdoors in all kinds of weather. Inspectors (Hoists and Rigging) may be required to work various shifts including nights, Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays. Candidates must pass a drug screening in order to be appointed. At the time of appointment to this position, you must have a motor vehicle driver license valid in the State of New York. If you have moving violations, license suspension or an accident record, you may be disqualified. This license must be maintained for the duration of your employment. At the time of appointment, all candidates residing in New York City must apply to receive Special Patrolman Status. To Apply: Visit Jobs NYC (cityjobs.nyc.gov) to view and apply for available positions. Search by agency (Department of Buildings), keywords, or for the specific Job ID \#. NOTE: ONLY THOSE CANDIDATES UNDER CONSIDERATION WILL BE CONTACTED. INSPECTOR (HOISTS AND RIGGING) \- 31627 **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- 1\. Five years of full\-time satisfactory experience in one or a combination of the following: as a rigger handling gear and equipment in the hoisting and rigging business; as an inspector of hoists and rigging; as a licensed crane operator; as a crane mechanic; or as an engineer in the design of plans and specifications for cranes, engineering investigations of crane incidents, and/or field assessments of stability and safety of cranes; or 2\. Three years of experience as described in “1” above, and sixty (60\) credits towards a degree in civil or mechanical engineering from an accredited college or university; or 3\. Completion of an apprentice program, a minimum of three years in length, in the hoists and rigging trade or hoists and rigging inspection and one of the following: (a) Two years of experience as described in “1” above; or (b) 60 credits as described in “3” above; or 4\. A license as a professional engineer issued pursuant to the New York State Education Law. 5\. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to “1,” “2,” or “3” above. 6\. To be eligible for placement to Assignment Level II, individuals other than licensed professional engineers must have, after meeting the minimum requirements, at least one additional year of experience as described in “1” above. 7\. To be eligible for placement to Assignment Level III, individuals other than licensed professional engineers must have, after meeting the requirements for Assignment Level II above, at least one year of experience as described in “1” above in a supervisory capacity. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Experience must be with cranes Working knowledge of the NYC Construction Codes Computer literacy **55a Program** --------------- This position is also open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55\-a Program. Please indicate at the top of your resume and cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position through the 55\-a Program. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** ----------------------------------- As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/. **Residency Requirement** ------------------------- New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview. **Additional Information** -------------------------- The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy. Apply Save Job ID 802042 Posted until 10/30/2026 Title code 31627 Civil service title INSPECTOR (HOISTS AND RIGGING) Title classification Competitive\-1 Business title Inspector, Cranes and Derricks * Experience level: Experienced (non\-manager) Job level 01 Number of positions 1 Work location 280 Broadway, 4th Floor, N.Y. * Category: Public Safety, Inspections, \& Enforcement Inspector, Cranes and Derricks

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Build something that matters. At Delta Star the work we do has a real impact. Every transformer we build helps deliver reliable electricity to homes, businesses, and communities across North America. As we continue to grow, we are looking for people who want more than just a job. We are looking for individuals who want to learn, contribute, solve challenges, and build a meaningful career alongside a team that is committed to delivering power at all times. Summary Delta Star Inc. is seeking a talented and detail\-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to provide engineering leadership and design support for the mechanical components of medium voltage, mobile power transformers, and mobile substations. If you’re passionate about safety, quality, and delivering innovative solutions that meet customer expectations, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, verifying, and supporting the mechanical aspects of transformer production. From generating 3D designs to creating shop drawings and ensuring design accuracy, you’ll contribute to delivering high\-quality transformers that align with industry standards and customer requirements. A Day in the Life As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you’ll create 3D core and coil designs using our engineering automation platform (EAP), verifying them against Delta Star standards and technical decisions. You’ll generate internal shop drawings, develop internal connection diagrams, and design woodwork structures and lead routing using Autodesk Inventor. Your work will also include generating material usage files for ERP system integration and providing production support by resolving issues and offering technical guidance. Over time, you’ll expand your role to include external transformer designs and tank drawings, along with plasma and wood routing machine programming.
