jobs.title: Product Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description: The Product Technical Support Specialist provides technical phone support to Customers, Third\-party Service Providers, and the Field Service team (customers) for issues that require in\-depth technical knowledge and/or access to the company’s engineering documentation and knowledge base. This role drives complete resolution to field based product issues. As a product expert with significant problem identification knowledge and product expertise, this role is expected to assess and address all incoming issues and as required, collaborate with other internal stakeholders where appropriate. As required the Specialist will review and correct electrical schematics issued by engineering prior to and after product build and installation. The Specialist leverages their expert experience with the products, in\-depth understanding of the products installation, operation, and application, and troubleshooting experience to resolve issues quickly. Inquiries may include troubleshooting, repair, and corrective maintenance advice related to controls, electrical, mechanical, piping, and electronics issues. Specialists must manage the customer to de\-escalate the situation while resolving the issue(s) or ensure a smooth hand off to other internal stakeholders. They will be accountable to address through resolution, critical customer issues and notify/inform supervision appropriately as issues need escalation. The Specialist manages customer relationships to boost customer retention and satisfaction while working closely with various internal departments to optimize service operations and uphold our commitment to customer satisfaction. This role may require work after normal business hours and weekends on occasion. #### **KEY DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES** * Being the first line of support and contact for customers with parts, service, or technical issues. a. Responds to customer inquiries, resolves issues, and escalates complex problems to the appropriate personnel. b. Troubleshoots equipment that is not functioning or not functioning as expected or built. c. Effectively provides customers with technical assistance with the proper operation and maintenance of the installed equipment. * Assists in resolving scheduling conflicts or emergencies that may arise during ThirdParty Service Provider service calls. * Assists the Douglas Field Service Technicians. a. Provides troubleshooting input to resolve issues with commissioning new machines and repairing existing machines b. Works closely with the Field Service Installation Coordinator to ensure necessary parts support is provided both before the engineer is dispatched and while they are onsite. * Proactively handles inbound calls, emails, and texts/chat to provide product technical support to customers and makes outbound calls, emails, and texts/chat in response to inquiries in a timely manner. * Utilizes business systems, MS Office software, and webbased software as required to provide quotes, place parts and service orders, advise of leadtimes, tracking information, and place order corrections. * Utilizes the SalesForce customer relationship management (CRM) system to document tech assist actions, assisting in maintaining equipment history. * Provides customers with technical drawings, parts lists, and manuals for customer specific machines a. Reviews and updates electrical schematics prior to and after product build and installation using AutoCAD. b. Reviews and provides inputs for machine technical manuals c. Creates and provides customers with spare parts lists by customer specific machines. d. Provides the customer with other documentation as required. * Works closely with departmental peers and utilizes skills obtained, documentation, and various methods to perform their role in delivering effective and efficient customer service. * On occasion assists in machine testing and factory acceptance tests (FAT). * Assist less experienced departmental Customer Service Representatives, as necessary. * Fosters clear communication between the various internal company departments (i.e., Engineering, Application Engineering, Procurement, Sales, Production, and Management). * Identifies areas for improvement and communicates them to supervision for review and implementation. * Maintains and prepares reports as requested by supervision. * Alerts supervisor when there is an absence of information or tools for completing their key responsibilities. #### **QUALIFICATIONS and TRAINING** * A high school/trade school diploma and a minimum of 4 years’ experience working on commercial or industrial equipment in the Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) facility or in the field and a minimum of 3 years’ experience relative to troubleshooting electrical control systems, conveying systems, and fluid flow systems. Industrial ware washing equipment experience is a plus. * An associate degree in mechatronics/mechanical engineering technology/electrical engineering technology is a plus * Understanding the theories of combustion, heat transfer, fluid distribution, hydraulic, pneumatic, conveyance, process controls, and electrical systems are required. * Ability to read engineering documents, including mechanical and electrical prints/schematics. * Experience with project management is a plus. * The ability to utilize AutoCAD to modify electrical diagrams/ schematics is a plus. * Ability to instruct customers to troubleshoot and diagnose problems with malfunctioning equipment using proper tools and testing apparatus. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. * Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and multitasking abilities. * Ability to work in a fastpaced environment and adapt to changing priorities. * Customerfocused with a commitment to providing excellent service. * Ability to be reliable, responsible, dependable, and fulfill obligations. * Ability to remain calm and make quick, informed decisions in highpressure situations. * Knowledge of the commercial or industrial equipment industry and service offerings is a plus. * Proficiency in Microsoft Suite Applications (Word \& Excel), as well as Internet software and Email, is required. * Proficiency in AutoCAD is a plus. * The employee is occasionally required to lift 50 pounds. * This position may require periodic travel (up to 25% of the time). * This position is not a fulltime remote position.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Database
jobs.description: **About DraftKings** -------------------- At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. ### **The Crown Is Yours** As a Senior Lead Reliability Engineer, Database, you'll own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the database infrastructure powering one of the most demanding real time platforms in sports betting and gaming. In this role, you'll combine deep database expertise with software engineering and infrastructure automation to build resilient, self healing systems, improve platform performance, and drive reliability across cloud and on premises database environments. ### **What You'll Do** * Drive the technical roadmap for database reliability across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, ScyllaDB, Aerospike, and managed cloud services, while shaping architecture for high availability, replication, partitioning, storage, and connection management. * Design and build automation first database platforms by developing Kubernetes operators, infrastructure as code, GitOps workflows, and production quality tooling in Go or Python to automate provisioning, failover, backups, schema migrations, and lifecycle management. * Lead operational excellence by defining service level objectives, monitoring database health, capacity, and performance, eliminating recurring reliability issues, validating backup and recovery processes, and leading critical production incidents through resolution and continuous improvement. * Optimize database performance and cost across cloud and on premises environments by driving capacity planning, resource efficiency, storage optimization, workload consolidation, and performance tuning for large scale systems. * Partner closely with application engineering teams to establish safe database practices, including schema reviews, migration strategies, query optimization, connection management, and zero downtime deployment processes. * Leverage AI to improve engineering productivity and database operations through intelligent observability, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, documentation, predictive insights, and evaluation of AI generated code to ensure reliability and security. * Mentor engineers across the organization by sharing best practices, leading design and code reviews, influencing technical direction, supporting hiring efforts, and raising the overall maturity of database reliability engineering. ### **What You'll Bring** * At least 6 years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering with a strong database focus, including technical leadership experience delivering complex database infrastructure projects at scale. * Deep expertise in at least one major relational database, preferably PostgreSQL, along with operational experience supporting technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, ScyllaDB, Aerospike, Aurora, Cloud SQL, and other managed cloud database services. * Strong experience building and operating stateful workloads on Kubernetes using technologies such as StatefulSets, Persistent Volumes, database operators, Terraform, Pulumi, FluxCD, ArgoCD, GKE, and EKS. * Hands on software development experience using Go or Python to create automation, platform tooling, Kubernetes controllers, APIs, and infrastructure that reduces manual effort and improves engineering efficiency. * A data driven, automation first mindset with proven experience improving reliability through observability, monitoring, service level objectives, capacity planning, performance optimization, and self service engineering solutions. * Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, MCP, or similar technologies to improve design, coding, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows while applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI generated outputs. * Excellent leadership and communication skills with a track record of mentoring engineers, influencing architectural decisions, collaborating across engineering teams, producing clear technical documentation, and driving continuous improvement in highly available production environments. ### **Join Our Team** We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.** We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **Summary** =========== As Dust’s first dedicated US Customer Success leader, you will build the post\-sales motion for one of our most important growth markets. You will begin as a player\-coach: personally owning a focused portfolio of strategic customers, leading the coordination of CSMs, Deployment Strategists, and Solutions Engineers, and partnering closely with Sales and Product to drive adoption, retention, and expansion. You will start close to the customer and close to the work, building conviction about what great post\-sales looks like at Dust. You will then turn those learnings into the operating rhythms, segmentation, playbooks, and team needed to scale. This is an opportunity to define how Customer Success works at a fast\-growing, AI\-native company, not simply inherit an existing process. **What you'll do** ================== **Own the US customer\-success motion** --------------------------------------- * Define and lead the Customer Success approach for Dust’s US customers. * Establish how we segment customers and determine the right level of engagement for each account. * Coordinate CSMs, Deployment Strategists, Solutions Engineers, and other post\-sales partners around shared customer outcomes. * Create the operating rhythms that keep the team aligned on adoption, customer health, renewals, escalations, and expansion. * Make clear prioritization and resourcing decisions as customer needs evolve. **Personally own strategic customers** -------------------------------------- * Manage a focused portfolio of strategic and high\-complexity accounts. * Build trusted relationships with users, champions, technical stakeholders, and executive sponsors. * Lead customers from deployment through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. * Develop clear success plans tied to the customer’s business priorities and measurable outcomes. * Serve as the senior escalation point for high\-stakes customer situations. * Bring firsthand customer context into decisions about product, process, and team priorities. **Build the US post\-sales playbook** ------------------------------------- * Define what great post\-sales delivery looks like across the customer lifecycle. * Improve the transition from Sales to Customer Success, including handoff quality, stakeholder mapping, use\-case definition, and success criteria. * Identify patterns across accounts and turn what works into repeatable playbooks. * Create practical approaches to customer health, risk management, executive engagement, adoption, and expansion. * Use Dust and other AI tools to increase the leverage of the Customer Success team. **Develop the team** -------------------- * Coach CSMs and Deployment Strategists to raise the quality of customer work across the board * Help define the roles, capabilities, and hiring plan required for the next stage of the US post\-sales organization. * Evolve from execution\-heavy to strategy\-heavy as the team grows building an organization that can operate independently * Create an environment where people develop faster than they would anywhere else **Partner cross\-functionally with Sales and Product** ------------------------------------------------------ * Work closely with AEs to align pre\- and post\-sales motions and unlock expansion opportunities * Represent the voice of the US customer internally with clarity and conviction * Surface recurring customer needs and product gaps, and help Product prioritize them. * Contribute to how Dust thinks about customer value, retention, and growth at a company level. **Requirements** ---------------- Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. **Aptitude** ------------ * **Has been an excellent Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Post\-Sales Leader**, with strong judgment across account strategy, executive communication, discovery, value articulation, adoption planning, stakeholder management, renewal strategy, and expansion. * **Has owned strategic B e with technical products and complex customer environments,** and can translate between business priorities, product capabilities, and operational execution. * **Uses AI tools actively in their own work** and can identify practical ways to create leverage across the Customer Success motion. **Attitude** ------------ * **Treats customer outcomes as the north star,** not activity metrics, and builds trust through preparation, clarity, follow\-through, and honest communication. * **Surfaces risks and difficult information early,** and collaborates naturally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams around shared customer outcomes. * **Is comfortable operating in a fluid, cross\-functional environment** where titles do not determine contribution. * **Develops the people around them** through coaching, direct feedback, and example, while maintaining high standards in a rapidly evolving company. **Agency** ---------- * **Is willing to stay close to the work,** personally own strategic accounts, and engage directly in complex customer situations. * **Can define and build the US post\-sales model without waiting for a complete blueprint,** turning customer patterns into repeatable processes and playbooks. * **Makes prioritization and resourcing decisions autonomously,** balancing customer urgency, strategic value, commercial importance, and team capacity. * **Finds ways to create customer outcomes** with limited resources and imperfect information, and treats the player\-coach phase as an opportunity to build conviction and organizational leverage. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation: $260,000–$340,000 OTE * Significant equity package in a Sequoia\-backed startup * Health insurance for you and your dependents * New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc. * Beautiful office in the heart of SoHo (NYC) * Opportunity to travel to Paris multiple times a year * Regular team events and offsites **Location** ============ We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. **Why Dust** ============ The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. *Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.* **Learn how we think and work.** * Our product constitution, *a story about our mission* * Agents at work \- Latent Space, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024 * LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time \- dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024 Compensation Range: $260K \- $340K

jobs.title: MRO Purchasing Manager
jobs.description: **1\.0 POSITION DESCRIPTION** The **MRO Purchasing Manager** is responsible for managing, optimizing, and driving value for MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations), technical spare parts, consumables, tooling, and contracted industrial services. (Freight and primary inbound/outbound logistics are excluded from this role's scope). Combining strong commercial negotiation skills, financial acumen, and technical affinity, this role acts as a strategic bridge between procurement and internal technical teams (Engineering, Maintenance, Operations). The primary objective is to maintain a sustainable, competitive, and reliable supplier base, systematically challenge internal demand and specifications to eliminate waste, and implement an automated consumable inventory replenishment system that maximizes parts availability while minimizing safety stock and holding costs. **2\.0 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Strategic Sourcing \& Supplier Relationship Management** * Nurture, evaluate, and entertain a sustainable, commercially aligned supplier network capable of meeting quality, lead\-time, cost, and ESG requirements. * Lead supplier identification, RFP/RFQ processes, technical bid evaluations, and contract negotiations for MRO, consumables, and vendor services. * Conduct continuous market intelligence, commodity tracking, and cost structure benchmarking to identify cost reduction opportunities. * Monitor supplier performance via Service Level Agreements (SLAs), On\-Time In\-Full (OTIF) metrics, quality rejection rates, and quarterly vendor reviews. **Inventory Replenishment \& Stock Optimization** * Design, implement, and optimize a robust consumable and spare parts replenishment system (e.g., Min/Max, KanBan, VMI, ERP\-driven reorder points). * Drive optimal inventory turn rates, balance buffer stocks against lead\-time volatility, and guarantee key operational items maintain high availability. * Partner with warehouse and maintenance personnel to ensure accurate physical stock tagging, layout optimization, and bin location tracking. **Demand Challenge \& Technical Collaboration** * Act as a constructive commercial partner to engineering and plant maintenance, challenging requested technical specifications, single\-source dependencies, and consumption patterns. * Evaluate total cost of ownership (TCO) and drive standardization across plants to reduce SKU variety and aggregate purchasing power. * Investigate substitute materials, alternate technical components, and OEM equivalent parts without compromising quality or equipment warranties. **Commercial Operations \& Data Analysis** * Leverage ERP systems and data analytics (Excel) to perform detailed spend analysis, purchase trend forecasting, and budget variance tracking. * Manage the purchase order (PO) lifecycle: requisition processing, order placement, vendor confirmations, expediting critical parts, and resolving invoice discrepancies with Finance. * Maintain master procurement data integrity (item masters, pricing agreements, lead times, vendor safety stock) in the ERP platform. **3\.0 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** * **Cost Savings \& Value Creation:** Annual cost reduction/avoidance percentage against the spend baseline. * **Parts Availability \& OTIF:** On\-time, in\-full availability rate for critical spares and consumables to prevent plant downtime. * **Inventory Optimization:** Reduction in total inventory carrying costs while maintaining required service levels and inventory turns. * **Contract Coverage \& Supplier Performance:** Percentage of spend under formal contract and overall supplier performance evaluation score. **4\.0 QUALIFICATIONS \& COMPETENCIES** * **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field with 4\+ years of strategic procurement experience within an industrial, manufacturing, or technical environment. * **Commercial Acumen:** Strong contract law understanding, negotiation prowess, and financial analysis skills. * **Technical Affinity:** Capability to read technical documentation/drawings, understand mechanical/electrical components, and converse effectively with plant engineers and maintenance technicians. * **Data Proficiency:** Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, financial modeling) and hands\-on experience with modern ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite). * **Soft Skills:** Assertive communicator, constructive challenger, high accountability, and strong problem\-solving mindset. **5\.0 WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position is based in a corporate/manufacturing plant office environment and requires frequent presence on the shop floor, warehouse, and maintenance areas to collaborate with technicians, review inventory, and inspect technical components. Physical demands include regular plant floor walkthroughs, handling light technical parts, and occasional travel (less than 10%) to vendor facilities or sister sites. **6\.0 OTHER DUTIES** *Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.* Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Energy Analyst I
jobs.description: About Us: At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward\-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy\-as\-a\-Service sector. We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success. Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success. Overview: The Energy Analyst I is responsible for organizing and analyzing utility and supporting energy use data to assist with the review and evaluation of energy and cost efficiency opportunities. An Energy Analyst will frequently interact with clients, contractors, and engineers to fulfill the essential duties and responsibilities of the position. Responsibilities: * Energy Procurement and Analytics + Collect, compile, organize, and analyze utility consumption data and rates. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of utility supply\-side opportunities. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of utility procurement logistics. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of possible utility energy efficiency rebate and incentive programs. + Research utility rate changes and deregulated energy cost trends. + Conduct energy benchmarks using internal and external tools such as EPA Energy Star. + Review utility invoices for errors and work to resolve the errors with the utility. + Create utility budgets. * Energy Auditing + Assist with the collection, review, and analysis of data collected from field surveys and utility data. + Develop a thorough understanding of existing building and its MEP systems. + Assist with the identification and evaluation of improvements for energy or cost reductions. + Assist with the development of associated technical reports. * Measurement and Verification + Assist with the development and implementation IPVMP \- Adherent Measurement and Verification (M\&V) Plans. + Develop energy consumption baselines and adjustments through regression analysis and other appropriate methods. + Coordinate with clients, utility representatives, energy analysts, engineers, construction managers, and commission agents during all appropriate project stages to assist in the design and implementation of M\&V plans for continuous monitoring of energy and water performance. + Assist with the review of design documents, M\&E specifications, and shop drawings of applicable metering systems to confirm all M\&V requirements are met. + Assist with the verification of utility performance of facilities and validate savings. + Review and analyze energy performance including data collection, utility bill accounting, sub\-metering data analysis, and utility cost analysis. + Create, maintain, and distribute M\&V dashboards and reports through multiple software platforms. * Remote Monitoring + Assist with the collection and evaluation of energy, weather, and building automation data on some periodic basis. + Assist with the review of data and identification of facility operational issues affecting energy consumption, comfort, and/or code compliance. + Assist with the development of recommendations to address any identified operational issues. + Assist with the preparation of reports for project stakeholders summarizing all discoveries. * Energy Modeling + Assist with the development of engineering\-based energy models to simulate existing and proposed operations of buildings or systems. + Work collaboratively with team members to identify and evaluate scope of potential improvements. + Assist with the development of life cycle cost analyses and other engineering economic analyses. + Assist with the development of supporting documentation on engineering calculations, methodologies, etc. as required. * Other + Uphold the Company owner advocacy philosophy, mission, and core values. + Perform the assigned duties with minimal supervision, while working in a team problem\-solving environment. + Assist with the development of technical reports or related documents. Qualifications: #### **Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications** * 4\-year Engineering degree from an ABET\-accredited university * Thorough, organized, and with superb attention to detail. * Proficient with computers. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Detail\-oriented and willing to tackle various ongoing projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Versed in the industry and the Company’s competitors. * Ability to multitask and perform duties outside of the scope of work when necessary. #### **Preferred Education, Experience, and Qualifications** * N/A #### **Travel Requirements** * 10\-20% of time will be spent traveling to job site(s)/office location. #### **Physical Activities** * Climbing stairs. * Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods * Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers #### **Environmental Conditions** * Quiet environment #### **Physical Demands** * Light work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 20 pounds \#LI\-SB1 EEO Statement: ENFRA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Women, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities, and participates in the e\-Verify program. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Technology (Google)
jobs.description: We're looking for a **Business Development Director \- Technology (Google)** to join our team in the Bay Area. In this role, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding EPAM's footprint within the Google account. You will operate as a dedicated account\-based seller, leveraging a deep understanding of Google's business priorities, organizational structure and buying behaviors to identify, engage and grow strategic opportunities. You will position EPAM as a strategic transformation partner across key priorities such as digital transformation, customer experience, data and AI. This role requires a strong focus on account growth, building trusted executive relationships and expanding EPAM's presence across business units within the account through high\-value, consultative engagement. Req\# 1089342607 **Responsibilities** * Own account growth within the Google account, driving expansion across business units and new opportunity areas * Identify and convert whitespace opportunities across underpenetrated teams and business units within the account * Build and execute a strategic account penetration plan aligned to Google's priorities and organizational structure * Develop senior stakeholder relationships (Director, VP and C\-suite level) within the Google account * Leverage account insight and technology sector trends to shape compelling, relevant client propositions * Lead the full sales lifecycle from prospecting and qualification through to deal closure * Proactively generate pipeline through targeted account outreach, representing EPAM at relevant industry forums and networks to strengthen brand presence * Position EPAM's capabilities across digital transformation, data, cloud and AI in the context of Google's business needs * Collaborate with internal delivery and account teams to align solutions with Google's specific challenges * Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting and reporting **Requirements** * 10\-15 years of experience in IT sales / business development with a strong focus on named account or strategic account selling * Demonstrated track record of identifying and closing new business in organizations with $2B\+ in sales using a consultative and collaborative multi\-discipline team approach * Proven track record of growing revenue and expanding whitespace within large, complex named accounts * Prior experience selling IT services into Alphabet/Google or working directly within the organization * Strong understanding of the technology sector and Google's organizational structure, priorities and buying behaviors * Experience selling complex, multi\-service or consulting\-led engagements * Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from scratch and close net\-new opportunities within an existing account * Established network or experience engaging with senior stakeholders across large technology organizations * Experience engaging with C\-level stakeholders and navigating complex organizations * Bachelor's degree in business, technology or related field * Strong communication, negotiation and commercial acumen * Ability to operate independently in a high\-growth, target\-driven environment * Existing relationships or network within Google * Familiarity with cloud, AI/ML and data platforms relevant to Google's technology stack **We offer** * Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (Subsidized) * Health Savings Account * Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability (Company Provided) * Life and AD\&D Insurance (Company Provided) * Employee Assistance Program * Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions * Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Paid Time Off * Legal Plan and Identity Theft Protection * Accident Insurance * Employee Discounts * Pet Insurance * Employee Stock Purchase Program EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. jobs.title: Senior Real-Time Software Developer
jobs.description: Are you a software engineer who is excited by the challenge of building both embedded firmware and user\-facing applications that power industrial automation systems? Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. We are looking for curious, motivated engineers who enjoy working across the full software stack, from real\-time controller firmware running on Linux and VxWorks RTOS to workstation applications used by engineers to configure, program, visualize, and manage industrial automation systems. Based in Austin, Texas, you will join a diverse community and work as a contributing member of a cross\-functional Agile team focused on the development of Emerson's PACSystems technologies. PACSystems is trusted by leading companies across discrete and hybrid manufacturing industries to safely and reliably control critical processes. In this role, you will contribute to both the embedded controller platform and the engineering software tools that interact with PACSystems controllers. Your work may include PLC programming capabilities, deterministic control execution, industrial communications, diagnostics, configuration, visualization, and management workflows used in demanding industrial environments. You will contribute to the design and development of next\-generation PACSystems software capabilities across embedded and workstation layers. Our work includes C and C\+\+ software development, real\-time distributed computing, Linux and VxWorks RTOS environments, workstation application development, and systems where timing, reliability, usability, and predictable behavior are critical. Our team also embraces modern development practices, including automated testing, AI\-assisted development, and spec\-driven methods that improve quality and reduce ambiguity. You will be part of an organization led by leaders who are deeply committed to technical excellence, Agile principles, mentorship, and building an environment where engineers do their best work. If you are looking for a role where you can grow quickly, contribute meaningfully, and be part of something that has lasting real\-world impact, we want to hear from you. **IN THIS ROLE, YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL:** * **Collaborate** \- Contribute to a creative team atmosphere, participate in code reviews, and actively engage in Agile activities such as sprint planning and retrospectives. Take part in Hackathons, Tech Talks, and Communities of Practice with like\-minded engineers. * **Learn from Domain Experts** \- Work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts in industrial automation to build your understanding of the domain and learn how real\-world requirements translate into software. * **Contribute to Specifications** \- Support the authoring and review of structured software specifications, gaining hands\-on experience with spec\-driven development practices and AI\-assisted development workflows. * **Innovate** \- Write software using modern tools, frameworks, and AI\-enabled development practices. Learn to apply spec\-driven methodologies to improve quality, reduce ambiguity, and accelerate your own delivery. * **Automate** \- Write automated unit tests and contribute to system\-level testing to support a healthy automation pipeline and a release\-ready product. * Iterate \- Actively participate in team retrospectives and bring ideas for how the team can improve its processes and ways of working. * **Tech Savvy** — Stay curious about emerging technologies, AI development tooling, and spec\-driven methodologies, and look for opportunities to apply new skills to real problems. * **Always Curious** — Ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take time to understand the problem before diving into solutions. Treat every task as a learning opportunity. * **Team Obsessed** — Engage openly with your teammates, actively seek feedback, and commit to continuous improvement in both your work and your craft. **WHO YOU ARE:** You enjoy solving complex technical problems and learning how software, hardware, networks, and industrial control systems work together. You are comfortable moving between low\-level firmware development and higher\-level workstation application software. You are naturally curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous improvement. **FOR THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline plus 5\+ years of experience; or Master's degree plus 3\+ years of experience. * Strong knowledge of embedded software development using C and C\+\+ * Basic understanding of Linux and/or VxWorks RTOS concepts, including real\-time execution, concurrency, memory management, and debugging * Strong problem\-solving skills and a genuine desire to understand complex, distributed control systems Legal authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship now and in the future Individuals with temporary visas such as E, nvironment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. jobs.title: AI Engineer Internship | Undergraduate or Graduate - Summer 2027
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE:** Endeavor's Platform team builds the data, tools, and AI infrastructure that powers our global network across 50\+ markets. With Claude Enterprise now deployed to 390\+ staff across 43\+ markets, access to AI is no longer our constraint. The next challenge is organizational: converting that access into institutional capabilities that one team can build, another market can reuse, and Endeavor retains when people move on. We're looking for a **curious, hands\-on, builder\-minded intern** to help create Endeavor's **AI organizational infrastructure**: the reusable capabilities, templates, governance rails, and enablement systems that let our local offices and functional teams design their own AI\-augmented processes safely and effectively, instead of 50 markets reinventing the same tools in isolation. This is not a shadowing role. It is a hybrid role between discovery and applied AI engineering. You will interview local offices and functional departments to understand their workflows and what infrastructure they actually need, and you will get your hands dirty: prototyping agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval systems on Endeavor's enterprise AI stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP integrations, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Notion). You will also support the Platform team's deeper work on knowledge capture and institutional memory, helping turn the network's interactions into structured, trusted, actionable knowledge. By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped real capabilities used by teams across markets, creating a tangible output with lasting impact on how nearly 500 Endeavor colleagues work worldwide. This internship is ideal for someone excited by applied AI, organizational systems, and building things that scale globally, while gaining real responsibility and visibility inside a mission\-driven organization. ##### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Responsibility \#1: Discover What Teams Actually Need** + Lead structured interviews with local offices and functional departments to map their workflows, pain points, and existing AI experiments. Find where a shared, governed capability would beat fifty isolated ones, and identify what infrastructure, training, or guardrails each team needs to build effectively on their own. * **Responsibility \#2: Build Reusable AI Capabilities** + Prototype agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval features on our enterprise stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP, APIs), always choosing the lightest technical pattern that supports the behavior we want. Package what works so another market can adopt it without rebuilding it. * **Responsibility \#3: Create the Enablement Infrastructure** + Help create the templates, playbooks, starter kits, and documentation that let teams self\-serve: how to build a skill, an Artifact, a plugin, etc.; how to connect to governed data and use our MCPs; and how to stay within Endeavor's AI Policy. Make the right way the easy way. * **Responsibility \#4: Support Knowledge Capture \& Institutional Memory** + Support the Platform team's work on turning captured knowledge (meetings, founder ratings, network interactions) into structured, actionable intelligence, including retrieval pipelines and early knowledge graph work that makes institutional memory usable at the moment of key decisions. * **Responsibility \#5: Govern and Evaluate What You Ship** + Define what "working" means for the capabilities you build: success metrics, output quality checks, and simple eval loops. Contribute everything to Endeavor's AI Registry so it is human\-owned, tracked, permission\-aware, and auditable in line with Endeavor's AI Policy. ##### **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS \- WHO YOU ARE** * **Student Status:** Undergraduate Junior or Senior, or Graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; candidates from other disciplines with relevant skills and demonstrated building experience are encouraged to apply. * **Interests / Areas of Focus:** + Strong interest in applied AI and how organizations, not just individuals, adopt it: workflows, governance, change management, and knowledge systems. + Hands\-on experience building with LLMs beyond casual chatting: class projects, hackathons, or personal projects involving prompting, agents, RAG, or API integrations (Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, or similar). Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) is a strong plus. Things you have shipped matter more than credentials. + Working knowledge of Python or TypeScript/JavaScript and basic SQL, enough to build a prototype and query data with AI assistance. + Ability to understand technical architectures (APIs, databases, retrieval systems) and explain them clearly to non\-technical colleagues; much of this role is translating between technical and non\-technical worlds. + Exceptional written and verbal communication with an analytical\-first mindset; comfortable asking "why" to get to the root of a problem and turning research into actionable recommendations. + Comfortable working in a multilingual, global, cross\-cultural environment and incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders. + Nice to have: familiarity with Git, Snowflake, Salesforce, Notion, or workflow automation tools; interest in entrepreneurship or the startup ecosystem. * **Must be legally eligible to work in the U.S. We will not be able to interview or select candidates without valid U.S. work authorization for the 2027 year.** ##### **HIRING TIMELINE** * **Applications close:** October 7, 2026 at 11:59pm * **Interview process:** + **I****nitial Phone Screen:** A 30\-minute introductory conversation with a member of the Platform team to discuss your background and interest in the role. + **Final Interview:** A 1\-hour deep dive with the Hiring Manager covering discovery thinking, research methodology, and technical literacy, plus a short practical exercise. Using AI tools during the exercise is expected and encouraged; we want to see how you drive them. * **Offer extension:** November 16, 2026 #### **INTERNSHIP PROGRAM OVERVIEW** **The Endeavor Summer Internship Program**gives students 10 weeks to do more than just watch from the sidelines. You'll be put side by side with our Headquarters teams in NYC, San Francisco, London, Dubai, or Singapore, owning meaningful projects that move Endeavor forward. You'll contribute to real work from day one, and by the end of the summer, you'll present it directly to our CEO. Along the way you’ll get access most internships can’t offer, including fireside chats with our CEO, candid conversations with category\-defining Endeavor Entrepreneurs, and face time with executives across our global HQ. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Hardware
jobs.description: **About Etched** Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** Designing frontier AI hardware means solving electrical and mechanical problems together: schematics and board layouts, power delivery and signal integrity, packaging and cooling, manufacturing and assembly. Every decision changes the constraints on the next. Future breakthroughs will come from AI systems that can reason across these domains, operate engineering tools, run thousands of experiments, and learn which designs work in the physical world. You will build those systems. Your mandate is to build agents that take electrical and mechanical designs from requirements through verified, manufacturable outputs. These agents should create and modify CAD models, design schematics and PCB layouts, run simulations, diagnose failures, and iterate with our engineers, pushing the limits of how much of the design process AI can own end to end. Etched offers a uniquely tight research loop: chips, boards, racks, cooling systems, manufacturing, and dedicated in\-office compute under one roof. By architecting and orchestrating agent loops, you will turn proprietary designs, simulation results, engineering decisions, and physical test data into systems that get better with every experiment—and ship the hardware they help design. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and own AI systems that turn engineering requirements into verified electrical and mechanical designs, carrying intent and constraints from initial concepts through manufacturing outputs. * Build agents that operate CAD, EDA, and simulation tools to generate designs, run experiments, inspect results, diagnose problems, and iterate with our teams, to the limits of model autonomy. * Develop workflows spanning component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, mechanical CAD, assemblies, thermal analysis, and electrical and structural simulation. * Build the tool integrations and representations agents need to reason about geometry, connectivity, materials, tolerances, and coupled electrical, mechanical, thermal, and manufacturing constraints. * Design evals that measure engineering correctness, constraint satisfaction, simulation accuracy, manufacturability, and performance on real design tasks. * Turn simulation outputs, design\-rule checks, engineering reviews, and physical measurements into structured feedback models can learn from. * Curate proprietary datasets and design memory from complete trajectories, expert demonstrations, failed approaches, and manufactured outcomes. * Build reproducible experiment infrastructure so design revisions, tool actions, simulation settings, and results remain traceable and experiments can run at scale. * Ship agent\-generated designs with our electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams, and quantify improvements in design cycle time, hardware performance, and engineering effort. * Continuously evaluate new model releases and deploy the best models and methods for each stage of the design loop. **You may be a good fit if you have (Must\-have qualifications)** * A track record of solving hard problems across stacks and domains—you enjoy being dropped into unfamiliar territory and figuring it out. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping LLM\-based agents or AI tooling that people depend on: context engineering, tool integration, orchestration, evaluation, and failure analysis. * Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python. You can build reliable integrations with complex engineering tools, debug unfamiliar systems, and direct AI to write code well. We do not care whether you write code from scratch—we care whether you ship things that work. * Interest, experience, or an academic exposure to in electrical or mechanical engineering, or a record of learning a technical domain deeply enough to build useful tools for its practitioners. You can reason about physical constraints and distinguish a plausible design from a verified one. * Fluency using AI to learn and ramp on new problems—agentic coding tools, deep research, and frontier models are how you work, not an add\-on. * An eval\-driven mindset: you measure whether AI systems work, investigate where they fail, and use those failures to improve them. * Comfort moving between research exploration, agentic experimentation, engineering\-tool debugging, and production execution. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice\-to\-have qualifications)** * High agency and comfort with ambiguity—you find the real problem to solve. * Automating CAD or EDA tools through APIs, scripting, plugins, or GUI interaction. * Schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, power delivery, or signal and power integrity. * Parametric CAD, mechanical assemblies, tolerance analysis, thermal management, CFD, or FEA. * Design optimization, constraint solving, or search over large engineering design spaces. * Fine\-tuning or post\-training models using tool\-use trajectories, simulation feedback, or expert demonstrations. * Multimodal reasoning over engineering drawings, schematics, geometry, and simulation results. * Taking hardware through fabrication, assembly, bring\-up, and testing, and understanding where simulation and physical behavior diverge. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **Base Compensation Range** * $150K – $250K * Plus Significant Equity **How we’re different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer\-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Associate Web Development Software Engineer (SDK)
jobs.description: *Eulerity is a fast\-growing marketing technology company transforming how franchises and small businesses approach digital advertising. Built by former leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo!, our platform combines decades of experience in engineering and marketing to deliver an industry\-leading, automated solution. We make it easy to plan, launch, and analyze paid campaigns across Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Display, Video, and organic social \- all from one intuitive platform. We believe breakthrough results happen when technology, strategy, and creativity come together. By combining automation with human insight, we empower brands to scale smarter, move faster, and grow stronger. Internally, we're just as committed to growth. We cultivate a culture where ambitious, curious, and driven individuals are empowered to lead, learn, and elevate those around them.* **Your Role** * Designing, building, and shipping **developer\-facing SDKs** consumed by other engineers. * Owning the SDK as a product: the public API surface, TypeScript types, semantic versioning, packaging/distribution, backwards compatibility, and documentation. * Building and maintaining AI\-powered automation workflows that connect our product to internal and external systems. * Developing and testing new features using AI\-assisted tooling and autonomous agents, maintaining the codebase, integrating with APIs and data models, and owning the PR lifecycle (writing, reviewing, and incorporating feedback). * Collaborating across web, mobile, and backend teams to align on best practices, shared architecture, and product direction. * Partnering with Product and Design to translate designs and prototypes into shipped solutions for our users and the engineers who build on our SDK. **About You** * **SDK/library builder.** You design clean, intuitive, hard\-to\-misuse APIs and think about the developer on the other side of your interface. * **AI\-first engineer.** You've set up custom automation workflows (e.g., wiring Claude or similar LLMs into forms, APIs, or internal tools to replace manual work). * A self\-starter who can take ownership of a project and work independently and collaboratively. * Rigorous about reviewing AI\-generated output and taking full ownership of the code you ship. * Good attention to detail and initiative. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to document an SDK so another engineer can succeed with it. **Requirements** * **Proven experience designing and shipping a developer\-facing SDK, library, or public API consumed by other engineers** — including the public API/interface design, semantic versioning, and backwards\-compatibility discipline that come with it. * **Strong separation\-of\-concerns judgment** — able to design framework\-agnostic core logic (data, state, domain types) cleanly decoupled from thin, framework\-specific bindings, so the same core can support multiple front\-end frameworks over time. * Experience packaging and distributing libraries: bundling (e.g., tsup, Rollup, Vite), ESM/CJS output, tree\-shaking and bundle\-size awareness, and npm publishing. * **2–3 years of professional experience with React \& TypeScript**, including building reusable, composable components and using strong types as a public contract. * Well\-versed in building custom AI automation workflows (LLM API integrations, agentic tooling, or similar). * Solid understanding of fundamentals (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, working with APIs). * Familiarity with standard engineering workflows (PRs, code review, agile). * Strong written communication, including clear technical documentation. * Based in the NYC Metro Area and able to work hybrid from our NYC office 3x per week. * Authorized to work in the US. **A Strong Plus** * Experience building **embeddable / third\-party components** — style and CSS isolation (shadow DOM or scoped styles), theming and customization, and secure auth/token handling inside a host app. * Monorepo and release tooling (e.g., Changesets, Turborepo, Nx) and automated CI release pipelines. * Backend / full\-stack work (Java). * Technical writing and developer documentation experience. **Benefits:** * Comprehensive benefits + Medical + Dental + Vision * ️ Unlimited PTO * ️ In\-office lunch stipend * Commuter benefits * 401(k) with company match * Hybrid model (3x in office per week) * Summer Fridays **Compensation:** Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected range for this role is $100,000 \- $125,000, commensurate with experience and level. \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* ***IMPORTANT*** ***PLEASE FILL THIS FORM TO COMPLETE YOUR APPLICATION*** ***\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\****

jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Products
jobs.description: EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more. We are one of the fastest\-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com. In the past year, our engineering and data science team grew from 40 to 100\+ team members and we rolled out infrastructure updates, new products, and updates to existing workflows \- combining data, ML frontend and backend work. The next 12 months are very exciting for us; we expect the technical team to double as we deliver on a roadmap to handle 10x our current volume and build new products. As a Software Engineer on our New Products team, you’ll be responsible for helping build and launch brand new products that directly impact our customers' workflows \- which in turn has the opportunity to impact millions of lives in the personal injury space. **This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working at least 3 days a week from our downtown San Francisco hub.** **What you’ll do:** * **Build impactful technology**: You will build first\-of\-a\-kind technology that will transform an analog industry to improve the lives of millions of injury victims that got their lives turned upside down at no fault of their own. * **Have immediate impact in a small and tightly\-knit team**: be a key part of building the foundational blocks of their software and the team culture. Start shipping production code in less than two weeks! * **Be a core part of our engineering team**: Be a key part of building the foundational blocks of EvenUp's software and the team culture. Build and deploy and work on our core software product, whereby you’ll tackle hard problems, explore and deliver solutions while working with key people across the organization. * **Work with a world\-class team**: Our team has deep expertise in technology, machine learning, law, and finance, combining experiences from careers at Google, Uber, Waymo, Quora, Vimeo, Blizzard, and more. * **Learn new technologies from the best**: Our team emphasizes a culture of continual learning and you will have opportunities to work on projects in machine learning, data engineering, back\-end, front\-end, DevOps. * **Work with our tech\-stack**: Python, Typescript, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch. **What we look for:** * 5\-10\+ years of experience with backend or frontend engineering, working with relational databases and/or other database technologies \- **we're hiring frontend, backend, and full\-stack engineers for this team!** * Have several years of industry experience building high\-quality software, shipping production\-ready code and infrastructure. * Ability to communicate technical ideas or issues in easy\-to\-understand and actionable terms. * Learn quickly and are seeking opportunities to work cross\-functionally (including data engineering \& DevOps) and with a diverse group of people. * Experience owning a project from start to finish and loves to drive a project across the finish line. * Demonstrated success in mentoring and upleveling teammates. * Engineering excellence \- you’ve helped build what “great” looks like at scale (both product \+ team culture). * Kubernetes experience is a plus! **Benefits \& Perks:** As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including: * Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family. * Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness. * Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short\-term and long\-term disability. * 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province. * A home office stipend. * 401(k) for US\-based employees and RRSP for Canada\-based employees. * Paid parental leave. * A local in\-person meet\-up program. * Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto. *(Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees)* ***Notice to Candidates:*** *To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our* *careers page**.* *Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.* *EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* Compensation Range: CA$150K \- CA$215K

jobs.title: Digital Data Engineer & Analytics Lead
jobs.description: Description: EVEREVE inspires women to move forward in their fashion so that they feel fully alive. By offering modern, curated trends from 150\+ brands, including our own best\-selling line—along with warm, genuine advice—we deliver a styling experience made personal. Our 110\+ stores, booming e\-commerce business, and fast\-growing subscription box service, Trendsend, reach over two million customers every year. Living our core brand values and treating everyone with HEART (humility, empathy, authenticity, relationships, tenacity) creates a shared purpose and collaborative community—and it's also a key part of our success. Join our team to help shape the future of an ever\-growing, ever\-evolving brand! **Role Overview:** Reports to: Chief Digital Officer \| Level: 6 This role is onsite at our Edina, MN Headquarters, it is **not a remote position.** The Digital BI \& Analytics Lead owns the data foundation, BI ecosystem, and performance measurement framework for the Digital team. This role blends hands\-on data engineering with analytics leadership to deliver trusted insights across digital revenue, customer behavior, platform performance, fulfillment, returns, profitability, and long\-range planning. **Key Responsibilities:** **Data Engineering \& Infrastructure ·** * Design, build, and maintain scalable digital performance based data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, governed datasets, and semantic models leveraging datasets across digital, marketing, finance, merchandising, technology, and operations sources. * Translate business needs into production\-ready reporting assets, and reliable data models with clear documentation, monitoring, and quality standards. * Automate manual reporting, improve self\-service access, and strengthen data architecture, lineage, and change management practices. **Business Intelligence \& Performance Reporting** * Define and govern Digital KPIs, including revenue, conversion, AOV, traffic, engagement, funnel performance, delivery speed, shipping margin, returns, and profitability. * Build executive dashboards and reporting frameworks that combine insights across multiple internal and external sources to deliver one trusted source of truth for Digital performance. **Strategic Analytics, Experimentation, \& AI Enablement** * Develop analytical frameworks and financial models that support business transformation, five\-year planning, and technology prioritization. * Support experimentation, A/B testing, digital funnel analysis, and AI\-enabled analytics to improve performance forecasting, optimization, and insights. * Translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business stories that connect customer behavior, operational performance, and financial outcomes to identify opportunities for profitable digital growth. **Governance** * Serve as the Digital team’s subject matter expert for data standards, metric definitions, reporting governance, and analytics best practices. * Influence cross\-functional partners to improve reporting discipline, data quality, and adoption of trusted BI tools that support the Digital business. * Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to senior leaders, peers, and non\-technical stakeholders. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or related field; equivalent experience considered. * Progressive experience in data engineering, BI, analytics engineering, or digital analytics, preferably in retail, ecommerce, omnichannel, or consumer\-facing environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with SQL, Power BI, data modeling, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, and dashboard development; Python and SSRS preferred. * Experience working with complex, multi\-source datasets and building governed reporting, KPI frameworks, and actionable insights. * Strong financial acumen, analytical problem\-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and data storytelling skills. **EVEREVE Benefits and Perks:** * Self\-Managed PTO: Time off is yours to plan and use as you need it * Affordable Health Insurance: 80% employer\-paid premiums for medical and dental for team members; 50% covered for eligible partners, spouses and dependents * Parental Leave: Generous paid leave benefits for maternity, paternity and adoption to enjoy time with your growing family * Flex Spending Accounts: Benefit from pre\-tax savings for out\-of\-pocket healthcare or dependent/daycare costs * Additional Insurance: Company paid life insurance and short\-term disability * 401k \+5% Match:?Contribute to your financial future and receive a 5% company match with immediate vesting upon enrollment * Fashion Discount: Enjoy a 30% discount on all merchandise purchased in\-store or online, *excluding* Trendsend. EVEREVE team members are also eligible for a 30% discount online and in\-store at Jaxen Grey. * Flexible Work Model: Offers work from home flexibility with 4\-day in\-office presence to build connection with team members

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Design System
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to Team:** Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. This senior engineering manager role is part of the design system team which sits within our technology division. The team develops and maintains a unified design system that helps teams build consistent, accessible, scalable, and brand\-supportive experiences across web, iOS, and Android through reusable components, design standards, tokens, and theming. In this role, you will lead people and delivery for a high\-impact engineering team, setting direction, developing talent, and ensuring the team delivers outcomes aligned with business goals. I **n this role, you will:** * Lead, coach, and develop engineering teams responsible for Expedia Group’s design system, fostering technical excellence, accountability, and continuous growth. * Define and execute the technical strategy for reusable design\-system capabilities that improve consistency, accessibility, developer productivity, and customer experiences across products. * Guide architecture and implementation decisions across system design, low\-level design, API design, data modeling, and integration patterns for services and shared components. * Partner with product, design, accessibility, and engineering stakeholders to establish priorities, align roadmaps, and deliver scalable solutions across multiple domains. * Establish engineering practices that strengthen reliability, quality, security, observability, and operational excellence for design\-system platforms and services. Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products. * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of relevant professional experience and 3\+ years of people management experience * Experience owning technical direction and delivery across a multi\-service platform, shared capability, or technical domain. * Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, low\-level design, API design, data modeling, testing, observability, and production operations.
