jobs.title: Scientist (Ph.D.)
jobs.description: About Exponent: **Exponent** is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges. Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability. Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team! **Key statistics:*** 950\+ Consultants * 640\+ Ph.D.s * 90\+ Disciplines * 30\+ Offices globally Our Opportunity: We are currently seeking a **Scientist** for our **User Sciences** Practice to be based in our **Philadelphia, PA** office. In this role, you will work as part of a team to conduct user experience (UX) and usability research across a range of projects spanning consumer electronics hardware and software, medical devices, wearable technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) applications. Your work will help clients understand how users interact with their products—uncovering usability challenges, informing design improvements, and providing insights into safe and intuitive use. You will collaborate with a team of scientists and engineers from complementary disciplines to deliver research\-driven insights that are rigorous, actionable, and clearly communicated to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Projects will often span study design through data collection, analysis, and final reporting. You will be responsible for: * Reviewing and synthesizing scientific literature, technical data, and industry standards to ground research and inform study design and expert analysis * Designing and executing primary user research studies including usability testing, surveys, interviews, and observational research with careful attention to human perceptual, cognitive, and physical capabilities and limitations * Performing quantitative and qualitative data analysis including, for example, statistical analysis of behavioral and performance metrics and thematic analysis of qualitative data * Providing project management for multiple projects at a given time, including overseeing budgets and deadlines, coordinating project teams, and performing support tasks for team members * Preparing written reports and communicating complex analyses and findings clearly and succinctly to technical and non\-technical audiences * Developing client contacts and building foundational business development skills through client interactions, supporting proposals, and gaining exposure to consulting strategies across a variety of areas (e.g., consumer products, medical devices, etc.) You will have the following skills and qualifications: * Ph.D. in Developmental, Experimental, or Cognitive Psychology, Neuroscience, Vision Science, Data Sciences, Biomechanics, or a related discipline * Currently based in or are willing to relocate to the Philadelphia area * Willingness to travel for research sessions, client meetings, or on\-site evaluations * Breadth of knowledge of scientific literature from relevant fields along with the ability to creatively adapt expertise to specific and novel problems * Strong record demonstrating your ability to design and execute human subjects research studies using a variety of methods (e.g., usability testing, survey, experimental, quasi\-experimental, case study) * Experience leading multiple scientific studies from start (i.e., design) to finish (i.e., communicating your results) * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills * Assertive, self\-starter, and able to work with accuracy and attention to detail under pressure and/or deadlines * Proficiency in analytical, statistical, and computer programming (specifically Excel, MATLAB, Python, R, or SPSS) * Presently legally authorized to work in the United States; no immigration sponsorship or processing required *Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) \[not restricted to 1 page].* Life @ Exponent: To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links: https://www.exponent.com/careers/life\-exponent https://www.exponent.com/company/our\-impact Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment. Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well\-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference. Work Environment: At Exponent, we have found that in\-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in\-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities. We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well\-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients. \#LI\-Onsite Compensation: Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi\-weekly bonuses for high\-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary. The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process. Benefits you will enjoy: Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page: https://www.exponent.com/careers/life\-exponent Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may email us at HR\-Accommodations@exponent.com. Job Locations: US\-PA\-Philadelphia

We are looking for a Staff Engineer who can help mentor teams on both. **Architect Complex Distributed Systems** * Define architecture for large\-scale, distributed systems spanning multiple services, domains, and business capabilities. * Drive architectural consistency around: * APIs * event\-driven systems * cloud infrastructure * reliability * security * observability * operational excellence * Simplify complex systems through thoughtful abstractions and reusable patterns. **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Establish engineering standards that improve software quality across the organization. * Lead architectural reviews, influence design decisions, and help engineering teams make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, simplicity, scalability, reliability, and cost. * Champion modern engineering practices including AI\-assisted software development, automated testing, observability, continuous delivery, and platform engineering. **Mentor Technical Leaders** * Multiply the effectiveness of senior engineers and technical leads through coaching, architectural guidance, and design mentorship. * Help engineers grow their system thinking, technical judgment, and decision\-making while creating an engineering culture centered on curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement. **Drive Operational Excellence** * Lead initiatives that improve organizational reliability, resiliency, security, and operational maturity. * Define engineering patterns for: * observability * production diagnostics * AI evaluation * latency budgets * cost optimization * incident response * resiliency * governance * Establish measurable engineering standards that improve the health of production systems over time. **Collaborate Across the Organization** * Partner closely with engineering leadership, product management, solution architecture, security, platform engineering, infrastructure, and AI practitioners to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions. * Influence decisions through technical expertise, data, and strong communication rather than organizational authority. **What You'll Bring:** * 8\+ years of experience designing and building production software systems, including significant experience leading large\-scale technical initiatives * Demonstrated experience driving architecture across multiple teams, services, or business domains * Deep experience building cloud\-native distributed systems using modern software engineering pr owered applications and agentic workflows * Strong experience creating reusable engineering platforms, frameworks, libraries, or shared infrastructure adopted across multiple teams * Expertise designing APIs, event\-driven architectures, and highly available distributed systems * Experience establishing engineering standards, architectural patterns, and operational best practices across organizations * Demonstrated experience leading technical direction through influence rather than direct management * Deep understanding of AI operational concerns including evaluation strategies, model selection, latency optimization, cost management, observability, governance, and safety * Experience designing AI development workflows that improve engineering productivity through responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar * Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, and platform design * Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and elevate engineering organizations through coaching and technical leadership * Strong systems thinking with an outcome\-oriented mindset focused on creating durable organizational leverage **Ideally, You'll Also Have Experience With:** * Enterprise AI platforms (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Databricks) * C\# (.NET), Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or similar languages * Kubernetes, Docker, and modern platform engineering practices * Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CDK, or similar tooling * Observability platforms including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar * Large\-scale platform modernization or cloud migration initiatives * Highly regulated industries such as Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or similar \#ST2 Pay Range: $148,600\.00 \- $198,200\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Investment Associate** **Misumi Ventures** · San Francisco Bay Area · Full\-time **The fund** Misumi Ventures is a $50 million early\-stage fund investing at the intersection of frontier hardware, robotics, automation and industrial AI. We will build a portfolio of 20 to 30 seed and early\-stage companies. Our thesis is specific. Hardware companies rarely fail because the idea was wrong — they fail in the gap between a working prototype and repeatable volume production. Our portfolio companies get direct access to MISUMI's manufacturing continuum: more than 30 million standard parts, 22 company\-owned factories, 4,000 sourcing partners, and a five\-region network across the Americas, China, Asia, Europe and Japan. That is what we put on a cap table alongside the check. **The role** Misumi Ventures is newly launched. Our founding partners hold operating responsibilities within MISUMI Americas, which means the Investment Associate will be the fund's first dedicated full\-time investment professional. The scope is correspondingly broad. You will build our deal funnel, own how the fund presents itself to founders and co\-investors, support diligence and portfolio companies, and run the reporting cadence to our LP. You will report to the Managing Partner and participate in investment discussions. This is not a narrow deal seat, and we want to be direct about that before you apply. **Responsibilities** **Sourcing and co\-investor relationships** Our deal flow depends on being present in the pipelines of the firms that do lead. You will build and maintain relationships with investors across our sectors, work the accelerator and university research channels that produce frontier hardware companies, and keep a current map of who is funding what in robotics, automation, aerospace, and industrial software. You will run first meetings and write the memo that determines whether a partner takes a second. **Fund positioning and ecosystem presence** Founders and co\-investors distinguish between a fund and a corporate development budget, and our credibility depends on being clearly understood as the former. You will own our external presence — website, content, founder\-facing communications, and our participation in the deep\-tech and hardware communities — and run the founder dinners, technical sessions and events that make us a known quantity in our categories. **Diligence and portfolio support** Technical and commercial diligence: customer references, expert calls, competitive and supply chain analysis, market sizing. Post\-investment, you will connect portfolio companies into MISUMI's engineering and sourcing organization and support them through recruiting, customer introductions and subsequent financings. **Fund operations and LP reporting** Quarterly reporting to the LP, working with our fund administrator and the finance organization at MISUMI Americas. Portfolio and pipeline reporting for the investment committee. Ownership of the CRM and our data discipline. jobs.title: Enterprise Network Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES** The Enterprise Network Engineer will design and operate FirstKey Homes’s enterprise network infrastructure across corporate locations, cloud environments and remote users. This is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for maintaining a secure, resilient and high performing network environment. The ideal candidate has strong experience with enterprise routing and switching, network security, wireless infrastructure, cloud networking and modern SASE/SD\-WAN technologies. The Enterprise Network Engineer will serve as a senior technical resource within Infrastructure Operations, carrying out network\-focused projects, troubleshoot complex issues and help establish standards and best practices as the organization continues to modernize. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** * **Enterprise Networking** + **Design, configure, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN and Internet connectivity** + **Manage enterprise routing and switching infrastructure; primarily Cisco Catalyst** + **Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, routing protocols, ACLs and network segmentation** + **Maintain high\-availability in network connectivity across corporate and cloud networks** + **Perform network capacity planning, performance analysis and proactive improvement** + **Develop and maintain network diagrams, standards, configuration documentation and operational procedures** * **SASE, SD\-WAN \& Remote Connectivity** + **Administer and optimize the organization’s CATO SASE environment** + **Support secure remote access, internet and cloud connectivity through the SASE platform** + **Troubleshoot routing, application performance, connectivity and policy issues across the WAN** + **Assist with continued migration from traditional network architecture toward SASE and a zero\-trust model** * **Network Access Control \& Network Security** + **Lead or significantly contribute to the ongoing implementation and administration of Network Access Control (NAC)** + **Develop an optimized network segmentation and access\-control strategy for all corporate device classes** + **Implement and maintain 802\.1X and related authentication technologies where applicable** + **Partner with Cybersecurity to implement network security policies, vulnerability remediation and network infrastructure hardening** * **Wireless Networking** + **Configure, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise wireless networks** + **Perform wireless performance analysis and assist with RF optimization, coverage capacity and troubleshooting roaming issues** * **Cloud \& Hybrid Networking** + **Responsible for corporate Azure network infrastructure** + **Configure and troubleshoot VNets, subnets, routing, NSGs, VPN connectivity and related Azure networking services** + **Support connectivity between cloud resources, corporate networks, remote users and applicable third\-party environments** + **Collaborate with Systems and Cloud Engineering teams on infrastructure projects requiring network design or connectivity** * **Operations \& Troubleshooting** + **Serve as an escalation point for complex network incidents and performance issues** + **Perform packet captures, traffic analysis and systemic troubleshooting of network and application connectivity** + **Participate in root\-case analysis for significant infrastructure incidents** + **Monitor network health, availability, utilization and performance** + **Participate in infrastructure maintenance and changes that may occasionally occur outside of normal business hours** + **Work with telecommunications carriers, ISPs, hardware vendors and other third parties** + **Develop repeatable configuration standards and engineering practices** + **Assist with lifecycle planning and replacement of network infrastructure** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * Primarily working indoors, office environment. * May sit for several hours at a time. * Prolonged exposure to computer screens. * Repetitive use of hands to operate computers, printers, and copiers. * Up to 10% travel to offices throughout the US and globally for maintenance/upgrade purposes. **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Minimum 5\+ years of professional experience in managing enterprise\-scale global networks * Strong knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking fundamentals * Hands\-on experience with enterprise routing and switching * Strong understanding of: + TCP/IP, Wireless \& RADIUS Auth, VLANs, Spanning Tree, Link Aggregation, BGP and OSPF, DNS and DHCP, NAT, VPN, QoS, Network Segmentation \& Access Control * Experience troubleshooting complex network and application connectivity issues * Strong experience supporting firewalls, SD\-WAN/SASE, Software\-Defined Networking * Experience in managing cloud\-based networks such as within Microsoft Azure * Strong experience in working with Cisco Catalyst \& Meraki * Experience implementing and managing Access Control solutions * Experiencing in capturing documentation for audit purposes * CCNP or equivalent demonstrated enterprise networking knowledge **PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Experience in managing Cato Networks SASE * Experience with 802\.1X, RADIUS, certificate\-based network authentication * Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms **REQUIRED SKILLS** * Active Listening— Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times. * Active Learning— Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem\-solving and decision\-making. * Critical Thinking— Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems. * Complex Problem Solving— Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions. * Troubleshooting— Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it. * Systems Analysis— Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes. * Service Orientation— Actively looking for ways to help people. * Time Management— Managing one's own time and the time of others. * Speaking— Talking to others to convey information effectively. * Writing— Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience. * Driving Growth – Proven skill in assisting other team leaders with driving growth within individual teams. **WORK STYLES \& BEHAVIORS** * Attention to Detail— Job requires being careful about detail and thorough in completing work tasks. * Dependability— Job requires being reliable, responsible, and dependable, and fulfilling obligations. * Cooperation— Job requires being pleasant with others on the job and displaying a good\-natured, cooperative attitude. * Stress Tolerance— Job requires accepting criticism and dealing calmly and effectively with high stress situations. * Adaptability/Flexibility— Job requires being open to change (positive or negative) and to considerable variety in the workplace. jobs.title: HPC Kubernetes/Slurm Cluster Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a highly skilled HPC/AI/ML Cluster Engineer to support the design, deployment, and ongoing operations of large\-scale HPC environments powered by Kubernetes and Slurm (Slinky). This role centers on cluster engineering, administration, and performance optimization, with emphasis on GPU\-accelerated computing, advanced networking, and workload scheduling. In this role, you will work closely with our researchers, vendors, and partners to manage Slurm clusters that are used for AI/ML workloads. You will work alongside our team to support in\-house, partner, and customer infrastructure **Responsibilities** **Cluster Engineering \& Deployment** * Participate in the design and bring\-up of bare metal HPC/AI/ML environments * Integrate heterogeneous hardware platforms into cohesive scheduling environments. * Develop provisioning and imaging workflows (Ansible, MAAS, cloud\-init, warewulf, CI/CD pipelines) for reproducible cluster build\-out. * Coordinate communications between vendors, researchers, and other partners during cluster bring\-up and operation. **Slurm Management** * Configure and operate the Slurm Workload Manager. * Build custom Slurm plugins and scripts (epilog/prolog, pam\_slurm\_adopt) to extend functionality and integrate with authentication, health checking, and monitoring. * Manage federated Slurm setups across multi\-site or hybrid cloud environments. **System Administration \& Monitoring** * Administer Linux HPC environments, including network configuration, storage integration, and kernel tuning for HPC workloads. * Deploy and maintain observability stacks for system health, GPU metrics, and job monitoring. * Automate failure detection, node health checks, and job cleanup to ensure high uptime and reliability. * Manage security and access control (LDAP/SSSD, VPN, PAM, SSH session auditing). **User \& Stakeholder Support** * Assist cluster users with developing workflows that make efficient use of compute resources. * Containerize HPC applications with Docker/Podman/Enroot\-Pyxis and integrate GPU\-aware runtimes into Slurm jobs. * Automate cost accounting and cluster usage reporting. **Qualifications** * Previous experience in HPC cluster administration and engineering, with deep knowledge of Slurm. * Expert in Slurm configuration, partition design, QoS/preemption policies, and GRES GPU scheduling. * Strong background in Linux system administration, networking, and performance tuning for HPC environments. * Hands\-on experience with parallel file system, advanced networking (InfiniBand, RoCE, 100/200 GbE), and monitoring stacks. * Proficient with automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines) and version control. * Demonstrated ability to operate GPU\-accelerated clusters at scale. * Previous experience managing kubernetes deployments * **Exceptional candidates have familiarity with common AI/ML software package dependencies and researcher workflows** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Relocation assistance Experience: * Linux and HPC cluster system administration: 1 year (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hickory, NC 28602

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Decision Team** --------------------- **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * **Automate the delivery of gigawatts.** Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand. * **Forward\-deploy beside the experts.** Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit. * **Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last.** Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them. **Role Scope** -------------- * **Build the hiring machine as software.** Hiring is the company's biggest bottleneck. Every role, seat, and interview loop already lives in one graph, and you take it the rest of the way: the recruiting system synced both directions, interviewer supply and load visible to every hiring manager, and onboarding generated the moment an offer is signed, so day one starts with the job instead of the checklist. * **Build the cash view the company runs on:** today no system derives near term spend, so finance forecasts by hand and misses what construction already committed. You turn purchase orders, contract terms, and build milestones into an order schedule, a cash demand curve by month, and a payment schedule that recompute as procurement and construction move. * **Build one capital pipeline** from approved budget to released capital to spent dollar, gated on build milestones the delivery system already verifies, with the proof chain behind every financing drawdown assembled automatically, so releasing nine figures takes a day of judgment and funding follows construction within days. * **Parse every MSA, change order, and side letter** into obligations, prices, deadlines, penalties, and SLAs, so a delivery lead gets what we owe a customer at a site with the clause attached, a change order arrives with its legal and finance checks done, and the corpus of executed deals prices the next negotiation. * **Embed forward\-deployed** with finance, treasury, accounting, legal, and people teams through a close, a drawdown, a negotiation, and a hiring loop, and turn their approvals, contract terms, screens, and reconciliations into structured data and generated work, including a continuous close where capitalization and depreciation post as events the moment they happen. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would****.** * You've shipped production code in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you pick up whatever language the problem demands. * You've built real features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-weight models), MCP servers, and agentic frameworks. * You work daily with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and you get agents doing useful work autonomously alongside you. * You identify problems, design the solution, and ship it without waiting for direction or approval. * You've moved fast under deadline while leaving foundations that other engineers extended after you moved on. * You've earned credibility with experts outside engineering: finance leads, lawyers, recruiters, or auditors, and driven adoption of your software inside their real deadlines, like a working close calendar or an offer that has to go out today. * Your product taste shows in what you've shipped: a controller, a recruiter, or a lawyer calls your interface obvious, and the workflow matches how their work actually happens. * **Bonus:** ERP and fixed asset accounting. FP\&A, cash forecasting, and capital planning. Structured finance or treasury operations. Contract lifecycle systems. ATS and HRIS integrations (Ashby, Greenhouse, Rippling, Workday). LLM extraction over legal and financial documents. **Benefits:** ------------- * Competitive total compensation package (cash \+ equity) * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Retirement plan * Generous PTO policy We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $224K \- $300K

jobs.title: Level 2 IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Level 2 IT Support Engineer** **Salary: $50,000–$70,000 per year, depending on experience** **About Focused Technologies** At Focused Technologies, we help our clients get the most from their technology by keeping their IT environments secure, reliable, and running smoothly, allowing them to focus on delivering value to their customers instead of dealing with IT problems. Our Level 2 IT Support Technicians provide advanced technical support to our clients while serving as an escalation resource for Level 1 technicians. Level 2 technicians are expected to independently resolve a broad range of endpoint, Microsoft 365, server, network, and application issues while recognizing when an issue requires escalation to a Level 3 engineer. Our core values guide how we work: * **Respect the customer.** * **Empower each other.** * **Strive for success.** This position is ideal for an experienced IT support professional who has developed a strong technical foundation and wants to continue growing into systems administration, networking, cybersecurity, and infrastructure engineering. **Key Responsibilities** As a Level 2 IT Support Technician, you will be expected to: * Take ownership of client issues from initial assignment through resolution, including providing timely updates, setting appropriate expectations, coordinating next steps, and following through to ensure issues are fully resolved and the client is informed. * Build strong client relationships by communicating technical issues and solutions clearly, professionally, and proactively, while ensuring clients understand the status and next steps for their requests. * Independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues escalated from Level 1 technicians. * Provide remote and on\-site technical support to client users. * Troubleshoot Windows desktop and laptop hardware, operating systems, applications, printers, peripherals, and related issues. * Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, MFA, and user accounts. * Perform common Active Directory and Entra ID administrative tasks, including user accounts, groups, permissions, password issues, and device\-related problems. * Troubleshoot Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file shares, NTFS permissions, and common Windows Server issues. * Diagnose network connectivity problems involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, switches, VLANs, firewalls, and VPNs. * Troubleshoot common email delivery, spam, authentication, and Microsoft 365 issues. * Support backup and disaster\-recovery systems, including reviewing backup failures and performing file or system restores. * Review and respond to alerts generated by remote monitoring, endpoint security, backup, and other management platforms. * Support endpoint security technologies, MFA, email security, and other client security controls. * Install, configure, replace, and troubleshoot workstations, laptops, servers, network equipment, and other client technology. * Assist Level 3 engineers with server, network, Microsoft 365, security, and infrastructure projects. * Perform defined project work independently when the scope and technical approach have been established. * Coordinate with software vendors and other third parties to resolve client issues. * Properly document client environments, configurations, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. * Identify recurring issues or deficiencies within client environments and bring them to the attention of senior technical staff. * Assist Level 1 technicians with troubleshooting and provide guidance when appropriate. * Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to clients and other team members. * Participate in an on\-call rotation and occasionally perform scheduled evening or weekend work. **What We're Looking For** A successful Level 2 technician should be capable of independently resolving most day\-to\-day technical issues without requiring step\-by\-step assistance. You should: * Have strong troubleshooting skills and be comfortable investigating problems where the solution is not immediately obvious. * Understand the fundamentals of how endpoints, servers, networks, Microsoft 365, identity, and business applications interact. * Know how to research an unfamiliar problem rather than immediately escalating it. * Understand the difference between resolving the symptom of a problem and identifying its underlying cause. * Recognize when an issue exceeds your technical knowledge or presents significant risk and should be escalated. * Be comfortable working directly with clients and explaining technical issues in understandable terms. * Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow them through to resolution. * Document your work clearly enough that another technician can understand what was done and why. * Be organized and capable of prioritizing multiple client issues. * Be interested in continuously developing your technical skills. * Work effectively both independently and as part of a technical team. **Required Technical Knowledge** Candidates should have working knowledge and hands\-on experience with several of the following: * Windows 10 and Windows 11 * Windows Server * Active Directory * Group Policy * DNS and DHCP * NTFS and file\-share permissions * Microsoft 365 administration * Exchange Online * Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD * Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive * MFA and identity troubleshooting * TCP/IP networking * Subnetting fundamentals * VLAN concepts * Firewalls and VPNs * Managed switches and wireless networking * Server virtualization * Backup and disaster\-recovery technologies * Endpoint security / EDR technologies * Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) platforms * Remote end\-user support Prior experience working for an MSP or supporting multiple independent business environments is strongly preferred. **Preferred Experience** Additional experience in the following areas is beneficial: * Microsoft Intune * Microsoft Azure * Conditional Access * Hyper\-V or VMware * Firewall administration * Managed network switches * Email security * SPF, DKIM, and DMARC * Security awareness and endpoint security technologies * PowerShell * Server and workstation deployments * Microsoft 365 migrations * Business application support **Education and Experience** We value demonstrated technical ability and experience over a specific educational path. Preferred qualifications include: * Approximately **3–5 years of IT support, help desk, systems administration, or MSP experience**, or equivalent demonstrated technical ability. * Experience independently troubleshooting Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, and common server\-related issues. * Previous experience receiving escalations from junior technicians is beneficial. A bachelor's or associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is beneficial but not required. **Relevant Certifications** Relevant certifications may include: * CompTIA A\+ * CompTIA Network\+ * CompTIA Security\+ * Microsoft 365 certifications * Microsoft Azure certifications * Cisco CCNA or equivalent networking certifications Certifications are beneficial but are not a substitute for demonstrated technical ability. **Additional Requirements** * Valid State of Ohio driver's license. * Reliable transportation for client on\-site work. * Ability to travel to client locations primarily throughout Northeast Ohio. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation. * Ability to occasionally perform scheduled work outside normal business hours. **Benefits** Focused Technologies offers: * Health insurance * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Mileage reimbursement * Internet and cellphone stipends * Flexible scheduling * Primarily work\-from\-home environment **Position Details** **Job Type:** Full\-time **Salary:** $50,000–$70,000 per year, depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability **Typical Schedule:** Monday through Friday, with participation in an on\-call rotation and occasional scheduled evening or weekend work. **Work Environment:** Primarily remote, with on\-site work at client locations as needed. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan Education: * Associate (Preferred) License/Certification: * Driver's License (Required) * CompTIA A\+ (Preferred) * CompTIA Network\+ (Preferred) Location: * Cuyahoga Falls, OH 44221 (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cuyahoga Falls, OH 44221

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Remote Enterprise Technology plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are., Ford Pro is a new global business within Ford committed to commercial customer productivity. Ford Pro delivers a work\-ready suite of vehicles, accessories and services for virtually every vocation, backed by technology and engineered for uptime. A true one\-stop shop, we offer a full portfolio of electrified and internal combustion vehicles designed to integrate seamlessly with the Ford Pro ecosystem, helping customers' businesses thrive today and into the new era of electrification., Ford Pro Intelligence provides telematics and fleet management services to our commercial and fleet customers. Ford Pro products and services serve as a foundational building block to Ford’s continued leadership and innovation in fleet/commercial vehicle market segments. Fleets are our future, representing a significant portion of vehicle sales and continual expected growth. **In this position...** This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, backend API development, and data governance, and is ideal for someone who enjoys owning a problem from database to endpoint to business\-ready metric. You'll work closely with data analysts, application developers, and business stakeholders to ensure data is accessible, reliable, well\-documented, and easy to consume across the organization. **What you'll do...** We are looking for a Full Stack Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end data solutions — from raw data ingestion and API development through to curated semantic layers that power analytics and business decision\-making. * Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources into Google BigQuery and other cloud data platforms. * Develop, document, and maintain RESTful/GraphQL APIs to expose data and services to internal applications, dashboards, and third\-party consumers. * Design and manage a semantic data layer (e.g., LookML, dbt semantic models, Cube.js, or similar) that translates raw data into consistent, business\-friendly metrics and definitions. * Implement and maintain a data catalog / knowledge catalog (e.g., Google Data Catalog, Collibra, Alation, Atlan) to improve data discoverability, lineage tracking, and metadata management. * Optimize BigQuery performance through partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and cost\-management best practices. * Build data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to ensure pipeline reliability and data trustworthiness. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (analytics, product, engineering) to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data models and API contracts. * Enforce data governance, security, and access control standards (PII handling, role\-based access, encryption). * Write clean, well\-tested, and maintainable code (Python/SQL, and backend frameworks for APIs). Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and CI/CD pipeline development for data and application deployments. * **You'll have...** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a full\-stack data role. * 3\+ years in roles demonstrating Strong programming skills in Python, Kotlin, and Java * 3 years of Strong hands\-on experience with Google BigQuery (data modeling, query optimization, cost management, scheduled queries). * 3\+ years of Proven experience designing and building APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Node.js/Express, or similar. * 3 years of practical experience building and maintaining a semantic layer (e.g., dbt, LookML/Looker, Cube.js, AtScale) to standardize business metrics. * 2\+ years of experience in roles requiring a Strong understanding of testing, monitoring, reliability, and maintainable software design * 2\+ years comfortable working years of experience with SQL and structured data **Even better, you may have...** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field * Document data flows, API specifications, semantic definitions, and system architecture for internal and cross\-team use. * Experience working with a data catalog / metadata management tool (e.g., Google Data Catalog, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Amundsen) including lineage, tagging, and governance workflows. * Strong SQL skills and experience with Python for data pipeline development and automation. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer/Airflow). * Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, normalization). * Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data and application deployments. * Strong understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices. * Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer. * Familiarity with dbt (data build tool) for transformation and testing. * Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform). * Exposure to streaming data platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow). * Experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or connected vehicle data domain (a plus, given Ford's business context). * Knowledge of BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). * Understanding of data mesh or domain\-driven data architecture principles. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases • Tuition assistance • Established and active employee resource groups • Paid time off for individual and team community service • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is a salary grade 8 and ranges from $115,000\-$192,900\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-KD1

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Fortem is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own the design, development, and lifecycle management of Fortem’s ecosystem of supporting field hardware. This role is responsible for the mechanical systems that enable our sensors, cameras, and electronics to be mounted, aligned, protected, transported, and deployed in the field and includes but is not limited to tripod and precision radar mounts, ruggedized enclosures, calibration hardware, and custom case and foam packaging. You will serve as a technical authority for mechanical integration across our hardware platforms, working closely with Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, and Field Operations to ensure our equipment is robust, reliable, easy to deploy, and capable of performing in demanding field environments. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership engineering role for someone who enjoys taking hardware from initial concept through CAD, prototyping, testing, production, and field deployment—and who takes pride in creating hardware that works reliably when and where our customers need it. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead mechanical design efforts from concept through production release for supporting field hardware * Create and maintain detailed 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, BOMs, GD\&T, and product documentation * Perform tolerance stack\-up analysis, structural and vibration analysis, and other engineering analyses required to validate designs * Develop and execute environmental and durability testing, including shock, vibration, temperature, and ingress protection testing * Collaborate closely with Electrical, Systems, Software, Manufacturing, and Field Operations teams to ensure mechanical designs satisfy system\-level integration, calibration, and usability requirements * Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) throughout the product lifecycle * Work directly with machine shops, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to bring designs into production * Build and test prototypes, rapidly iterate designs, and incorporate lessons learned from testing and field deployments * Own sourcing and supplier relationships for mechanical components, custom cases, foam, and other specialized hardware * Develop and maintain assembly instructions, packing procedures, maintenance documentation, and engineering change documentation * Provide hands\-on mechanical engineering support to field teams, troubleshoot hardware issues, and implement robust corrective actions * Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, usability, manufacturability, and cost of existing hardware * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards, processes, and best practices * Manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities in a fast\-paced, resource\-conscious environment * Other engineering duties and tasks as assigned by engineering leadership Requirements: **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Master's degree is a plus. * 7\+ years of professional mechanical engineering experience, preferably with a significant portion focused on precision mechanical systems, ruggedized equipment, or field\-deployable hardware * Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD, with SolidWorks preferred, including complex assemblies, sheet\-metal design, and GD\&T. * Demonstrated experience designing ruggedized equipment and field\-deployable hardware * Experience designing hard cases, transit cases, and custom protective foam packaging, including CNC\-cut and/or 3D\-printed foam solutions * Experience designing precision mounting and alignment systems for radar, optical, camera, or other sensor payloads * Strong understanding of materials selection and manufacturing processes, including machining, sheet metal fabrication, casting, additive manufacturing, and common fastening methods * Experience with tolerance analysis, structural analysis/FEA, and environmental or durability testing * Demonstrated ability to take hardware from initial concept through production and field deployment * Experience working directly with external vendors, machine shops, fabricators, and contract manufacturers * Strong technical communication and documentation skills * Demonstrated ability to independently identify problems, develop solutions, and drive projects to completion **Preferred Skills** * Experience designing equipment for defense, aerospace, C\-UAS, radar, sensor, survey, or geospatial applications * Experience with mast systems, tripods, pan/tilt mechanisms, precision positioning systems, or calibration equipment * Experience with rapid prototyping using 3D printing, CNC machining, and other in\-house fabrication methods * Familiarity with environmental and durability standards such as MIL\-STD\-810 and IP ratings * Experience designing hardware for high\-shock, high\-vibration, outdoor, or otherwise demanding operating environments * Experience with fielded products and sustaining engineering, including troubleshooting and corrective action * Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical leadership on small engineering teams **ABOUT US** Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia. Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others. *Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Fortem is looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a passion for solving difficult problems. In this role you will primarily be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving DroneHunter’s ability to autonomously seek and capture targets safely. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise in embedded systems with architectural thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and a passion for building reliable, safety\-critical drone platforms. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and test flight control and autonomy software, including state estimation, sensor fusion, and control loops * Develop navigation and path\-planning algorithms, including obstacle avoidance and GPS/GNSS\-based positioning * Build and maintain firmware for flight controllers and embedded hardware, working within real\-time constraints * Implement communication protocols for telemetry, command\-and\-control, and failsafe/lost\-link scenarios * Contribute to ground control station software for mission planning, monitoring, and post\-flight analysis * Build and run hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) simulations to validate software before field testing * Collaborate closely with hardware, mechanical, and regulatory/compliance teams to ensure system\-level reliability * Participate in field testing and flight trials, iterating quickly based on real\-world results * Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code, and participate in code reviews * Other software engineering tasks and projects as assigned by engineering leadership Requirements: **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally in robotics, aerospace, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and/or Python; experience with real\-time or embedded systems is a plus * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment with frequent hardware testing * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to debug complex, multi\-layered systems (hardware \+ software) * Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and code review workflows * Excellent collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional **Preferred Skills** * Familiarity with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2, PX4, or ArduPilot * Understanding of communication protocols (MAVLink, UART, CAN, etc.) * Part 107 Remote Pilot License **ABOUT US** Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia. Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others. *Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, CNC Machining (New Grad December 2026)
jobs.description: **MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, CNC MACHINING (NEW GRAD DECEMBER 2026\)** ------------------------------------------------------------------- Freeform builds AI\-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial\-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. As a Manufacturing Engineer (CNC Machining), you will play a critical role in achieving Freeform's goal of becoming the world leader in the manufacturing of high\-value metal 3D printed parts. You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing CNC programs for precision machining operations as well as working closely with our engineers and machinist to establish machining standards for Freeform's high\-volume, vertically integrated machining workflow. You'll use top of the line multi\-axis machines—including DMG Mori and Haas—to develop complex geometries and refine machining processes for maximum efficiency, quality, and repeatability. The ideal candidate is highly technical, hands\-on, and thrives in a fast\-paced development environment. If you want to be at the forefront of the next era of manufacturing technology, we'd love to hear from you! 3D printing experience is not required to be successful here—we look for smart, motivated, and collaborative individuals who love tackling complex challenges and building world\-class technology! **Responsibilities:** * Develop, implement, and optimize CNC programs for complex metal components, including post\-processing of 3D printed parts * Program, set up, and refine operations on multi\-axis CNC machines (DMG Mori and Haas) * Interpret CAD models, technical drawings, and GD\&T specifications to create highly precise machining programs * Select and optimize cutting tools, speeds, feeds, and machining strategies for efficiency and repeatability * Troubleshoot and resolve CNC programming issues, collaborating with machinists and design engineers * Create, maintain, and update CNC program libraries, tool databases, best practices, and process documentation * Implement process improvements to enhance productivity, reduce cycle times, and increase machine utilization * Collaborate cross\-functionally with additive designers on custom workholding, identifying whether design or process changes are the right fix for a given issue * Design and deploy automation solutions to enhance quality control and maximize production rates * Work on the production floor to provide technical support, training, and hands\-on troubleshooting as needed * Ensure compliance with quality control processes, industry standards, and safety regulations **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline * Experience with CNC programming and machining (internships and/or collegiate engineering clubs are acceptable) * Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing **Nice to Have:** * Experience with MasterCAM or Hypermill * Experience with 5\-axis machines * Experience with DMG Mori and Siemens controls * Experience machining hard metals such as titanium or Inconel * Experience with automation programming for probe alignment, in\-situ quality checks, and adaptive process compensation based on measurement feedback * Familiarity with metal 3D printed parts and their post\-processing requirements * Familiarity with machining castings or forgings * Strong problem\-solving skills and a hands\-on approach to debugging machining processes * Experience with quality control tools, including CMM, micrometers, and thread gauges * Ability to work with power tools, hand tools, cranes, forklifts, and other heavy equipment * Comfortable lifting/moving up to 30 lbs and standing for extended periods * Willingness to work overtime when needed **Location:** * Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R\&D, and production together under one roof. We operate at the center of LA's deep tech ecosystem, surrounded by some of the most ambitious hardware innovation happening anywhere in the country. * Our fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment is built on close collaboration, and as such, this role requires full\-time onsite presence (five days a week), with very limited exceptions. **What We Offer:** * We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data\-driven decisions. * We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling a world\-changing technology. * Benefits + Significant stock option packages + 100% employer\-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (premium PPO and HMO options) + Life insurance + Traditional and Roth 401(k) + Relocation assistance provided + Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays + Generous Paid Parental Leave and extended transition back to work for the birthing parent + Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette + Casual dress, flexible work hours, and regular catered team building events * Compensation + Our intent is to offer a salary that is commensurate for the company's current stage of development and allows the employee to grow and develop within a role. + In addition to the significant stock option package, the estimated salary range for this role is $95,000\-$110,000, *dependent on the candidate's academic level (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) and demonstrated out of classroom experience.* * Freeform is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity; employment with Freeform is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician II
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- Filed Service position is based in our West Lebanon, NH office location with frequent travel required. Often considered a “bag\-carrying” repair specialist. Performs client\-site servicing, repair and/or installation of company product(s). Provides technical support to customers on operational or maintenance aspects of system equipment. Serves as customer contact on technical and service\-related problems. Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, electrical, software and systems failures using established procedures. Determines most cost effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime. Prepares reports for analysis of product failure trends and service ability issues. **Company Overview** -------------------- At FUJIFILM Dimatix Inc., printing and material deposition devices are only as good as their printheads. We are a recognized leader in the manufacturing and design of durable and productive drop\-on\-demand inkjet printheads that power cutting\-edge systems, as well as integrated inkjet solutions that add digital inkjet capabilities to other equipment. These are part of the digitization and transformation of many applications such as commercial printing, graphics, label \& packaging, additive manufacturing, ceramic tiles, textiles, electronics and life science research. We’re looking for forward\-thinkers eager to spark innovation in inkjet technology. Bring your talents to a team built on collaboration, creativity, and a passion for excellence. At FUJIFILM Dimatix, every product we make begins with the extraordinary people behind it. Join us for groundbreaking work in a flexible, engaging environment. We’re based in two incredible locations: Lebanon, New Hampshire, surrounded by picturesque New England landscapes, and Santa Clara, California, a dynamic hub in Silicon Valley with a mix of innovation, diversity, and sunshine. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers **Job Description** ------------------- **SKILL** Applies acquired job skills and company policies and procedures to complete assigned tasks. **JOB COMPLEXITY** Works on assignments that are semi\-routine in nature but recognizes the need for occasional deviation from accepted practice. **SUPERVISION** Normally follows established procedures on routine work, requires instructions only on new assignments. **EXPERIENCE** Typically requires a minimum of 1 \- 2 years of related experience. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Provide service and customer support during field visits and onsite print trials. * Travel to customer sites to perform equipment installation, repair, maintenance and testing. * Diagnose technical issues, determine and implement proper solutions. * Provide pre\-sales samples for future business opportunities. * Create and modify graphics appropriate for the best images for customer samples. * Performs basic experiments and tests on varied electromechanical systems in a laboratory environment. * Performs basic set up of equipment in a laboratory environment. * Correlates and reports results and observations of testing and experiments to engineering using databases and spreadsheet computer programs. * Produce timely and detailed service reports. * Works from written/verbal instructions, specifications, technical manuals and engineering sketches. * Uses a variety of imaging equipment and software associated with image manipulation. Basic repairs to test equipment and components, if applicable. * Performs testing of customized inkjet systems. * Assembles, disassembles, modifies, reworks, refurbishes, repairs, reassembles and tests units as required, using: * Blueprints, sketches, engineering specifications and standard testing equipment, applying knowledge of mechanical, electrical and optical interrelations. * Compiles and records test results. * Usage of computer skills such as Excel, Word and database applications. * Works closely with customers, engineers and senior technicians. * Travel domestically and abroad – Extensive travel may be required. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * None **QUALIFICATIONS:** *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* REQUIRED: * High school degree or equivalent and 1\-2 years of related experience. * Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office product suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) * Knowledge of basic wiring, mechanical workings and electronics. * Strong attention to detail. * Effective writ tively present information and respond to questions from customers, engineers, peers and management. * Ability to create / manipulate graphic imaging in various formats and programs. * Ability to understand the various graphic formats required by FIS printers to create graphics for printing. * Familiar with Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator. * Basic knowledge of color and color science; screening and halftone techniques. * Ability to work from a foreign site with limited infrastructure or oversight. * Ability to travel domestic and abroad, either alone or as a part of a team. DESIRED: * Two\-year technical degree **PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or stand to use hands to manipulate, handle, touch and connect parts. * Standing or walking is required more than 30% of the day. * The employee frequently is required to use a word processor and calculator. * The employee frequently is required to speak and listen. * The employee is regularly required to stand, walk and reach with hands and arms. * The employee will occasionally lift and/or move items up to 10 pounds and will very occasionally be required to move items in the 25 to 75 lb. range. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. * Travel 25%\-75%. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** *The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * Heavy Travel, at times with short notice (same day on occasion). * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to low. * Engineering laboratory environment. * Exposure to electrical, thermal and/or chemical hazards. * May potentially handle hazardous waste in accordance with the safe work practices defined in Hazardous Communication and Hazardous Waste training programs. Initial training is required upon hiring status and every 3 years thereafter. Employees handling hazardous waste will insure that waste containers in their work areas are properly labeled and dated. Employees will ensure that waste containers are closed after transferring waste to them. Report any incidents involving hazardous waste to supervisor. **OTHER:** * Other duties as may be assigned. * Each employee’s primary objective is to assure that the quality, delivery and cost controls within his/her control meet or exceed all of our internal and external customers’ requirements. * Each employee is required to abide by the Employee Handbook and the rules and regulations explained and provided at each orientation and training session. Special attention must be given to the safety aspects of these documents. **FUJIFILM Dimatix provides competitive wages, a generous benefits package and a friendly, dynamic working environment.** *Equal Opportunity Employer* *FUJIFILM Dimatix is an E\-Verify Employer* *EO\-employer\-M/F/Vets/Disabled* **EEO Information** ------------------- Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc. **ADA Information** ------------------- If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department (fdmxbenefits@fujifilm.com).

jobs.description: Job Description Software Developer (m/f/d) Job Location: Augsburg, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hannover Chicago Lane, München, Nürnberg, Stuttgart Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country Req Id: 12651 Posting Start Date: 9/24/26 At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935\.
