jobs.title: Commercial HVAC Projects coordinator/ sales
jobs.description: **Commercial HVAC Project Sales \& Coordinator** **Hi\-Tek Mechanical, Inc.** is seeking an experienced **Commercial HVAC Project Sales \& Coordinator** who can take ownership of HVAC projects from the initial customer opportunity through final completion. This is **not strictly an office project coordinator position and not strictly a sales position**. We are looking for someone who understands commercial HVAC, can identify and sell project opportunities, build scopes and proposals, and then coordinate the work they sell through successful completion. The right person should be comfortable walking a jobsite, talking with building owners, property managers, general contractors, vendors, and technicians, developing a clear scope of work, pricing the project, closing the work, and then making sure the project is properly executed. Responsibilities * Develop and sell commercial HVAC project opportunities, including equipment replacements, tenant improvements, retrofit work, system upgrades, controls, ductwork, and other mechanical projects. * Perform job walks and evaluate project requirements. * Develop detailed scopes of work and professional customer proposals. * Prepare project estimates including equipment, material, labor, subcontractors, crane/rigging, controls, TAB, permits, and other project costs. * Follow up on proposals and work directly with customers to close projects. * Build and maintain relationships with property managers, building owners, general contractors, facility managers, and existing customers. * Review plans, specifications, equipment schedules, and mechanical drawings. * Coordinate equipment selections and verify model numbers, capacities, electrical requirements, accessories, lead times, and project requirements before ordering. * Prepare and manage equipment and material submittals. * Coordinate equipment ordering, material purchasing, deliveries, crane/rigging, subcontractors, and project scheduling. * Work closely with field technicians and installers to ensure they have the correct information and materials before the project begins. * Coordinate projects with customers, general contractors, building engineers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal staff. * Manage RFIs, change orders, scheduling conflicts, and field conditions as they arise. * Track project costs and labor to protect estimated gross profit. * Identify additional work and change\-order opportunities during project execution. * Conduct site visits throughout the project as necessary. * Maintain communication with the customer from initial proposal through project completion. * Ensure completed projects are properly documented, closed out, and ready for billing. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who understands that selling the project is only the beginning. You should be able to look at an HVAC project and understand **what it will actually take to complete the job**, not simply prepare a price and hand it off to someone else. The ideal candidate has experience with: * Commercial HVAC project sales * HVAC estimating and proposal development * Commercial HVAC equipment and system applications * Package units, split systems, heat pumps, mini\-splits/VRF systems, air handlers, exhaust systems, ductwork, controls, and related mechanical systems * Reading mechanical plans and equipment schedules * Equipment selection and ordering * Tenant improvement and retrofit construction * Working with general contractors and property management companies * Project scheduling and field coordination * Submittals, RFIs, change orders, and closeout documentation * Managing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and project costs * Microsoft Excel and general project\-management software Experience with **Bluebeam, Procore, Service Fusion, or similar platforms** is helpful but not required. The Person We Want This position requires someone who is organized but also willing to get out of the office. You should be comfortable meeting customers, walking mechanical rooms and rooftops, working with technicians, calling vendors, reviewing equipment selections, solving project problems, and following up on proposals. We are looking for someone who: * Has strong commercial HVAC knowledge * Can communicate professionally with customers and field personnel * Is comfortable selling and asking for the job * Understands project costs and gross margin * Takes ownership instead of waiting for someone else to solve problems * Can manage multiple projects and proposals at the same time * Pays close attention to equipment selections and project details * Understands the importance of getting the scope right before work begins * Can recognize additional project opportunities while working with existing customers Preferred Experience **3\+ years of commercial HVAC experience** in project sales, estimating, project management, or a combination of these roles is preferred. Candidates with strong commercial HVAC field experience who have moved into estimating, sales, or project management are also encouraged to apply. A mechanical engineering degree is **not required**. Practical commercial HVAC knowledge and the ability to successfully sell and execute projects are more important to us. About Hi\-Tek Mechanical Hi\-Tek Mechanical, Inc. is a commercial HVAC contractor serving Southern California. We work with property managers, building owners, general contractors, and commercial clients on HVAC service, preventative maintenance, equipment replacements, tenant improvements, and mechanical projects. We are looking for someone who wants to help grow our project division while taking responsibility for delivering quality work to our customers. **If you know commercial HVAC, know how to sell work, and know how to take a project from a job walk to a completed installation, we want to talk to you.** Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Materials Manager
jobs.description: **Location:** Michigan City, Indiana, United States **Job ID:** R0146062 **Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-23 **Company Name:** HITACHI GLOBAL AIR POWER US, LLC **Profession (Job Category):** Production \& Skilled Trades **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The Company** We build the machines that power industry. We are Hitachi Global Air Power, a leading global industrial compressed air manufacturer driving the innovations that keep the world moving. From our headquarters in Michigan City, Indiana, our compressed air solutions power manufacturing operations all around the globe; from food and beverage to life\-saving pharmaceuticals and cutting\-edge semiconductor chips. Our portable compressors provide the air power to build roads and bridges, lay pipelines and aid in oil and gas mining and production. We are a team of innovators, engineers, and quality experts with a shared vision to create the next generation of efficient, environment\-forward compressed air solutions that meet the demands of today, while boldly contributing to a sustainable, circular economy. With more than 60 years of legacy and trusted performance through our brands \- Hitachi, Sullair, and Champion (Australia), we are proud of our reputation for reliability, durability, and performance and groundbreaking engineering. Join us in building a future where your work has an impact. At Hitachi Global Air Power, you’ll be part of a global network that’s shaping the future of industrial power. **Summary of the position:** The Materials Manager oversees material\-related operations to ensure that all incoming and outgoing inventory is processed for Hitachi Global Air Power US, LLC (HGAP). Responsible for material storage and movement within several manufacturing and storage facilities to ensure manufacturing lines receive the correct material when needed. This position is located at the Hitachi Global Air Power manufacturing plant in Michigan City, Indiana, and reports to the Vice President of Operations. **Key Accountabilities:** * Ensure all Inventories are aligned with Sales Product Strategy and Production needs meeting Customer On\-Time delivery expectations. Improve warehouse layout to drive sustainable inventory and production plans that meet the business financial targets and meet or exceed our customer and shareholder expectations. * **Duties and responsibilities:** * Manage material inventory control, shipping and receiving, handling, and storage throughout manufacturing and storage facilities in support of production to ensure delivery demands and schedules are met. * Identify opportunities to reduce transportation, storage, and handling costs. * Strategize about inventory volumes and storage capacity to maximize productivity, rearranging containers for improved efficiency while allowing material handlers to easily navigate between aisles. * Support transformation efforts to digitally transform material handling systems such as automated guided vehicle systems (AGVs), autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), and collaborative robotic arms (cobots) for palletizing. * Maintain balanced workloads by shifting assignments, workers and other resources under own control to achieve the most effective material handling and material processing operations. * Explain work requirements, methods, and procedures; instruct workers in new procedures; and provide advice when problems arise. * Adjust plans, assignments, and methods as necessary to accomplish the work effectively and economically. * Coordinate activities with manufacturing, purchasing, engineering, planning, and quality departments to resolve material shortages. * Provide weekly schedules for direct reports, including starting/ending times, as well as overtime hours. * Monitor overtime hours to stay within budget while maintaining adequate coverage to support operations. * Hold direct reports accountable to uphold Sullair values and policies; issue discipline as required in conjunction with the Human Resource Department. * Review and execute corrective actions for Near Miss and Recordable safety incidents. Oversee proactive audits for discoveries of potential safety\-related issues. **Qualifications:** **Education** : * Bachelor’s degree in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics * Graduate degree in a logistics\- or business\-related field a plus * Material Management certification, such as CPIM, CSCP, CLTD, and CLT, a plus **Professional experience:** * Five plus years of experience in material management, including inventory management systems. * Ability to establish self as credible leader and partner with site leadership as a trusted member of staff. * Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn. * Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively. * Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed. * Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision\-maker, collaborative. * Problem solver: analytical\-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker. * Working knowledge of Inventory Control Software, SAP, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access). **Key behaviors:** * Lifting up to 35 lbs, lifting over 35 lbs. requires a lifting device, crane, or assistance from another associate * Standing and walking minimum of 8 hours, must be able to bend/stoop, squat/crouch, kneel and twist * Must understand and comply with Sullair Safety Standards **Physical requirements:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk, talk, and/or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, sit, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. **Direct reports:** * Material Handler Supervisors Shipping / Receiving Supervisor * The successful candidate is responsible for complying with Hitachi Global Air Power US Code of Ethics and related policies. In performing the job, the incumbent shall take all steps necessary to comply with our safety rules and requirements and must actively support the organization's efforts to meet and exceed its goals of creating and maintaining a safe workplace. This description is to serve as a guide. It is intended to be flexible and will continue to evolve over time with business needs and demands and may be updated periodically and at the Company's discretion. jobs.title: Agentic AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: Primary Work Address: 19700 Helix Drive, Ashburn, VA, 20147 The Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Janelia Research Campus is a pioneering research center in Ashburn, Virginia, where scientists pursue fundamental questions in the life sciences. Our integrated teams of biologists, computational scientists, and tool\-builders innovate research practices and technologies to solve biology’s deepest mysteries. HHMI launched Janelia in 2006, establishing an intellectually enriching environment for scientists to do creative, collaborative, hands\-on work. We share our methods, results, and tools with the scientific community. AI@HHMI at Janelia integrates AI agents across the research process. These tools write and execute code, optimize experimental and model parameters, and drive instruments. Letting AI agents act on shared research infrastructure requires serious safety engineering. The relevant failure mode is usually not a malicious attacker but a capable, misdirected tool running with legitimate user permissions at machine speed: hallucinated commands, instructions hijacked by retrieved content, runaway loops, sandbox escapes. We are hiring the engineer who owns this problem. **The role** ------------ You will research, develop, deploy, operate, and analyze the safety stack for agentic AI at Janelia: * **Sandboxing.** Hardened, reproducible execution environments for agent code (kernel\- and VM\-level isolation, network egress control) on our OpenShift platform and HPC cluster, validated by adversarial testing. * **Guardrails.** Policy enforcement on agent inputs, outputs, and tool calls; judge models; human approval gates; independent safeguard services that sessions can be routed through, individually or chained. * **Observability.** Attributable audit logging, full\-trace capture, real\-time monitoring, and post\-incident analysis of agent sessions. You will join early enough to make the foundational architecture decisions, and you will operate what you design. We expect and support open\-sourcing and publishing this work. **The environment** ------------------- A large NVIDIA GPU cluster (B300/H200/H100 class) running self\-hosted open\-weight models and frontier commercial models; collaborations with industry (Anthropic and Google); scientists across biology, physics, and ML as your users; the long\-term stability of a philanthropy\-funded research institute. **What we look for** -------------------- * Hands\-on experience operating LLM agents and dealing with their failures, or deep sandbox/container\-security expertise with clear ability to move into the agentic domain. * Linux and Kubernetes/OpenShift isolation depth, including a precise understanding of the difference between containerization and sandboxing. * Working knowledge of agent architectures: tool\-calling protocols (e.g., MCP), approval gates, judge models, guardrail frameworks, and the limits of each. * Evidence over certifications: open\-source contributions, publications or technical writing, disclosed findings, or production systems you can discuss in depth. * Minimum 5 years in security, systems/SRE, or ML systems engineering. **To apply:** include a link to something you have built, broken, or written. **Physical Requirements** Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. jobs.description: **Senior Associate Design Engineer \- Aiken, SC** ================================================= **Date:** Sep 24, 2026 **Location:** Aiken, SC, US, 29801 **Company:** Hubbell Incorporated **Job Overview** ---------------- This role will be responsible for technical maintenance and design improvement of HV (High Voltage) / EHV (Extra High Voltage) substation, distribution and/or transmission products, including surge arresters and metal oxide varistors. The senior associate design engineer will be responsible for technical aspects of existing designs, including continuous improvement, as well as new product development activities. A strong cross\-disciplinary background is advantageous, as design projects may involve aspects of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or materials science (electrical ceramics, polymers). \#LI\-SL1 **A Day In The Life** --------------------- * Perform 3D CAD modeling and detail drawings, assist in patent searches, do necessary calculations, select materials, determine and coordinate tests, review and analyze costs, and solve design related problems * Complete significant design projects including New Product Development, working independently or within a small project team * Interface with customers, provide technical assistance when required, and develop knowledge of applicable industry standards * Propose and help to implement cost improvement actions * Contribute ideas for design projects (both new and revised) and recommend new uses for existing products * Collaborate with manufacturing on product design, tooling development, and manufacturing processes for assigned projects, and assist pilot runs and first article inspections * Implement corrective actions, process deviations, engineering change requests, drawing updates, and related activities. * Perform root cause analysis for product field failures within assigned product families. * Develop proficiency in use of Inventor, AutoCad, and related systems for management of engineering\-controlled drawings. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- * Experience related to the design of high voltage electrical components, circuits, and/or materials * B.S. Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field * 2\-5 years of industry experience * Experience with AutoCAD / Inventor, ElecNet, Coulomb or related software packages (3D CAD and/or FEA experience is preferred) * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with teammates * Excellent organizational and analytical skills * Experience with project management methodology is advantageous * Ability to develop detailed work plans, schedules and specifications **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Utility Solutions** Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. jobs.description: Husky TechnologiesTM is a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky TechnologiesTM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM United States manufacturing facility is located in Milton, Vermont on a large, beautiful campus located just 30 minutes north of downtown Burlington, Vermont. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment, competitive total compensation and attractive benefits package. Additional things you might like to know about working at Husky TechnologiesTM in Milton, Vermont; * 200,000 square foot bright, clean machine shop * Shift work premiums (25% afternoon shift and 40% evening shift) * Annual incentive bonus * Outstanding 401k contribution and match program * 700 acres of private land to walk, bike, run or cross country ski * On site gym facility * On site cafeteria * Opportunity to work for a world class company with great people Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Range: $125,000\-$155,000 Vacancy: ADD Are you interested in developing new products and technologies? Have experience defining and developing tooling for the packaging market? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic learning environment? Are you interested in joining a team of innovative engineers working for the leading global supplier of injection molding equipment for the plastic industry? If you answered yes, this role is for you. Our Development Engineering team is looking to hire an experienced Product Development Engineer. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of packaging products working with business development, completing engineering, and subsequent launch into our manufacturing operations. **Role Description:** * System level design with limited guidance, frequently in the absence of specific design standards. * Product Architect * Participate in the formulation and/or evaluation of business cases. * Work within a team of Engineers/Design Specialists in the development of new Injection Molding tooling products following appropriate steps within a formal product development process. * Guide and approve the content of design documents and validation plans. * Contribute to, verify and monitor engineering documentation. * Apply scientific/engineering principles design execution. * Sizing and selection of components (for example, but not limited to linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Provide leadership, mentoring and training to team members. * Create system level concept designs in various levels of detail including function block diagrams, CAD layouts, functional decomposition. * Lead and contribute to design reviews and brainstorming sessions. Responsible for decision making in the context of product definition and architecture. * Participate in or lead continuous improvement activities. * Verify all concept and systems level process steps of the product development process and Product Release process are followed. * Drives the product development process levering team collaboration. * Design risk mitigation including participation or facilitation of FMEA. * Champion of product compliance with regulatory requirements. * Cross discipline interaction and communication including cross discipline inputs – Business Development, Analysis, Electrical, Software, Fluid Power, Metallurgy, Manufacturing, Validation/Test. * Represent Husky technically in front of customers, suppliers and technical partners. * Represent the Innovation and Sustainability department in front of internal customers including the executive. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering **Qualifications and Skills:** * 10 \+ years of design experience in a relevant industry. * Excellent communication (verbal and written) and strong presentation skills. * Specialized knowledge of products, tools, standards, processes and technology. * Specialized knowledge within injection molding, tooling and or plastics processing market. * Skilled in CAD modeling techniques – Unigraphics preferred. * Expert in calculating design parameters and applying engineering principles to design. * Strong time management and organizational skills for maximum efficiency. * Illustrates attention to detail when completing tasks. * Strong problem\-solving skills. * Advanced creativity and innovation skills. * Strong sense of ownership. * Advanced understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes related to injection molding tooling. * A flexible team player. * Demonstrated ability to lead and work both autonomously, and as part of a highly cohesive cross functional team. * Experience selecting appropriate materials and sizing various components. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please. If you need special assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at talent@husky.ca. Equal Opportunity Employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. jobs.description: Hourly Rate: $27\.58 Hourly Wage: $27\.58 **JOB SUMMARY** Responds and attends to guest repair requests. Communicates with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Performs preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspects tools, equipment, or machines. jobs.title: Engineer Tech
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Engineering Technician provides technical support for a high\-volume roll forming and value\-added manufacturing operation. This position serves as a key resource for troubleshooting production equipment and processes, working closely with Maintenance, Production Supervision, and Process Engineering. The primary reporting and work direction for this role will come from Process Engineering Management. The Engineering Technician is responsible for supporting equipment reliability, process improvements, new product introductions, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires a strong hands\-on background in PLCs, hydraulics, pneumatics, electrical systems, robotics and mechanical troubleshooting within a manufacturing environment. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Equipment and Process Support** * Troubleshoot and resolve production equipment issues involving PLC controls, hydraulics, pneumatics, electrical systems, and mechanical components. * Support maintenance personnel in diagnosing and correcting complex equipment failures. * Assist production teams in minimizing downtime and improving overall equipment effectiveness (OEE). * Analyze recurring equipment and process issues and recommend corrective actions. * Support root cause investigations and implementation of permanent corrective measures. **Process Engineering Support** * Work directly with Process Engineering Management to develop, improve, and standardize manufacturing processes. * Assist in establishing process parameters and operating standards for roll forming and value\-added operations. * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and cost reduction. * Develop and maintain process documentation, work instructions, setup sheets, and troubleshooting guides. * Support process validation and capability studies. **New Product Introduction** * Assist with onboarding and launch of new products into production. * Support tooling trials, process development, and production startup activities. * Coordinate with engineering, maintenance, quality, and operations personnel to ensure successful product implementation. * Evaluate production readiness and recommend process improvements prior to full\-scale production. **Project and Technical Support** * Assist with equipment upgrades, modifications, and automation projects. * Support installation and commissioning of new machinery and production equipment. * Participate in capital improvement projects and equipment evaluations. * Maintain technical records, drawings, schematics, and process documentation. **Safety and Quality** * Promote and support a safe work environment and compliance with all company safety policies. * Support quality initiatives by identifying and addressing process variation and equipment\-related quality concerns. * Participate in corrective and preventive action activities related to customer and internal quality issues. **Qualifications** **Education** * Associate degree in Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, or a related technical field preferred. * Equivalent combination of education and manufacturing experience will be considered. **Experience** * 3\+ years of manufacturing, maintenance, engineering technician, or related industrial experience preferred. * Experience in roll forming, metal fabrication, stamping, or similar manufacturing environments strongly preferred. * Experience supporting automated production equipment and industrial controls. **Technical Skills** * Strong PLC troubleshooting skills (programming experience is a plus). * Knowledge of hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and mechanical systems. * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, hydraulic diagrams, and mechanical drawings. * Experience with process development and continuous improvement methodologies. * Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and root cause analysis techniques. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and basic engineering software applications. **Competencies** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities. * Hands\-on approach with a willingness to work directly on the production floor. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, maintenance, quality, and operations teams. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moving equipment, noise, and varying temperatures. * Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 50 pounds as needed. * Ability to safely access production equipment for troubleshooting and process support. * Willingness to flex schedule and work overtime where necessary to support operations **Reporting Structure** * Primary Direction: Process Engineering Manager * Works Closely With: Maintenance, Production Supervision, Quality, Tooling, and Operations Personnel

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description **Senior Data Engineer** **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with a strong foundation in modern data engineering, DevOps, and cloud data platforms. The primary focus of this role is designing, building, and operating scalable, reliable data pipelines and data products that support analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the organization. In addition to building and operating reliable data pipelines, this role will contribute to automation, data quality, metadata management, and governance workflows. The successful candidate will bring strong data engineering expertise and an interest in expanding their knowledge of data governance and AI\-enabled automation as these capabilities continue to evolve. While our current platform is centered on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, we welcome candidates with strong data engineering experience on AWS, Databricks, or other modern data platforms, provided their skills are transferable and they demonstrate strong data engineering fundamentals. **How This Role Is Different** This role is for a senior data engineer who enjoys building modern data platforms, scalable data pipelines, and trusted data products. The primary focus will be delivering high\-quality data engineering solutions that support business, analytics, and AI needs. The individual will also have opportunities to contribute to governance patterns, platform automation, and controls embedded within CI/CD processes while developing these skills as the organization's capabilities mature. **Key Responsibilities** Data Engineering Foundations Data Governance \& Platform Stewardship AI \& Automation Enablement DevOps \& Platform Enablement Design, build, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines on modern cloud data platforms. Develop robust ETL/ELT processes using SQL, Python, and PySpark with strong error handling, monitoring, and cost awareness. Implement layered / medallion data architectures and analytics\-ready data models to support BI and AI workloads. Partner with analysts and data scientists to deliver trusted, production\-grade data assets. **Data \& AI Governance (Primary Focus)** Partner with platform and business stakeholders to support and enhance data governance practices using Microsoft Purview or comparable governance platforms. Contribute to governance standards and best practices for data products, analytics solutions, AI/ML features, and agent\-based workflows as organizational capabilities continue to evolve. Help incorporate governance considerations into platform workflows and data engineering practices rather than treating governance as an after\-the\-fact process. Support ongoing data and AI governance initiatives and grow into greater ownership of governance patterns as experience and organizational standards evolve. **AI Agents \& Automation** Contribute to the design and implementation of AI\-enabled tools and automation workflows that support data platform and governance operations. Partner with technical teams to explore and develop automation that assists with metadata enrichment, data quality checks, anomaly detection, and governance workflows. Help ensure AI\-enabled tools and automation operate only on approved, governed data sources with appropriate logging and auditability. Build knowledge of evolving AI governance patterns, including agent lifecycle management and input/output traceability, with support from the broader team. **DevOps \& Platform Enablement** Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data and AI assets. Promote infrastructure\-as\-code practices (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent) for repeatable, governed environments. Define environment promotion paths (dev, test, prod) with embedded governance and policy checks. **What Success Looks Like in This Role** Reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products support business reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives. Data assets are discoverable, trusted, and auditable, with governance considerations incorporated into the platform. The individual contributes to safe automation of platform and governance workflows while continuing to build AI and governance expertise. Teams scale analytics and AI capabilities while maintaining data quality, security, and operational efficiency. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree AND 5\+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform engineering in a production environment. * SQL and hands\-on experience with Python and PySpark. * Experience in data engineering on at least one major cloud or data platform (Azure, AWS, Databricks, or equivalent), with skills that are transferable across platforms. * Experience with Git\-based development and CI/CD practices. * Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as cataloging, lineage, data quality, or access control. * Demonstrated engineering judgment and the ability to balance delivery speed, reliability, safety, and governance considerations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Exposure to Microsoft Purview or comparable data governance platforms. Interest in or experience supporting AI agents, LLM\-based automation, intelligent assistants, or other automation for operational or platform workflows. Exposure to embedding governance controls into DevOps workflows or an interest in developing a policy\-as\-code mindset. * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks\-centric architectures, and the ability to learn new platforms quickly. **Bot and Third\-Party Applications** Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. **Working at ICF** ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting\-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. **Pay Range** \- There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Wells Engineering
jobs.description: **Company Description** At IPT Global your models won't die in a pilot. With a team of around 100 people, you'll work directly with the people making operational decisions and see the impact of your work quickly. Check out https://iptglobal.com/careers/ for more information on our world\-class team. **Job Description** We're looking for an engineer who knows how wells are designed, drilled, and completed, and wants to spend their time building the models that make that work safer, faster, and cheaper. You'll turn well barrier assurance and verification data into predictions and recommendations that engineering and operations teams use to make real decisions, and you'll own that work end to end, from understanding the problem on the rig to putting a working model in front of the people who need it. This role is a strong fit for a drilling, completions, wells, or well integrity engineer who has already been writing Python and building models alongside their day job and wants to make that the job. We'll support you in deepening your machine learning skills; what we can't teach is the operational intuition you bring. **What you'll work on** * Building models to support pressure test interpretation, including positive and inflow tests * Evaluating time series data from well control equipment, such as BOPs and associated control systems, and developing predictive maintenance models * Developing monitoring models for sustained or abnormal annulus pressure behavior across the well lifecycle * Tracking barrier element status and verification history to surface gaps and prioritize integrity work * Cleaning and structuring data into something models can trust * Explaining model results clearly to wells engineers, integrity teams, and leadership, including when the model shouldn't be trusted **Qualifications** **What you bring** * A degree in petroleum, mechanical, or a related engineering discipline * Demonstrable hands\-on wells engineering or well integrity experience at an operator, drilling contractor, or oilfield services company * Working proficiency in with range of data science tools * At least one model or analytical tool you built that was actually used to inform engineering or operational decisions * A solid grasp of statistics and the judgment to know when an engineering assessment beats a data\-driven one **Nice to have** * Experience with well integrity management systems or barrier assurance workflows * Experience with time series analysis or anomaly detection on pressure and sensor data * Exposure to cloud platforms or deploying models into production * SQL experience **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. https://iptglobal.com/careers/

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** The AI for Data team builds and ships state of the art machine learning solutions to support data lifecycle within the enterprise. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver personalized experiences to our data and platform users to drive productivity and innovation. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate and create next generation experiences powered by the latest emerging ML technologies. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data * Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. * Technical. You’re comfortable with open\-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience developing data science solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms. * Statistically\-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and back tested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. * A data guru. "Big data" doesn't faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. jobs.title: REMOTE - Lead MLOps Engineer (Databricks)
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/23/2026 Description **Overview** Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a \#1 team and do some good! **REMOTE:**Qualified candidates living outside a 50\-mile radius of a hub location listed below can plan to work remote. **HYBRID:** Qualified candidates living within a 50\-mile radius of a hub location listed below should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Bloomington, IL; Dunwoody, GA; Richardson, TX; or Tempe, AZ **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** **Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential** **Responsibilities** At the State Farm Applied Innovation Lab, we’re building an Agentic SDLC control plane, where GenAI helps with every part of how we build, test, deploy, and run software. We’re looking for someone who has run real workloads on Databricks in production and knows Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow inside and out. Just as important, they already work the way we do, reaching for agentic tools naturally whether they’re building something new or tracking down a bug. If you’re happiest at the command line, you’ll feel right at home here. In this role, you’ll own the performance, quality, and production\-readiness of select innovation projects running on Databricks – the ones where we dig deep to learn what excellence really looks like, then turn those lessons into patterns we can reuse on future projects. Other teams take care of the platform and infrastructure; you’ll own the layer above it: the data foundations, governance, FinOps, lineage, runbooks, and the handoff to Enterprise Technology. When a project leaves our hands, it’s fully governed, tagged at the project level, and optimized for cost, with a low L3 incident rate, complete runbooks, and self\-healing wherever possible. This is a lead individual contributor role: you’ll set technical direction and raise the bar across teams without managing people. You’ll partner with teams across the enterprise, take on hard problems on Databricks, and help shape how we put the platform’s newest capabilities to work on the goals that matter most to State Farm. The IT Manager is responsible for the support of company applications, technologies, and/or infrastructure across the organization, serving as a business and technical liaison between internal and external customers. Manages cross functional planning and project teams in the establishment, design and implementation of new or revised systems and programs. Manages direct reports, providing timely and insightful direction and coaching on roles, responsibilities, business strategy, and customer\-driven culture expectations. Some of the IT Manager responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Provides leadership and oversight to direct reports and team by establishing goals, providing coaching and feedback, evaluating performance, and supporting development and training initiatives * Establishes and maintains strong business relationships with both senior and operating level business leaders across the organization, customers and vendors. * Be a thought partner to the team and business units, providing recommendations for improvement of business processes by leveraging existing IT capabilities and/or defining new strategic IT capabilities. * Acts as the point of contact for escalated department/team issues and facilitate the prioritization process. * Establish and reinforce clean\-code practices, reusable components, automated testing and engineering standards that improve maintainability and reduce technical debt. * Advance DevSecOps capabilities, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, observability, environment management and operational readiness. * Promote responsible adoption of AI and GenAI across software development, testing, modernization, support and developer productivity while aligning with security, risk and governance expectations. * Manages and leads projects and project life cycle; accountable for identifying needs, securing commitments and monitoring progress of deliverables. Meets scheduled milestones to ensure project/program objectives are met. * Participate in key IT and assigned business unit governance, planning and initiative review teams, committees and meetings. **The expertise you bring** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or other related field or equivalent work experience. * 7–10 years of IT and software engineering experience, including hands\-on application development and leadership of complex delivery or modernization initiatives. * Prior people management, supervisory or technical team leadership experience, with demonstrated success coaching and developing engineers. * Strong technical experience with .NET Core, React, Java and Microsoft Azure in enterprise application environments. * Strong service and API development experience, including RESTful design, integration patterns, security, performance, observability and operational support. * Experience with modern software engineering practices, agile delivery, automated testing, DevOps/DevSecOps, CI/CD and cloud\-based delivery. * Practical experience applying AI and GenAI to software development, testing, modernization, operations or developer productivity. * Advanced understanding of IT applications and technologies. Once the role is filled, this job posting will be removed.* **Why choose Intact** **We live our Values:** We are committed to acting with the highest of ethical standards through our five core values: integrity, respect, customer driven, excellence and social responsibility. **Our commitment to Diversity:** Founded in our values, we see diversity as a strength and aspire to create an environment where everyone can be themselves, grow and succeed. We are committed to creating a positive and supportive environment in which you perform your best. Our Time\-Off and Flexible Work Arrangement options help foster a healthy work\-life balance. jobs.title: Senior Staff Business Systems Analyst – Legal Technology
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Intuit FLP (Finance, Legal, and Privacy) Tech team builds Intuit’s core capabilities across enterprise finance, legal, and privacy applications. Our stakeholders include Intuit’s finance team, the Legal, Compliance, and Policy Organization (LCPO), segment business unit leaders, and all Intuit employees. As Intuit consolidates and standardizes backend processes onto common capabilities, we evaluate every solution through a rigorous Build vs. Buy lens. LCPO is in the middle of the most significant technology transformation — consolidating a fragmented estate onto a modern service delivery platform, building a knowledge and data spine underneath it, and moving from AI\-assisted professionals toward agentic orchestration of legal work. FLP Tech is hiring a Staff Business Systems Analyst for Legal Technology to own that transformation end to end. This is not a requirements\-taking role. You will own the Legal Technology portfolio and roadmap: partnering with LCPO Solutions \& Strategy and the legal practice groups to envision where legal technology should go over the next two to three years, converting that vision into a prioritized, sequenced roadmap, and working with FLP Tech engineering and cross\-functional technology teams across Intuit to deliver it. The role sits deliberately at the intersection of product management and business systems analysis. You will be as comfortable defending a multi\-year platform strategy to senior leaders as you are writing the acceptance criteria for a single intake workflow. You are accountable for the outcome, not the artifact — if the workflow ships and nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve. **Responsibilities** * Vision, Portfolio \& Roadmap. Define and own the multi\-year Legal Technology roadmap and the single authoritative view of Legal Tech investment — initiatives, sequencing, dependencies, capacity, and status. Run the operating rhythm that keeps it honest: portfolio and roadmap reviews with LCPO and FLP Tech leadership, and clear escalation with recommended paths when something is off track. * Stakeholder Partnership \& Requirements. Act as the primary partner to Legal Practice Groups (Privacy, Corporate Affairs, Litigations, Regulatory, Compliance \& Risk, etc.) to gather requirements, conduct user research, and translate insights into technical requirements. . * Unified Orchestration. Own the roadmap for the unified legal front door — omni\-channel intake from Slack, email, Jira and web, smart triage and routing, SLA management and status transparency — and the migration of legacy workflows onto the target platform without losing capability, integrations or audit history. * Build vs. Buy Governance. Apply an 80% configure / 20% build lens across the LCPO estate. Run structured vendor evaluations end to end — scoring rubrics, demos, proofs of concept, reference checks, security and privacy review, total cost of ownership — build the business case, drive it to a decision with senior stakeholders, and own the implementation you recommended. * Solution Design \& Integration. Lead fit\-gap analysis and design the integrations that connect the service delivery layer with CLM, eDiscovery, matter management and outside counsel billing, procurement, identity, and the enterprise data platform. You do not need to write production code, but you must understand APIs, data models and authentication well enough to design realistic solutions and call out unrealistic ones. * AI Innovation \& Prototyping. Build prototypes and run pilots for Generative AI, knowledge management and agentic workflows that eliminate repetitive legal work and institutionalize legal expertise. Critically evaluate AI capabilities inside vendor platforms, and define where human\-in\-the\-loop oversight, evaluation and audit controls belong. * Data \& Measurement. Establish a baseline and a target for every initiative before work begins. Partner with data engineering and analytics to build the reporting that shows portfolio health, adoption, cycle time and toil reduction — and use that data to reprioritize. * Delivery, Adoption \& Craft Leadership. Drive end\-to\-end delivery with FLP Tech engineering and architecture, and with systems integrators where they are engaged — helping shape the statement of work and holding delivery to it. As a Staff\-level individual contributor, set the craft standard for requirements, solution design and business cases across the Legal Tech team, including contingent workers and partner teams. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years delivering enterprise software products or business systems solutions as a business systems analyst, technical product manager, or solution owner — including meaningful time supporting a legal, compliance, finance or other regulated business function. * Portfolio \& Roadmap Ownership: You have built and executed a multi\-year roadmap balancing new capability, platform health and run\-the\-business demand, and can show how you made prioritization trade\-offs and defended them. * Business Analysis Craft: Requirements elicitation, process mapping and redesign, use case and user story writing, data mapping, test strategy and UAT. You write specifications that engineers and non\-technical stakeholders can both act on without losing fidelity. * Legal Domain Expertise: Familiarity with legal workflows — matter intake and triage, Contract Lifecycle Management, eDiscovery and legal holds, regulatory monitoring, outside counsel management and accruals, intellectual property, marketing compliance, and privacy operations. Legal Tech Stack Expertise: * Orchestration / Low\-Code: ServiceNow, Tonkean, Workato or similar — with hands\-on configuration experience, not just oversight. * Legal\-Specific Tools: Ironclad, Legal Tracker, Exterro, or comparable CLM, matter management and eDiscovery platforms. * Data \& Analytics: data lake (e.g.AWS, GCP) and BI solutions (e.g.Databricks, Qlik, Tableau). * Emerging Legal AI: Harvey, Hebbia, Eudia or similar, and the evaluation judgment to separate capability from demo. Staff\-Level Craft: * Technical Acumen: strong understanding of API strategies, integration patterns, identity and access, and AI/ML workflows with human\-in\-the\-loop design. * Analytical Thinking: uses data to find the bottleneck and proposes the scalable, automated fix. * Decision Ownership: sets the evaluation criteria, makes the technology call, and owns the consequences. * AI Fluency: an active, critical user of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) in your own delivery work, with a clear view of where AI creates leverage and where it does not. Soft Skills \& Leadership: * Master Translator: bridges legal counsel and engineering without losing fidelity in either direction, and communicates complex trade\-offs to senior executives through compelling narrative. * Ambiguity Navigator: thrives on a blank slate; creates the roadmap where none exists. * Influence Without Authority: builds trust quickly across Legal, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Privacy and Procurement, and moves decisions forward when nobody in the room reports to you. * Education: BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or equivalent work experience is preferred. A background in Legal Operations is a significant plus. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $187,500 \- $253,500 San Diego, CA $172,500\- $233,000
