jobs.description: * JR10001334 * On Site * Madison, Wisconsin * Instructional **Job Category:** ----------------- Academic Staff **Employment Type:** -------------------- Regular **Job Profile:** ---------------- Radiation Oncology Medical Physicist **Job Summary:** ---------------- It’s an exciting and transformational time to join the University of Wisconsin! The Radiation Oncology Physics Section in the Department of Radiation Medicine at the UW–Madison School of Medicine and Public Health is seeking a dynamic, collaborative Director of Clinical Physics. We are a highly engaged team of 27 physicists, 6 residents, 2 clinical engineers, and medical physics assistants across 2 major hubs and two satellite locations. With a strong foundation already in place, we’re looking for a leader eager to help propel our program forward—advancing technology, introducing new ideas, and guiding emerging clinical initiatives. Over the next 1–3 years, several major imaging, therapy, and software projects will launch, offering exceptional opportunities to shape clinical practice, integrate cutting‑edge technologies, and influence the future of our clinical capabilities. The successful Director of Clinical Physics will provide leadership, mentorship, and performance management for clinical and support staff. They will be central to clinical project management, operational oversight, and fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. We are deeply committed to supporting scholarly activity, professional development, and research, providing abundant opportunities for growth, creativity, and meaningful impact within a forward‑thinking physics and departmental leadership team. Administrative effort will be balanced with clinical activities, teaching, and academic pursuits. The UW\-Madison University campus currently includes a Viewray MRIdian Linac with daily online adaptive radiation therapy, three Varian TrueBeams (one STx), an AccuRay Stellar with Synchrony and online ART capabilities expected, and two Elekta Flexitron Remote Afterloaders. We offer a broad range of special procedures, including SRS/SBRT, TBI, TSE, and brachytherapy for a wide range of treatment sites (e.g., GYN, breast, prostate) with MRI\-guided planning and BodyTom CT for image verification. In Fall 2024, we opened our dual\-hub UW Health Cancer Center, Eastpark Medical Center location on Madison's east side. The 469,000 square foot state\-of\-the\-art facility introduced two new Varian TrueBeams, a Varian Edge, and an Elekta Flexitron Remote Afterloader coupled with Siemens multi\-energy CT on rails. Both locations offer advanced simulation capabilities using Siemens dual\-energy computed tomography with upgrades to photon counting CT simulation planned and 1\.5 T GE MR\-simulator units. Aria Record and Verify systems and advanced treatment planning via RayStation are fully integrated with central planning and chart checking between our two major hubs. The Director of Clinical Physics will have opportunities to collaborate with physics leaders across the growing imaging, theranostics, SRS, and proton therapy programs, facilitating alignment of practice standards, technology development, and strategic initiatives across the department. The proton therapy program, which opened for patient care in July, 2026, includes a Hitachi synchrotron, high\-energy beam transport, intensity modulated proton therapy (IMPT) capability, a gantry room with 360\-degree rotation, and an upcoming fixed beam room with a first\-of\-kind upright patient positioning system provided by Leo Cancer Care coupled with on\-board CT. The Director of Clinical Physics will serve in a departmental leadership capacity to develop best practices to ensure high quality patient care and cutting\-edge implementations in our external beam program. Additional academic opportunities, based on the candidate's interests and accomplishments, in research, education, and service are fully encouraged and supported, including interactions with the Department of Medical Physics Graduate Program. UW is a state\-of\-the\-art integrated clinical, research, and training facility, ranked number 1 in Wisconsin in the U.S. News \& World Report for the 12th consecutive year and ranked 2nd in the TIME World’s Top Public Universities of 2026, that continually invests in the latest technological advancements. Access to ample preclinical/clinical research imaging and therapeutic systems are available including preclinical RayStation treatment planning for research activities. Other major research programs in the department include immunotherapy, theranostics, artificial intelligence, normal\-tissue toxicity assessment, advanced imaging, and automated treatment planning. jobs.title: AI Data Reliability Engineer Intern | Financial Data Systems
jobs.description: About WalletGyde WalletGyde is building a Financial AI platform designed to help people better understand, manage, and improve their financial lives through trustworthy, explainable, and personalized financial intelligence. As our Financial AI architecture becomes more sophisticated, one principle has become increasingly important: An AI system cannot produce trustworthy financial intelligence if the underlying financial data cannot be trusted. WalletGyde integrates financial data through providers such as Plaid and transforms that information into normalized financial structures that support deterministic calculations, financial metrics, product experiences, and AI generated explanations. We are now looking for an **AI Data Reliability Engineer Intern** to help strengthen the data foundation underneath that system. This role is not simply about cleaning spreadsheets or correcting database records. It is about helping engineer WalletGyde’s **Financial Data Health layer**. The Role As an AI Data Reliability Engineer Intern, you will work across financial data ingestion, APIs, normalization, schemas, transaction intelligence, categorization, validation, synthetic financial personas, and cross product data consistency. The central question for this role is: Can every downstream WalletGyde system trust the financial data it receives? You will help us understand exactly how financial information moves from provider APIs into WalletGyde, how that information should be normalized and classified, and how we can systematically detect when something goes wrong. You will also help us expand our synthetic financial testing environment from approximately 20 existing personas toward a much larger and more diverse library of controlled financial scenarios. This role sits at the intersection of **data engineering, FinTech APIs, AI systems, backend engineering, data quality, and Financial AI reliability**. What You Will Work OnPlaid Data Mapping Help document and improve how WalletGyde uses financial data from Plaid. You may work with data related to: Accounts Transactions Balances Income Liabilities Identity Investments Merchants Recurring transactions Transaction categories You will help map provider data into consistent WalletGyde financial structures and document how individual fields are used throughout the platform. Financial API Integration Help strengthen the reliability of WalletGyde’s financial data ingestion workflows. This may include working with: REST APIs JSON responses Pagination Date ranges Transaction history windows Refresh behavior Error handling Missing data Sandbox environments Response parsing API field mapping Rate limits and API reliability The goal is to make sure WalletGyde receives the right financial information and handles incomplete or unexpected provider responses correctly. Data Normalization Financial institutions do not always represent information in exactly the same way. You will help WalletGyde transform provider data into consistent internal structures that downstream systems can rely on. This includes improving normalization for areas such as: Merchant names Account types Transaction descriptions Dates Balances Categories Financial institution data Income sources Transfers Debt payments Schema Design \& Data Contracts Help review and improve the financial schemas supporting WalletGyde. You may work with Supabase, PostgreSQL, and related backend systems to strengthen: Table structures Field definitions Relationships Validation rules Data types Financial taxonomies Data contracts Required versus optional fields Historical financial data The goal is to create a clear, reliable financial data model that can support both product development and AI evaluation. Transaction Intelligence One of the most important parts of this role will be improving how WalletGyde understands transactions. Areas may include: Merchant normalization Transaction categorization Transfer detection Recurring transaction detection Income classification Credit card payment handling Savings transfers Investment transfers Refunds Business versus personal transactions Mandatory versus discretionary spending The challenge is not simply assigning labels. Those classifications directly affect financial calculations such as income, expenses, cash flow, savings rate, debt ratios, budgeting, and financial recommendations. Financial Taxonomy Help evolve WalletGyde’s rules for interpreting financial activity. Examples include distinguishing: **Income vs. transfers** **Expenses vs. debt payments** **Savings transfers vs. spending** **Business vs. personal activity** **Mandatory vs. discretionary expenses** **Recurring vs. one time transactions** **Internal account movement vs. actual financial activity** These distinctions are foundational to accurate Financial AI. Data Validation \& Data Quality Engineering Help build automated checks that identify problems before bad data reaches downstream systems. Examples may include: Are tr resent the user’s financial reality?** ↓ **AI Systems \& Evaluation Engineering** Focuses on Ground Truth, QA, regression, Guardrails, and evaluation. **Core question: Can we prove the system behaved correctly?** ↓ **Tone \& Trust** Focuses on how WalletGyde communicates financial information. **Core question: Did WalletGyde communicate appropriately?** ↓ **Security \& Governance** Focuses on access, permissions, privacy, and responsible system behavior. Together, these systems form the reliability foundation underneath WalletGyde’s Financial AI platform. What We Are Looking For Strong candidates will have experience or interest in several of the following: Python SQL PostgreSQL REST APIs JSON Git and GitHub Supabase or similar databases Data modeling ETL or ELT concepts Data validation Data quality engineering Backend development FinTech APIs Transaction data Schema design Automated testing Synthetic data generation LLMs or AI systems Technical documentation Experience with Plaid is helpful but **not required**. You do not need to know everything on day one. We care heavily about your ability to understand unfamiliar data structures, investigate inconsistencies, ask thoughtful questions, and document what you learn. The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here You should be naturally curious about data. If two financial numbers disagree, your instinct should be to figure out why. Was the source data incomplete? Was a transaction duplicated? Did an API return a partial date range? Was a transfer incorrectly classified as spending? Did two institutions represent the same field differently? Was the schema wrong? Was normalization inconsistent? Did the deterministic calculation consume the wrong field? We are looking for someone willing to follow that chain until the underlying problem is understood. You should also enjoy improving existing systems rather than assuming everything needs to be rebuilt. Why This Internship Is Different This is not a traditional data analyst internship. You will not simply be creating reports from clean datasets. You will work closer to the point where **raw financial data becomes Financial AI intelligence**. You will gain hands on exposure to: Financial APIs FinTech infrastructure Plaid Financial data modeling Database architecture Transaction intelligence Data quality engineering Synthetic data generation Financial taxonomies AI evaluation datasets Financial AI systems Early stage startup engineering You will also see how decisions made at the data layer directly affect AI accuracy, financial calculations, product experiences, and user trust. What Success Looks Like By the end of the internship, we want you to be able to trace a financial data point from: **Provider API** → **WalletGyde ingestion** → **Normalization** → **Supabase** → **Deterministic Financial Intelligence** → **Product Surface** → **AI Response** and understand how errors at any stage could affect the final financial experience. We also want to move closer to a world where WalletGyde can systematically generate hundreds of controlled financial scenarios and automatically test whether our Financial Harness understands them correctly. Ultimately, your work will help answer one of the most important questions in our entire AI architecture: Can every downstream WalletGyde system trust the financial data it receives?How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a short response to the following: Imagine two WalletGyde screens show different monthly spending totals for the same user and month. How would you investigate where the inconsistency originated? GitHub projects, backend systems, data engineering projects, API integrations, synthetic data projects, database work, FinTech projects, or other examples of systems you have built or analyzed are encouraged but not required. **WalletGyde, Inc.** **Building trustworthy financial intelligence from the data layer up.** Job Type: Internship Pay: From $100\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Systems & Evaluation Engineer Intern
jobs.description: About WalletGyde WalletGyde is building a Financial AI platform designed to help people better understand, manage, and improve their financial lives through trustworthy, explainable, and personalized financial intelligence. As we continue evolving our Financial AI architecture, one of our highest priorities is making sure the system does more than generate convincing responses. We want to understand whether every financial answer is **correct, grounded in the right data, produced through the right logic, and communicated responsibly**. Over the past year, our team has built a growing reliability infrastructure around our Financial AI, including deterministic financial calculations, Ground Truth datasets, regression testing, financial personas, Guardrails, Tone \& Trust standards, QA workflows, failure classification, and what we refer to internally as the **WalletGyde Financial Harness**. We are now looking for an **AI Systems \& Evaluation Engineer Intern** to help us strengthen and evolve these systems. The Role This is not a traditional machine learning internship focused primarily on model training. You will work across the systems surrounding modern AI models to help WalletGyde answer one critical question: How do we know WalletGyde produced the right financial answer, for the right reason, with the right behavior? You will help investigate where AI failures originate, improve how we evaluate system performance, strengthen our Ground Truth methodology, build regression coverage, and help convert manual evaluation processes into more repeatable engineering systems. This role sits at the intersection of **AI engineering, evaluation, financial logic, QA, data analysis, and responsible AI**. What You Will Work OnGround Truth \& Financial Accuracy You will help audit, validate, version, and expand WalletGyde’s Ground Truth datasets and expected financial answers. This includes reviewing how expected answers connect to approved financial definitions, formulas, time periods, and deterministic calculation logic. AI Evaluation Help improve how WalletGyde measures AI performance using a combination of: Deterministic evaluators Model based graders Expected versus actual comparisons Financial accuracy testing Behavioral evaluation Human review You will help us move beyond simply asking whether a chatbot response passed or failed and toward understanding **why** a response succeeded or failed. Failure Analysis Investigate failures across multiple parts of the AI stack, including: Financial data Date and period logic Deterministic calculations Retrieval and RAG Orchestration and routing Guardrails Model responses Evaluation methodology The goal is to determine the actual root cause rather than assuming every incorrect response is an LLM problem. Regression Testing Help maintain and expand WalletGyde’s regression suite as new edge cases and failures are discovered. You will work with existing test cases and help ensure engineering improvements do not unintentionally break previously correct behavior. QA Engineering Help convert portions of our existing manual QA methodology into repeatable engineering workflows. This may include test runners, structured evaluation outputs, regression reports, automated checks, and eventually CI/CD evaluation gates. Guardrail Evaluation Help build executable tests around behaviors such as: Uncertainty Unsupported financial claims Clarification Privacy Financial boundaries Hallucination prevention Responsible redirection Safe handling of incomplete information Tone \& Trust Evaluation WalletGyde has developed a Tone \& Trust framework designed around principles such as: **Never Shame** **Never Pretend Certainty** **Answer First** **Encourage the User** **Connect Insight to Action** You will help explore how qualitative standards like these can become measurable, reproducible evaluation criteria. Financial Harness Engineering Support the broader WalletGyde Financial Harness connecting: **Financial Data → Deterministic Logic → Ground Truth → Retrieval → AI Reasoning → Guardrails → Tone → Product Response → Evaluation** You will help us understand how these components interact and how failures can be traced through the system. Evaluation Automation Work alongside WalletGyde engineers and external technical partners to help move portions of our evaluation methodology into automated workflows, regression pipelines, observability systems, and CI/CD. What You Will Inherit You will not be starting from a blank slate. WalletGyde has already developed significant evaluation infrastructure, including: **140 Ground Truth evaluation questions** **26 core regression cases** **20 structured financial personas** **Financial Metrics \& Calculation Logic** **Deterministic Financial Intelligence functions** **Failure classification methodology** **Guardrail framework** **Tone \& Trust framework** **Existing QA workflows** **Financial Harness evaluation methodology** Your job will be to understand what ex  **Evaluation Pipeline v1** Help develop a repeatable workflow that runs evaluation cases and captures expected versus actual behavior. **Failure Attribution Framework** Help improve how WalletGyde identifies whether failures originate from data, calculations, date resolution, retrieval, orchestration, Guardrails, model behavior, or evaluation itself. **Regression Suite Expansion** Turn newly discovered failures into permanent regression tests. **Guardrail Evaluation Suite** Help convert key Guardrail requirements into executable tests. **Tone Evaluation Suite** Explore automated and human assisted approaches for evaluating WalletGyde’s communication principles. **Financial Harness Reporting** Help create structured evaluation outputs that can eventually support dashboards, observability, and engineering decision making. What We Are Looking For Strong candidates will have experience or interest in several of the following: Python SQL REST APIs Git and GitHub Large Language Models RAG systems AI evaluation Automated testing Data analysis Prompt evaluation Model evaluation AI reliability Debugging complex systems CI/CD concepts Financial data or FinTech systems Technical documentation You do not need to be an expert in every area. We care deeply about your ability to **learn quickly, investigate complex systems, ask strong questions, and reason through ambiguous technical problems**. The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here We are looking for someone who is naturally curious. When an AI response is wrong, your instinct should not be: “The model made a mistake.” Your instinct should be: “Why did this fail, and at what layer did the failure actually begin?” Maybe the data was incomplete. Maybe the wrong financial period was selected. Maybe the deterministic calculation was incorrect. Maybe retrieval missed a transaction. Maybe the Ground Truth answer itself was wrong. Maybe the model received the correct information but explained it incorrectly. We want someone who enjoys following that chain until the actual cause is understood. You should also be comfortable reading and understanding existing systems before immediately rebuilding them. Why This Internship Is Different Many AI internships focus primarily on prompts, model experimentation, or building chatbot features. This role focuses on a different question: **How do you engineer trust around an AI system operating in a high stakes domain like personal finance?** You will gain hands on exposure to: Financial AI architecture LLM evaluation Ground Truth engineering Deterministic financial systems AI reliability Responsible AI Guardrail testing Regression engineering RAG systems FinTech data Early stage AI product development Evaluation automation You will also have the opportunity to see how an early stage company moves from experimental AI systems toward more measurable, observable, and production ready infrastructure. What Success Looks Like By the end of the internship, we want you to be able to look at a Financial AI failure and systematically determine: **What happened** **Where it happened** **Why it happened** **How it should be fixed** **How we prevent it from happening again** Ultimately, your work will help WalletGyde move from manually asking whether our AI is correct toward building systems that can **continuously measure, diagnose, and improve Financial AI reliability.** How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a brief response to the following: **Tell us about a technical problem you investigated where the first explanation turned out not to be the actual root cause. How did you figure out what was really happening?** GitHub, technical projects, AI evaluation work, research, or other examples of systems you have built or analyzed are encouraged but not required. **WalletGyde, Inc.** Building trustworthy financial intelligence through better data, better evaluation, and better AI systems. Job Type: Internship Pay: From $100\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

Our client\-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction. We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls. Position Summary Waterfield Tech is seeking a Director, AI \& CX Services to lead and grow one or more professional services delivery practices that design, implement, and modernize customer experience and contact center solutions across leading CCaaS and UC platforms and our Applied AI capabilities. The Director owns the full P\&L for the practices held and is accountable for delivery outcomes, quality, growth, and the people in each practice. Bringing deep, hands\-on delivery expertise, the Director sets the delivery approach, standards, and CX modernization roadmap for the practices held, is the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers, owns the manufacturer/partner relationships, and partners across Sales, Product, and Operations. monitor industry trends, partner roadmaps, and customer feedback; and lead organizational change (change management plans for new methodologies, technologies, and operating models) that fosters continuous improvement and innovation. * Lead and develop the teams within the practices held: hire, coach, develop, and retain leaders and individual contributors; set goals, run performance and career development, and build leadership depth and succession. * Grow the delivery capability and own the manufacturer/partner relationships for the practices held, including certifications, enablement, partner tier, roadmap alignment, and joint delivery. * Establish portfolio level delivery governance and roadmap and release management standards for the practices held, including cadence, health reporting, KPIs, risk and escalation management, quality gates, release readiness, and the accelerator/IP release pipeline; report progress and outcomes to senior leadership. * Set and own delivery standards, methodology, reference architectures, accelerators, templates, quality bars, and the implementation to support handoff and lifecycle standards for the practices held (flows/IVR, IVA/agent assist, WFO/WEM, reporting/administration, and CRM/CTI integrations); run post\-mortems and lessons learned, and feed delivery insight into renewals and expansions. * Own resource and capacity planning across the practices held; partner with Sales on scoping, feasibility, and level of effort while protecting margin during pre\-sales. * Serve as the senior escalation and executive point of contact for customers across the practices held; maintain executive relationships, satisfaction, and reference\-ability. * Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, Operations, and commercial, pre\-sales, and proposal colleagues, bridging technical and non\-technical teams to drive aligned execution of CX modernization. * Drive AI enablement in both directions: delivering AI solutions to customers and applying AI to delivery operations (portfolio health signals, status roll\-ups, risk analysis, documentation) across the practices held. * Where a custom development/Applied AI capability is held, own the team that builds integrations, APIs, conversational AI, and AI\-enabled applications that extend the platforms, and align its roadmap to customer and practice needs. * Review the customer satisfaction and delivery results (CSAT, NPS, and KPIs) for the practices held; use tha le production implementations and migrations at scale (inbound, outbound, blended, Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, WFO/WEM, Studio/IVR, reporting and VCC administration, and CRM/CTI integrations such as Salesforce and ServiceNow). * Zoom (Contact Center, Phone, and Workplace) and custom development/Applied AI delivery preferred. * All other CCaaS/UC practice areas a plus: Genesys (Cloud CX), Cisco (Webex Contact Center/UC), Avaya (Aura/AEP/ACO), and Google (Contact Center AI/Dialogflow). * AI enablement: Conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, real\-time analytics, and AI\-powered self\-service. * Multi\-vendor/multi\-platform delivery: Combining two or more of the above with CRM, WFM, QA, and analytics integrations; legacy to cloud migration delivery. Qualifications **Experience** * 12\+ years delivering complex CX/contact center technology services, with 5\+ years leading, building, and retaining delivery teams (people leadership) accountable for delivery outcomes and margin. * Grounded in hands\-on delivery, with career progression through implementation consultant, technical/solutions architect, or professional services/telephony (CCaaS) engineering into delivery leadership. * Proven track record leading CX modernization initiatives at a leadership level. * Demonstrated financial and practice economics acumen: margin, utilization, burn vs. plan, and estimate at completion. * Experience owning manufacturer/partner relationships, including certification, enablement, and partner tier management, and leading customer executive governance and recovery of at\-risk engagements. * Software development/Applied AI engineering leadership a plus. **Leadership Attributes** * Executive presence and people leadership: build, coach, and retain multi\-team technical organizations. * Strong financial and operational discipline; balances growth, margin, and headcount investment while protecting delivery quality. * Data driven, innovative, and future oriented; turns customer and delivery data into modern CX strategy. * Sets strategy and standards across diverse teams and resolves cross\-team tensions constructively. * Outstanding communication across all levels, including C\-suite and partner executives; strong change management expertise; thrives amid rapid change and ambiguity. **Education** * Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s a plus. Emphasis in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered. Additional Requirements * Manufacturer/platform certifications strongly valued across the CCaaS/UC ecosystem. * PMP/PgMP, ITIL, and change management credentials (e.g., Prosci ADKAR) a plus, but not required for this role. * Availability to work flexible hours as needed, including senior customer escalations. Physical Requirements * Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods (up to 80% of the time). * Lifting: Ability to lift or carry objects up to 10 lbs. * Equipment: Frequent use of computer, telephone, and standard office equipment. * Travel: Ability to travel up to 15% for client meetings, training, or installations. jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic IT team. In this pivotal role, you will drive the automation, deployment, and management of cloud\-based and on\-premise infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and high availability of enterprise software solutions. Your expertise will empower development and operations teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure applications efficiently. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about optimizing software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes through innovative DevOps practices, this is the opportunity for you! **Duties** * Design, implement, and maintain containerization systems such as Docker and Kubernetes to streamline application deployment and scaling. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and PowerShell scripts across cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, OpenStack, and private data centers. * Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines utilizing Jenkins, GitLab, TFS, or similar tools to facilitate continuous integration and continuous delivery of software projects. * Monitor system performance with IT monitoring tools such as New Relic or Splunk; analyze logs for troubleshooting and optimize system health for high availability. * Administer cloud infrastructure components including virtual machines (VMware), virtualization platforms (Virtualization), web servers (NGINX, WebSphere, Weblogic), databases (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle), and application servers. * Implement security best practices by configuring firewalls, managing identity \& access management (IAM), DNS configurations, disaster recovery plans, incident response protocols, and cloud security measures. * Collaborate with development teams to automate deployment processes for enterprise software using scripting languages like Bash (Unix shell), Perl, Groovy, Ruby, Python, C\#, Java, Go, or C\+\+. **Skills** * Extensive experience with containerization systems such as Docker and Kubernetes for deploying microservices architectures. * Proficiency in cloud computing platforms including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, OpenStack; strong understanding of cloud infrastructure management. * Hands\-on knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, Chef; build automation with Maven or Gradle; source control with GitHub or GitLab. * Deep understanding of networking principles including TCP/IP protocols; DNS management; TCP connections; WAN/LAN configurations; network administration. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash (Unix shell), Perl; ability to automate complex deployment workflows and system testing procedures. * Familiarity with enterprise software environments such as WebSphere, Weblogic; middleware configuration; disaster recovery planning; incident recovery strategies. * Experience managing databases like MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle with T\-SQL or PL/SQL scripting for data operations. * Knowledge of monitoring tools such as New Relic or Splunk for log analysis; Elasticsearch for search capabilities; incident management protocols. * Understanding of SDLC principles including requirements gathering, requirements management; agile methodologies like Scrum or Kanban for project execution. * Ability to troubleshoot technical issues related to cloud security, system administration across UNIX/Linux environments; debugging software deployment problems efficiently. Join us to be at the forefront of innovative IT infrastructure solutions! Bring your passion for automation and your expertise in cloud\-native technologies to help us deliver reliable enterprise software that empowers users worldwide. We value proactive problem solvers eager to make a tangible impact through continuous improvement and collaborative teamwork! Pay: $115,374\.75 \- $138,945\.94 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Specialty Protocol Engineer
jobs.description: **About This Role:** Wells Fargo is seeking several Senior Specialty Software Developers (Protocol Engineers) to contribute to a next\-generation Digital Asset Platform designed to solve the most critical challenge in institutional finance: achieving strict regulatory compliance without compromising transaction confidentiality. Wells Fargo is moving beyond standard public blockchains to build a custom, application\-specific infrastructure. Our platform utilizes advanced cryptography to enable "auditable privacy"—allowing regulated institutions to settle digital assets securely while preserving strategic confidentiality, without relying on centralized intermediaries. As a Senior Protocol Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting the core settlement engine. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems and applied cryptography, translating complex mathematical proofs into high\-performance, **production\-grade Go code**. **Why apply to this job?** * **To work on complex problems:** You won't be building another yield farm copycat. You'll be solving fundamental privacy/compliance contradictions in the global financial system * **High\-Impact Engineering:** Your code will secure high\-value institutional transactions * **Technical Autonomy:** You'll play a key role in architectural decisions, choosing the right curves, libraries, and design patterns **Responsibilities:** * **Core Protocol Development:** Architect and build a custom blockchain application using **Go**, **Cosmos SDK**, and **CometBFT (Tendermint)** * **Cryptographic Implementation:** Implement and optimize privacy\-preserving primitives, specifically **Pedersen Commitments** and **Bulletproofs (Range Proofs)**, ensuring no trusted setup is required * **Consensus Customization:** Engineer custom **ABCI\+\+** extensions (specifically PrepareProposal and Vote Extensions) to implement an on\-chain Multi\-Party Computation (MPC) mixing network. * **State Machine Design:** Design a custom KVStore state machine that manages homomorphic encrypted balances (Elliptic Curve points) instead of plaintext integers. * **Performance Engineering:** Optimize cryptographic operations (scalar multiplication, point addition) for low latency and high throughput in a distributed environment. * **Auditing Infrastructure:** Build secure off\-chain query layers and "view key" mechanisms that allow for granular, permissioned regulatory auditing. **Required Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of Specialty Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * **Systems Engineering:** 3\+ years of experience in backend or systems programming, with expert\-level proficiency in **Go (Golang)** * **Applied Cryptography:** 6\+ months of experience with Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) * **Distributed Systems:** 1\+ year of experience withBFT consensus algorithms, P2P networking, and state replication **Desired Qualifications:** * **Blockchain Core:** Deep experience with **Cosmos SDK** and **CometBFT**. Comfort building custom modules and modifying consensus logic, not just deploying smart contracts * **Pedersen Commitments** (Homomorphic encryption properties) * **Zero\-Knowledge Proofs** (specifically Bulletproofs or Sigma protocols) * **Math\-to\-Code:** Demonstrated ability to read academic whitepapers/preprints and translate mathematical specifications into functioning code * Experience with **MPC (Multi\-Party Computation)** or Verifiable Secret Sharing (VSS) schemes * Familiarity with the **Ristretto255** curve or libraries like gnark\-crypto * Background in **FinTech, payment systems, or high\-frequency trading platforms** * Understanding of the **Account Model** vs. **UTXO Model** trade\-offs in privacy\-preserving ledgers **Job Expectations:** * This position offers a hybrid work schedule * Relocation assistance is not available for this position **Locations:** * 194 Wood Ave S, Iselin, New Jersey * 3075 Loyalty Circle, Columbus, Ohio * 1755 Grant Street, Concord, California **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities. $119,000\.00 \- $224,000\.00**Benefits** Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Manager, AI and ML Engineering
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Management Technical 715 Pay Range: $174,700\.00 \- $288,200\.00**Job Description** The Manager, AI and ML Engineering is a leader in building high\-performing teams that turn AI opportunities into production\-ready solutions. This leader combines strong people leadership, technical judgment, and a bias for delivery to guide the design, development, evaluation, and continuous improvement of AI applications and services. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Security, and business partners, the manager translates strategy into execution, develops talent, establishes engineering excellence, and helps scale responsible AI across the university. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise AI Platforms, this role leads the AI Engineering team and supports the Director in advancing engineering strategy, technical standards, delivery practices, and organizational priorities across the broader Enterprise AI Platforms organization. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Leads, develops, and inspires a high\-performing team of AI Engineers through clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and purposeful career development. * Translates AI strategy and organizational priorities into an actionable team roadmap, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. * Leads the design, development, testing, evaluation, deployment, and continuous improvement of production AI applications and services. * Establishes and reinforces engineering standards, design patterns, development practices, and quality expectations that improve reliability, scalability, security, and developer productivity. * Partners with the Director, Enterprise AI Platforms, to shape AI Engineering strategy, technical priorities, organizational planning, and cross\-team initiatives. * Drives delivery of complex, high\-impact AI initiatives, balancing near\-term business outcomes with long\-term technical sustainability. * Partners closely with AI Platform Operations and other technology teams to ensure AI solutions are production\-ready, observable, secure, scalable, and operationally sustainable. * Collaborates with Product, Engineering, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Security, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate opportunities into practical AI solutions. * Provides technical leadership and guidance on generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI application architecture, evaluation, and emerging AI technologies. * Builds reusable engineering capabilities, patterns, components, and practices that accelerate delivery and enable teams to develop AI solutions consistently. * Champions responsible AI engineering practices, including appropriate evaluation, security, privacy, governance, risk management, and quality controls. * Uses engineering metrics, product outcomes, quality measures, and operational signals to identify opportunities, manage risk, and continuously improve team performance and solution value. * Leads technical discussions and decisions, clearly articulating tradeoffs, recommendations, risks, and implications to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Evaluates emerging AI technologies, development frameworks, models, tools, and vendor capabilities and translates relevant advances into practical engineering opportunities. * Creates a culture of innovation, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement while maintaining a strong focus on delivery and production quality. * Represents AI Engineering with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional partners, building trust and alignment around technical direction and delivery. * Mentors engineers and technical leaders across the broader organizatio tware, AI, or engineering professionals, including responsibility for delivery and team development. * Demonstrated jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **CLIENT HIGHLIGHT** The client you will be working for is a Fortune Global 500 Renewable Energy Company. This opportunity will give you experience in the clean energy sector with a company that is a globally recognized leader in wind, solar, and grid infrastructure — and one of the largest power producers in the world. **LOCATION** Remote, USA. **COMPENSATION** $44\.50/hour. **SCHEDULE** Monday\-Friday, 40 hours per week, timing flexible. **CONTRACT TERM** 9\-and\-a\-half\-month contract with a very high likelihood of extension/conversion to full\-time. **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Firmware Engineer will be responsible for maintaining and updating firmware on four proprietary hardware devices critical to the operations of the Demand Response business. These devices support remote energy monitoring, control equipment toggling, and secure communication with central servers and dispatch platforms. This role requires a detail\-oriented embedded systems engineer with deep knowledge of microcontroller architectures, communication protocols, and legacy firmware systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with a strong interest in sustaining long\-lifecycle products and supporting hardware deployed in the field. **RESPONSIBILITIES** **Technical Firmware Maintenance:*** Maintain and enhance embedded firmware for low\-power microcontroller\-based systems. * Analyze, debug, and resolve field\-reported issues, ensuring reliability and uptime. * Modify and extend legacy codebases with minimal documentation. * Collaborate with electrical engineers to support device\-level debugging and testing. **Hardware Interface Integration:*** Work with digital I/O, relays, KYZ pulse counting, analog inputs, and related interfaces. * Use development tools and equipment such as debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Integrate serial protocols including UART, RS\-232, RS\-485, SPI, and I2C. **Communication Systems:*** Support and troubleshoot cellular modem communications using AT commands. * Maintain and optimize firmware for reliable data transmission from field\-deployed units. * Support satellite module integration for remote telemetry. **Product Lifecycle \& Sustainability:*** Participate in long\-term support for embedded products used in energy monitoring. * Maintain secure firmware update mechanisms, bootloaders, and OTA processes. * Ensure backward compatibility and long\-term maintainability of deployed firmware. * Collaborate with senior engineers to understand design rationale and architecture. **Documentation \& Collaboration:*** Create and maintain technical documentation outlining firmware behavior and architecture. * Work cross\-functionally with hardware and field teams to coordinate debugging and enhancements. * Record and share tribal knowledge to enhance future sustainability. **OTHER DUTIES*** Support continuous improvement efforts in firmware processes and maintainability. * Assist with legacy code refactoring efforts while minimizing risk to deployed systems. * Provide input into hardware design with firmware constraints in mind. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS** **Education:*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Work Experience: * 2\-5 years of experience in embedded firmware development. * Prior exposure to legacy code maintenance and fielded device support. **Certifications:*** No certifications required, but familiarity with secure firmware design or industrial communication protocols is beneficial. **Skills \& Tools:*** Experience in embedded systems programming with competence in C/C\+\+, Python, and Linux Shell Script. * Experience working with Embedded Linux and associated open source resources, including cross\-compile toolchains and Yocto image build software. * Ability to use debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Serial communication protocols: UART, RS\-232, RS\-485, SPI, I2C. * Experience with Modbus, KYZ pulse metering, and industrial energy monitoring equipment. * Familiarity with battery\-powered device design and power optimization. * Clear communication and strong documentation practices. * Comfort with schematics and cross\-functional engineering collaboration.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- About Weyerhaeuser At Weyerhaeuser, we are the world’s premier timberland, and forest products company. Sustainability is the founding concept of our business, and our values drive every decision to ensure we continue to lead the forestry industry in sustainability practices. And we know about sustainability – we led it in the forestry industry when we planted our first seedling by hand in 1938\. We recognize that our success is dependent on the success of our people. For over 125 years, our Weyerhaeuser team has been making a difference in the world – from the seedlings we plant, to the forests and trees we nurture, we ensure every acre is managed with diligence, patience and pride. That’s the Weyerhaeuser way. About the Role Grasp the opportunity to apply data science to the physical world of manufacturing! We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to provide technical leadership and passionate about applying machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and optimization techniques to solve complex business problems across manufacturing, operations reliability, supply chain, and product quality domains. We have a large manufacturing presence in North America with lumber, OSB, plywood, and engineered lumber products mills in Canada and the United States. Our Weyerhaeuser brand and scale of operations make us a major player in the wood products business. You would be partnering with our manufacturing mills to identify, analyze, and solve complex problems related to production quality, equipment reliability, and preventative maintenance. Your work would directly impact operational efficiency, improved product quality, and mill uptime. You will work with historian data, MES systems, machine sensors, vision systems, operational events, and enterprise data to build solutions that directly impact mill performance. You have a high attention to detail, but are good at seeing the big picture, and aren’t afraid to think outside the box, and champion your ideas. You have experience articulating opportunity, as well as creating and successfully managing projects. You are effective at communicating timely and relevant information to business leaders and internal partners. Responsibilities * Partner with manufacturing, reliability, maintenance, quality, and operations teams to understand business problems and translate them into machine learning opportunities. * Analyze large volumes of industrial time\-series, historian, MES, ERP, and sensor data to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and root causes. * Establish reusable patterns, standards, and best practices for model development and deployment. * Define success metrics that balance model performance with business outcomes including revenue growth, operational efficiency, customer experience, safety, and risk reduction. * Partner with Product Managers and Operation teams to identify, prioritize, and frame business opportunities that can be solved with scientific framework. * Influence technical direction across multiple programs without direct authority. * Design, execute, and analyze online and offline experiments, including A/B testing, causal inference, and counterfactual analysis, to evaluate the impact of data science solutions on business outcomes. * Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models to solve forecasting, optimization, reliability, anomaly detection, and decision\-support problems. * Design and implement statistical process control methods and anomaly detection techniques to proactively address quality issues in the manufacturing process. * Own the end\-to\-end model lifecycle, including feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement. * Collaborate with software engineers, ML engineers, and data engineers to productionize models and integrate AI capabilities into business workflows. * Translate ambiguous business problems into scientific approaches and influence stakeholders through data\-driven recommendations. * Develop analytical visualizations and communicate findings through dashboards, notebooks, and presentations that drive business decisions. * Contribute to reusable analytics libraries, feature engineering patterns, and best practices across Industrial AI use cases. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning and AI solutions in manufacturing, industrial, supply chain, or related domains. * Strong software engineering skills in Python and modern ML frameworks. * Expertise in supervised learing, forecasting, optimization, statistical modeling, anomaly detection, model evaluation and experimentation methodologies. * Demonstrated success delivering enterprise\-scale AI products from concept through production. * Experience leading highly ambiguous technical initiatives. * Proven ability to influence technical strategy across multiple teams and organizations. * Experience with experimentation and causal inference methods, including A/B testing, quasi\-experimental designs, and counterfactual analysis. * Experience communicating insights using Power BI or Python\-based visualization libraries such as Plotly and Matplotlib. * Experience with modern cloud platforms and data architectures, including AWS, Azure, Snowflake, and MLOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management. Preferred, not required: * Practical experience with Recommendation Systems, Pricing Optimization, and Computer Vision * Practical experience in Forestry Services or Wood Product manufacturing * Experience with Industrial Internet of Things and time\-series manufacturing data Education * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative discipline. **What We Offer:** **Compensation:** This role is eligible for our annual merit\-increase program, and we are targeting a salary range of $98,811\-148,217 based on your level of skills, qualifications and experience. You will also be eligible for our Annual Incentive Program, which offers a cash bonus targeting 15% of base pay. Potential plan funding may range from zero to two times that target. **Benefits:** When you join our team, you and your dependents will be offered coverage under our comprehensive employee benefits plan, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, and life insurance. We offer a pre\-tax Health Savings Account option which includes a company contribution. Other benefit options are also available such as voluntary Long\-Term Care and Employee Assistance Programs. We also support personal volunteerism, sponsor a host of diversity networks, promote mentoring, and provide training and development opportunities to help you chart your path to a fulfilling career. **Retirement:** Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, which includes a paid company match in addition to our contribution equal to 5% of your eligible pay **Paid Time Off or Vacation:** We provide eligible employees who are scheduled to work 25 hours or more per week with 3\-weeks of paid vacation to use during your first year of employment. In addition, after being employed for six months, eligible employees begin to accrue vacation for future use. We also recognize eleven paid holidays per year, providing a total of 88 holiday hours and paid parental leave for all full\-time employees. *Weyerhaeuser is an equal opportunity employer. Inclusion is one of our five core values and we strive to maintain a culture where all our people feel a sense of belonging, opportunity and shared purpose. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce and supporting an equitable and inclusive environment that inspires people of all backgrounds to join, stay and thrive with our team.* **Job** ------- Information Technology**Primary Location** -------------------- USA\-WA\-Seattle**Schedule** ------------ Full\-time**Job Level** ------------- Individual Contributor**Job Type** ------------ Experienced**Shift** --------- Day (1st) Relocation Assistance Available

jobs.description: Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar \- delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy. Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact \- both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best. Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs. **Position Summary:** Applies extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. Performs as a staff advisor and consultant in a technical specialty, a type of facility or equipment, or a program function. Carries out complex or innovative assignments requiring the development of new or improved techniques and procedures. Work is expected to result in the development of new/improved techniques and procedures or new/refined equipment, materials, processes, products, and/or scientific methods. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact on contracts and projects and interacts with senior external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Work is performed without appreciable direction and considerable latitude is exercised in determining technical objectives of assignment. Guidance relates largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts and policy matters. Completed work is reviewed from a relatively long\- term perspective, for desired results. May assign tasks to and direct engineers, technicians, craft personnel and administrative staff, including coordination and review of work assignments. Responsible for (and may lead) multiple projects of moderate to large size or portions of major projects. This role requires a balance of technical acumen and strong communication skills, as the senior engineer will need to convey technical concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Communication will occur in various formats, including in\-person meetings, virtual discussions, presentations to leadership, and written reports. **Essential Responsibilities:** * Power systems studies engineer: Leads and performs modeling and analysis activities for steady state and stability simulations * Transmission planning engineer: Develops scopes for studies to guide long\-range transmission system plans and coordinates with other Integrated System Planning departments to ensure assumptions align across subdisciplines * Effectively communicates the results of studies and department endeavors to a wide range of audiences through written and verbal means * Improves Integrated System Planning procedures and techniques through largely self\-directed work. Resolves difficult technical and business problems * Implements, without substantial direction, NERC and FERC compliance activities as an SME. Activities are coordinated through the Integrated System Planning department and with external entities * Assigns tasks to lower\-level engineers, interns and technicians. Mentors and provides training materials for less experienced engineers to ensure group development **Senior Minimum Requirements (Salary Range: $97,000\-$145,500\)** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering and/or Physics from ABET accredited curriculum, electrical engineering degree preferred. * 5\+ years with nationally recognized certification, 7\+ years without certification. * Experience with multiple power system transmission analysis tools such as PSSE, TARA, EMS, ASPEN, CAPE, PROMOD, PLEXOS, PowerWorld, PSCAD or other similar analysis software. * EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering and/or PE (Professional Engineer) registration preferred. * Graduate degree in fields above preferred. **Principal Minimum Requirements (Salary Range: $112,000\-$178,900\)** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering and/or Physics from ABET accredited curriculum (or recognized equivalency). * 9 \+ years of demonstrated experience with PE (Professional Engineer) registration, 15\+ years of demonstrated experience without PE (Professional Engineer) registration. * Experience with multiple power system transmission analysis tools, such as PSSE, TARA, EMS, ASPEN, CAPE, PROMOD, PLEXOS, PowerWorld, PSCAD or other similar analysis software. * EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering and/or PE (Professional Engineer) registration preferred. * Graduate degree in fields above preferred. * PE (Professional Engineer) registration preferred. **Preferred Experience \& Skills:** * Experience with Python programming * Proficiency in conducting transient stability studies and analysis. * Experience with EMT modeling and studies using PSCAD, ETAP or other similar tools Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together. **Our Values** Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe **Our Employee Commitments** * Work that makes a difference * A team you can count of * Opportunities to grow * Rewards that help you thrive Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form. In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information including but not limited to dates of school attendance and graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. jobs.title: Lead Engineer - Payments Platform
jobs.description: **The role / impact** In this role, you will help shape the technical foundation for money movement capabilities while unlocking new product lines globally. You will guide the design and development of reliable, scalable, performant, and secure services for the platform, ensuring operational excellence and direct business outcomes. This is a rare chance to join an early\-stage initiative, make foundational architectural decisions, and have a visible impact on the future of small businesses. By contributing directly to production code and proof\-of\-concepts, you will solve complex financial technology challenges at a massive scale. **The team / how they connect** The Payments Platform team is the engine powering money movement across the entire ecosystem, collaborating closely with product, security, risk, and operations. We are a highly collaborative collective that values technical excellence, inclusion, and continuous innovation. Together, we work cross\-functionally to translate complex business needs into resilient engineering solutions that support millions of subscribers. **The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on** * Designing and building out payment platform capabilities, such as orchestration, risks \& fraud, multi\-providers, to accelerate various payment products development and improve operational posture * Building out a global bill payment product to streamline how small businesses manage their cash flow * Developing core high\-throughput platform services * Integrating and championing artificial intelligence capabilities to accelerate engineering productivity and enhance developer workflows **Where and how you can work** **This position is open to remote applicants based within Washington State.** Because this role requires close cross\-functional collaboration with our teams in Australia and New Zealand, working within the Pacific time zone helps align our schedules for essential catch\-ups. You will also have the flexibility to balance your remote focus with in\-person connection during team alignment days and local hub events. **Here are some of the things we are looking for** * You bring a proven track record of delivering highly available, distributed backend systems and designing high\-throughput services under real\-world constraints * A deep understanding of system architecture, API design, and both SQL and NoSQL databases is essential * Your background includes proficiency in modern backend stacks such as C\#, Java, Golang, or C\+\+, alongside cloud\-native platforms like AWS * You are passionate about staying hands\-on contributing directly to production code, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical deep dives. * You possess strong leadership capabilities, with a passion for setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and fostering an inclusive culture * You demonstrate strong ability in breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable solutions while driving agile execution to deliver results. * You are a strong partner to Product, Design, and other cross\-functional teams to translate complex business needs into resilient engineering solutions. * You are a champion of advanced usage in AI tools and practices across the team to accelerate development workflows. Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team. We are also tech stack agnostic, so please apply if you've worked with adjacent technologies. **Compensation \& Total Rewards** At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy \- which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheque. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world\-class benefits. The expected base salary range for this role in: * Washington: **$206,000 \- $260,000 USD** Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role. In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation: * **Variable Pay:** Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance\-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our **Xero Perks** page. Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job\-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken. Compensation Range: $206K \- $260K

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer I
jobs.description: * The Site Reliability Engineer I supports the reliability, availability, and operational health of KFC production systems and applications. This role works with Platform Engineering, Development, and Product teams to monitor and troubleshoot production environments, improve observability, contribute to automation, and support cloud\-based infrastructure. * The SRE I is expected to operate within defined systems and services, contribute to reliability improvements, participate in incident response, and build increasing technical ownership over time. * + Observability – Monitor KFC production environments using tools such as Datadog. Create and improve monitors, dashboards, alerts, logging, and other telemetry used to proactively identify reliability and performance issues. * + Incident Response – Participate in the investigation, troubleshooting, and restoration of production systems. Use metrics, logs, traces, and application telemetry to identify issues and support technical resolution and post\-incident actions. * + Cloud \& Infrastructure – Support and improve cloud\-based and containerized infrastructure, including compute, networking, application services, and supporting platform components. * + Infrastructure as Code – Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of infrastructure using technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and GitLab in partnership with SRE and Platform Engineering teams. * + Automation – Develop basic scripts, tools, and automated workflows using technologies such as Python, Go, Bash, and REST APIs to reduce repetitive operational work and toil. * + Reliability Engineering – Contribute to improvements in system availability, scalability, resilience, and performance by identifying operational gaps and implementing defined reliability improvements. * + Deployment \& Production Support – Assist with deployment readiness, production validation, change verification, and monitoring following application or infrastructure releases. * + Documentation \& Continuous Improvement – Maintain operational runbooks and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and improvements identified through incidents and service health reviews. * + Participate in the SRE 24/7 on\-call rotation to detect, respond to, and resolve production issues. * + Education/Certifications – Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent technical experience. * Experience * 1 to 3\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, infrastructure, application support, software engineering, or a related technical role. * 1\+ year’s experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute and networking concepts. * 1\+ year’s experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, or Grafana. * 1\+ year’s experience with Incident and Problem Management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Incident.io. * Familiarity with Linux\-based systems and command\-line utilities. * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, load balancing, routing, and TLS. * Experience with containerized environments and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes or EKS. * Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, Bash, or REST APIs. * Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation. * Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices, including GitLab. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
